subject: biology
picture: A close-up photo of droplets of water on a fresh green leaf, with a blurred natural background.

en.fact: Did you know the human body is about 60% water?
en.detail: Most of your cells are filled with water, which helps chemical reactions, transport, and temperature regulation. Losing even a few percent of body water affects mood, energy and concentration.

pcm.fact: You sabi say human body na about 60% water?
pcm.detail: Most of your cells are filled with water, which helps chemical reactions, transport, and temperature regulation. Losing even a few percent of body water affects mood, energy and concentration.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ara ènìyàn jẹ́ 60% omi?
yo.detail: Most of your cells are filled with water, which helps chemical reactions, transport, and temperature regulation. Losing even a few percent of body water affects mood, energy and concentration.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ahụ mmadụ nwere ihe dị ka 60% mmiri?
ig.detail: Ọtụtụ n’ime sel gị jupụtara mmiri, nke na-enyere usoro kemịkal, njem ihe, na nhazi okpomọkụ; ọnwụ naanị pasent ole na ole nke mmiri ahụ gbanwere ọnọdụ uche, ume na mmegharị iche.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa jikin ɗan adam kusan 60% ruwa ne?
ha.detail: Yawancin ƙwayoyin jikinka suna cike da ruwa, wanda ke taimakawa a cikin sinadarai, sufuri da daidaita yanayin zafin jiki; rasa kashi kaɗan na wannan ruwa zai iya shafar hali, ƙarfi da mayar da hankali.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Le corps humain est composé d'environ 60% d'eau.
fr.detail: La plupart de vos cellules sont remplies d'eau, ce qui aide les réactions chimiques, le transport et la régulation de la température; perdre même quelques pourcents d'eau corporelle affecte l'humeur, l'énergie et la concentration.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن جسم الإنسان يتكون من حوالي 60% ماء؟
ar.detail: Most of your cells are filled with water, which helps chemical reactions, transport, and temperature regulation. Losing even a few percent of body water affects mood, energy and concentration.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mwili wa mwanadamu ni takriban 60% maji?
sw.detail: Seli nyingi za mwili zimejaa maji, ambayo husaidia katika mwitikio wa kemikali, usafirishaji na udhibiti wa joto; kupoteza hata asilimia chache ya maji mwilini huathiri hali ya hisia, nishati na umakini.

pt.fact: Sabias que o corpo humano tem cerca de 60% de água?
pt.detail: A maioria das células contém água, que ajuda nas reações químicas, no transporte e na regulação da temperatura; perder apenas alguns por cento de água corporal afeta o humor, a energia e a concentração.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el cuerpo humano es aproximadamente 60% agua?
es.detail: La mayoría de tus células están llenas de agua, que ayuda en reacciones químicas, transporte y regulación de la temperatura; perder incluso unos pocos puntos porcentuales de agua corporal afecta el ánimo, la energía y la concentración.

subject: biology
picture: A high-resolution microscopic image of mitochondria inside a cell, showing many small sausage-shaped organelles.

en.fact: Did you know mitochondria are inherited almost only from your mother?
en.detail: Mitochondria have their own DNA passed through the egg cell. That maternal inheritance is why some mitochondrial disorders and DNA studies trace the mother's lineage.

pcm.fact: You sabi say mitochondria almost always dey come from your mama?
pcm.detail: Mitochondria have their own DNA passed through the egg cell. That maternal inheritance is why some mitochondrial disorders and DNA studies trace the mother's lineage.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé mitochondria máa ń wọ̀lú fọwọ́kan láti ọ́dọ̀ ìyá rẹ ní hù?
yo.detail: Mitochondria have their own DNA passed through the egg cell. That maternal inheritance is why some mitochondrial disorders and DNA studies trace the mother's lineage.

ig.fact: Ị ma na mitochondria na-abịa fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ naanị site nʼaka nne gị?
ig.detail: Mitochondria nwere DNA nke ha nke a na-ebufe site nʼakpa nwa (egg); nʼihi nke a, ụfọdụ ọrịa mitochondria na ọmụmụ DNA na-achọpụta slaynị nne.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa mitokondriya ana gada su kusan gaba ɗaya daga mahaifiyarka?
ha.detail: Mitokondriya na da nasa DNA wanda ake watsawa ta ƙwayar ƙwai; wannan gadar mahaifiya ce ke sa wasu cututtukan mitokondriya da binciken DNA su bi asalin mahaifiya.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les mitochondries sont héritées presque uniquement de votre mère.
fr.detail: Les mitochondries possèdent leur propre ADN transmis par l'ovule; cet héritage maternel explique pourquoi certaines maladies mitochondriales et études génétiques retracent la lignée maternelle.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الميتوكوندريا تُورَّث تقريبًا من الأم فقط؟
ar.detail: Mitochondria have their own DNA passed through the egg cell. That maternal inheritance is why some mitochondrial disorders and DNA studies trace the mother's lineage.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mitochondria hupitishwa karibu kabisa kutoka kwa mama yako?
sw.detail: Mitochondria zina DNA yao inayopitishwa kupitia yai; urithi huu wa kike ndicho kilichoelezea kwa nini baadhi ya matatizo ya mitochondria na tafiti za DNA zinafuata mzizi wa upande wa mama.

pt.fact: Sabias que as mitocôndrias são herdadas quase só pela mãe?
pt.detail: As mitocôndrias têm ADN próprio transmitido através do óvulo; essa herança materna explica por que algumas doenças mitocondriais e estudos genéticos seguem a linhagem materna.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las mitocondrias se heredan casi exclusivamente de tu madre?
es.detail: Las mitocondrias tienen su propio ADN que se transmite a través del óvulo; esa herencia materna explica por qué ciertos trastornos mitocondriales y estudios de ADN rastrean la línea materna.

subject: biology
picture: A close-up photo of sunlit green leaves with visible chlorophyll-rich cells and sunlight filtering through.

en.fact: Did you know plants split water to make oxygen during photosynthesis?
en.detail: In photosynthesis, chloroplasts use light to split water and release oxygen as a byproduct. This process made Earth's breathable atmosphere over millions of years.

pcm.fact: You sabi say plants dey split water to make oxygen during photosynthesis?
pcm.detail: In photosynthesis, chloroplasts use light to split water and release oxygen as a byproduct. This process made Earth's breathable atmosphere over millions of years.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn ọ̀gbìn ń ya omi kúrò nínú rẹ̀ kí wọ́n lè ṣe ọ̀kísẹ́nì nígbà fọ́tósíntésì?
yo.detail: In photosynthesis, chloroplasts use light to split water and release oxygen as a byproduct. This process made Earth's breathable atmosphere over millions of years.

ig.fact: Ị ma na osisi na-ekewa mmiri ka ha wee mepụta oxygen nʼime fotosynthesis?
ig.detail: Nʼime fotosynthesis, chloroplasts na-eji ìhè kewaa mmiri ma wee wepụ oxygen dị ka ihe mgbakwunye; usoro a mere ka ikuku ụwa bụrụ nke a ga-anụrịrị nʼime puku afọ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa tsire‑tsire suna raba ruwa don su samar da iskar oxygen yayin photosynthesis?
ha.detail: A cikin photosynthesis, chloroplasts suna amfani da haske don raba ruwa kuma su saki iskar oxygen a matsayin samfurin gefe; wannan tsari ya kafa yanayin da za a iya numfashi a doron ƙasa a tsawon miliyoyin shekaru.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les plantes scindent l'eau pour produire de l'oxygène lors de la photosynthèse.
fr.detail: Dans la photosynthèse, les chloroplastes utilisent la lumière pour séparer l'eau et libérer de l'oxygène comme sous-produit; ce processus a créé l'atmosphère respirable de la Terre sur des millions d'années.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن النباتات تفصل الماء لإنتاج الأكسجين أثناء عملية البناء الضوئي؟
ar.detail: In photosynthesis, chloroplasts use light to split water and release oxygen as a byproduct. This process made Earth's breathable atmosphere over millions of years.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mimea hugawanya maji ili kutengeneza oksijeni wakati wa fotosintesis?
sw.detail: Katika fotosintesis, kloroplasti hutumia mwanga kugawanya maji na kutoa oksijeni kama bidhaa ya pembeni; mchakato huu umeunda anga inayoweza kupumuliwa duniani kwa mamilioni ya miaka.

pt.fact: Sabias que as plantas partem a água para produzir oxigénio durante a fotossíntese?
pt.detail: Na fotossíntese, os cloroplastos usam a luz para dividir a água e libertar oxigénio como subproduto; esse processo formou a atmosfera respirável da Terra ao longo de milhões de anos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las plantas dividen el agua para producir oxígeno durante la fotosíntesis?
es.detail: En la fotosíntesis, los cloroplastos usan la luz para dividir el agua y liberar oxígeno como subproducto; este proceso creó la atmósfera respirable de la Tierra durante millones de años.

subject: biology
picture: A forest floor with visible tree roots and a close-up of thin white fungal threads (mycorrhizae) among soil and leaf litter.

en.fact: Did you know trees share food and signals through underground fungal networks?
en.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi connect tree roots and move sugars, nutrients and chemical signals between plants. Scientists call this network the "wood wide web" for its communication role.

pcm.fact: You sabi say trees dey share food and messages through underground fungal networks?
pcm.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi connect tree roots and move sugars, nutrients and chemical signals between plants. Scientists call this network the "wood wide web" for its communication role.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn igi máa ń pín oúnjẹ àti ìkìlọ̀ nípasẹ̀ nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì ìfúnpọ̀ fungi ní ìsàlẹ̀ ilé?
yo.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi connect tree roots and move sugars, nutrients and chemical signals between plants. Scientists call this network the "wood wide web" for its communication role.

ig.fact: Ị ma na osisi na-ekerịta nri na mgbaàmà site nʼụgbọ mmiri fungi n'okpuru ala?
ig.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi jikọtara mgbọrọgwụ osisi ma na-ebu shuga, nri na mgbaàmà kemịkal n'etiti osisi; ndị ọkà mmụta akpọrọ netwọk a “wood wide web” n’ihi ọrụ nkwurịta okwu ya.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa itatuwa na raba abinci da saƙonni ta hanyar hanyoyin fungi a ƙasa?
ha.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi suna haɗa tushen itatuwa kuma suna motsa sukari, sinadarai masu gina jiki da saƙonni tsakanin tsirrai; masana suna kiran wannan hanyar sadarwar “wood wide web” saboda rawar sadarwa da take takawa.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les arbres partagent nourriture et signaux via des réseaux fongiques souterrains.
fr.detail: Les champignons mycorhiziens relient les racines des arbres et déplacent sucres, nutriments et signaux chimiques entre les plantes; les scientifiques appellent ce réseau le « wood wide web » pour son rôle de communication.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأشجار تتشارك الغذاء والإشارات عبر شبكات فطرية تحت الأرض؟
ar.detail: Mycorrhizal fungi connect tree roots and move sugars, nutrients and chemical signals between plants. Scientists call this network the "wood wide web" for its communication role.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa miti hushirikishana chakula na ishara kupitia mitandao ya uyoga chini ya ardhi?
sw.detail: Uyoga wa mycorrhizal unaunganisha mizizi ya miti na kusafirisha sukari, virutubisho na ishara za kemikali kati ya mimea; wanasayansi huuita mtandao huu "wood wide web" kwa sababu ya jukumu lake la mawasiliano.

pt.fact: Sabias que as árvores partilham comida e sinais através de redes fúngicas subterrâneas?
pt.detail: Fungos micorrízicos ligam as raízes das árvores e movem açúcares, nutrientes e sinais químicos entre plantas; os cientistas chamam essa rede de "wood wide web" pelo seu papel na comunicação.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los árboles comparten alimentos y señales a través de redes subterráneas de hongos?
es.detail: Los hongos micorrízicos conectan las raíces de los árboles y mueven azúcares, nutrientes y señales químicas entre plantas; los científicos llaman a esta red la «wood wide web» por su papel comunicativo.

subject: biology
picture: A macro photo of several fingerprint patterns on a neutral surface, showing loops and whorls in high contrast.

en.fact: Did you know identical twins do not have identical fingerprints?
en.detail: Fingerprints form in the womb and are shaped by tiny differences in blood flow and position, so even identical twins have unique patterns. Fingerprints are therefore useful for individual identification.

pcm.fact: You sabi say identical twins no get identical fingerprints?
pcm.detail: Fingerprints form in the womb and are shaped by tiny differences in blood flow and position, so even identical twins have unique patterns. Fingerprints are therefore useful for individual identification.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìbáṣe-ara (identical) twins kò ní àmì ọwọ́ kan náà?
yo.detail: Fingerprints form in the womb and are shaped by tiny differences in blood flow and position, so even identical twins have unique patterns. Fingerprints are therefore useful for individual identification.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụmụnne yiri ibe ha (identical twins) adịghị enwe mkpịsị aka nke yiri ibe ha?
ig.detail: Mkpịsị aka na-etolite nʼime afọ na a na-eme ha ka ọ bụrụ site nʼiche iche dị ntakịrị na ntinye ọbara na ọnọdụ, yabụ ọbụna ụmụnne yiri ibe ha nwere ihe atụ pụrụ iche; nke a mere mkpịsị aka ji baa uru nʼịmata mmadụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa 'yan'uwa masu kama a jiki ba su da yatsunsu iri ɗaya?
ha.detail: Yatsun hannu suna samuwa a cikin mahaifa kuma ƙananan bambance‑bambance a jini da matsayi suna tsara su, don haka ko da 'yan'uwan da suka yi kama suna da tsarin yatsu na musamman; don haka ana amfani da yatsa wajen ganewa.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les jumeaux identiques n'ont pas des empreintes digitales identiques.
fr.detail: Les empreintes se forment dans l'utérus et sont influencées par de minuscules différences de flux sanguin et de position, donc même les jumeaux identiques ont des motifs uniques; les empreintes sont donc utiles pour l'identification individuelle.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن التوأم المتماثل ليس له بصمات متطابقة؟
ar.detail: Fingerprints form in the womb and are shaped by tiny differences in blood flow and position, so even identical twins have unique patterns. Fingerprints are therefore useful for individual identification.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mapacha wa aina moja hawana alama za vidole zilizo sawa kabisa?
sw.detail: Alama za vidole huundwa tumboni na kuathiriwa na tofauti ndogo za mtiririko wa damu na mkao, kwa hivyo hata mapacha wa aina moja wana mifumo ya kipekee; alama za vidole hutumika kwa utambulisho wa mtu binafsi.

pt.fact: Sabias que gémeos idênticos não têm impressões digitais idênticas?
pt.detail: As impressões digitais formam‑se no útero e são moldadas por pequenas diferenças no fluxo sanguíneo e na posição, por isso mesmo gémeos idênticos têm padrões únicos; as impressões digitais servem para identificar indivíduos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los gemelos idénticos no tienen huellas digitales idénticas?
es.detail: Las huellas se forman en el útero y se moldean por pequeñas diferencias en el flujo sanguíneo y la posición, por eso incluso los gemelos idénticos tienen patrones únicos; por eso las huellas sirven para identificar personas.

subject: biology
picture: A close-up photo of a bright flower taken under natural light, with emphasis on petal texture and a bee-shaped silhouette nearby.

en.fact: Did you know bees can see ultraviolet patterns on flowers that humans cannot?
en.detail: Many flowers have UV 'nectar guides' that show up only in ultraviolet light, directing pollinators to nectar. Bees have UV-sensitive photoreceptors that help them find food efficiently.

pcm.fact: You sabi say bees fit see ultraviolet patterns on flowers we humans no fit see?
pcm.detail: Many flowers have UV 'nectar guides' that show up only in ultraviolet light, directing pollinators to nectar. Bees have UV-sensitive photoreceptors that help them find food efficiently.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn akàn (bees) lè rí àwò ìpínlẹ̀ ultraviolet lórí odó tí ènìyàn kò rí?
yo.detail: Many flowers have UV 'nectar guides' that show up only in ultraviolet light, directing pollinators to nectar. Bees have UV-sensitive photoreceptors that help them find food efficiently.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọrịa bi na ekike (bees) nwere ike ịhụ usoro ultraviolet na ifuru nke mmadụ enweghị ike ịhụ?
ig.detail: Ọtụtụ ifuru nwere “ụzọ nectar” na-apụta naanị na ìhè ultraviolet iji dọpụta ụmụnnụ anụmanụ na nsị; ọrịa bi na ekike nwere photoreceptors na-ahụ UV nke na-enyere ha ịchọta nri nke ọma.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa sauro‑ƙwari (bees) na iya ganin tsarin ultraviolet a furen da mutane ba su iya gani ba?
ha.detail: Yawancin furanni suna da 'nectar guides' a cikin UV waɗanda suke bayyana ne kawai a ƙarƙashin hasken ultraviolet, suna nuna hanyoyin zuwa nectar; sauro‑ƙwari suna da na'urorin hangen UV da ke taimaka musu gano abinci cikin sauri.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les abeilles voient des motifs ultraviolets sur les fleurs que les humains ne voient pas.
fr.detail: De nombreuses fleurs possèdent des « guides nectarifères » en UV visibles uniquement en lumière ultraviolette, qui dirigent les pollinisateurs vers le nectar; les abeilles ont des photorécepteurs sensibles à l'UV qui les aident à trouver de la nourriture efficacement.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن النحل يرى أنماطًا فوق بنفسجية على الأزهار لا يستطيع البشر رؤيتها؟
ar.detail: Many flowers have UV 'nectar guides' that show up only in ultraviolet light, directing pollinators to nectar. Bees have UV-sensitive photoreceptors that help them find food efficiently.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa nyuki wanaweza kuona mifumo ya ultraviolet kwenye maua ambayo binadamu hawaioni?
sw.detail: Maua mengi yana 'mielekeo ya nyasi' za UV zinazonekana tu kwa mwanga wa ultraviolet, zikimwongoza msafirishaji wa poleni kwa haraka; nyuki wana vipokezi vya nuru vya UV vinavyowasaidia kupata chakula kwa ufanisi.

pt.fact: Sabias que as abelhas conseguem ver padrões ultravioleta nas flores que os humanos não vêem?
pt.detail: Muitas flores têm 'guias de néctar' em luz ultravioleta que só aparecem nesse comprimento de onda, direcionando os polinizadores para o néctar; as abelhas têm fotorreceptores sensíveis ao UV que as ajudam a encontrar alimento com eficiência.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las abejas pueden ver patrones ultravioletas en las flores que los humanos no vemos?
es.detail: Muchas flores tienen 'guias de néctar' en UV que solo aparecen en luz ultravioleta, dirigiendo a los polinizadores hacia el néctar; las abejas tienen fotorreceptores sensibles al UV que les ayudan a encontrar alimento eficientemente.

subject: biology
picture: A detailed photo of a cluster of mushrooms growing on decaying wood, showing gills and textured caps.

en.fact: Did you know fungi are more closely related to animals than to plants?
en.detail: Genetic analyses show fungi and animals share a more recent common ancestor than either does with plants. Both groups use chitin (in different ways) and store energy similarly to show their relationship.

pcm.fact: You sabi say fungi dey more closely related to animals than to plants?
pcm.detail: Genetic analyses show fungi and animals share a more recent common ancestor than either does with plants. Both groups use chitin (in different ways) and store energy similarly to show their relationship.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé fungi sunmọ́ ẹranko ju wọn ṣe sunmọ́ ọ̀gbìn lọ ní ìbáṣepọ̀ ìmọ̀-ọ̀nà ìran?
yo.detail: Genetic analyses show fungi and animals share a more recent common ancestor than either does with plants. Both groups use chitin (in different ways) and store energy similarly to show their relationship.

ig.fact: Ị ma na fungi jikọrọ karịa ụmụ anụmanụ karịa osisi?
ig.detail: Nchọpụta ọgbọ gene gosipụtara na fungi na anụmanụ nwere nna nna jikọrọ nso karịa onye ọ bụla nʼime ha na osisi; ha abụọ na-eji chitin nʼụzọ dị iche ma na-echekwa ike nʼusoro yiri nke na-egosi njikọ ha.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa fungi sun fi kusanci da dabbobi fiye da tsirrai?
ha.detail: Binciken kwayoyin halitta ya nuna fungi da dabbobi suna da kakanni na ƙarshe mafi kusa fiye da kowanne da tsirrai; duka rukuni suna amfani da chitin (a hanyoyi daban‑daban) kuma suna adana makamashi da wasu kamanceceniya waɗanda ke nuna dangantaka.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les champignons sont plus proches parents des animaux que des plantes.
fr.detail: Les analyses génétiques montrent que champignons et animaux partagent un ancêtre commun plus récent que celui qu'ils partagent avec les plantes; les deux groupes utilisent la chitine (de façons différentes) et stockent l'énergie de manières similaires, ce qui confirme leur parenté.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الفطريات أقرب إلى الحيوانات منها إلى النباتات؟
ar.detail: Genetic analyses show fungi and animals share a more recent common ancestor than either does with plants. Both groups use chitin (in different ways) and store energy similarly to show their relationship.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa uyoga una uhusiano wa karibu zaidi na wanyama kuliko na mimea?
sw.detail: Uchambuzi wa vinasaba unaonyesha uyoga na wanyama wanashiriki babu wa karibu zaidi kuliko yeyote yao na mimea; makundi haya kwa pamoja hutumia kitini (kwa njia tofauti) na kuhifadhi nishati kwa namna zinazofanana kuonyesha uhusiano wao.

pt.fact: Sabias que os fungos estão mais próximos dos animais do que das plantas?
pt.detail: Análises genéticas mostram que fungos e animais partilham um ancestral comum mais recente entre si do que com as plantas; ambos usam quitina (de maneiras diferentes) e têm semelhanças na forma de armazenar energia.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los hongos están más emparentados con los animales que con las plantas?
es.detail: Los análisis genéticos muestran que hongos y animales comparten un ancestro común más reciente que cualquiera de los dos con las plantas; ambos grupos usan quitina (de formas distintas) y almacenan energía de maneras similares, lo que refleja su relación.

subject: biology
picture: A clear aquarium photo of a pale axolotl swimming, showing its external gills and limb structure.

en.fact: Did you know axolotls can regrow whole limbs and organs?
en.detail: Axolotls regenerate bones, muscles, nerves and skin perfectly after injury by reactivating growth programs in their cells. Scientists study them to learn how regeneration might work in humans.

pcm.fact: You sabi say axolotls fit regrow whole limbs and organs?
pcm.detail: Axolotls regenerate bones, muscles, nerves and skin perfectly after injury by reactivating growth programs in their cells. Scientists study them to learn how regeneration might work in humans.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé axolotl lè tún ẹ̀sẹ̀ àti àwọn ọmọ ara ṣọ́ọ̀ṣọ́ padà ní kikún?
yo.detail: Axolotls regenerate bones, muscles, nerves and skin perfectly after injury by reactivating growth programs in their cells. Scientists study them to learn how regeneration might work in humans.

ig.fact: Ị ma na axolotls nwere ike wughachi ọnwụ dum nke aka na organ niile?
ig.detail: Axolotls na-emeghachi egbugbere ọnụ, akwara, nerve na akpụkpọ ahụ zuru oke mgbe ha merụrụ ahụ site nʼịgbanye mmemme uto nʼime sel ha; ndị ọkà mmụta na-amụ ha ka ha mụta otú e si emepụta mmepụta ahụ nʼọnụ mmadụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa axolotl na iya sabunta gabobin hannu da sauran gabobi gaba ɗaya?
ha.detail: Axolotl suna sake gina ƙasusuwa, tsokoki, jijiyoyi da fata cikakke bayan rauni ta hanyar sake kunna shirye‑shirye na girma a cikin ƙwayoyinsu; masana suna nazarin su don fahimtar yadda sabuntawa zai iya aiki a cikin mutane.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les axolotls peuvent régénérer des membres et des organes entiers.
fr.detail: Les axolotls régénèrent os, muscles, nerfs et peau parfaitement après une blessure en réactivant des programmes de croissance dans leurs cellules; les scientifiques les étudient pour comprendre comment la régénération pourrait fonctionner chez l'humain.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأكسولوتل يستطيع إعادة نمو الأطراف والأعضاء بالكامل؟
ar.detail: Axolotls regenerate bones, muscles, nerves and skin perfectly after injury by reactivating growth programs in their cells. Scientists study them to learn how regeneration might work in humans.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa axolotl inaweza kukua upya mikono na viungo vyote?
sw.detail: Axolotl hurudisha mifupa, misuli, neva na ngozi kikamilifu baada ya jeraha kwa kuanzisha tena programu za ukuaji katika seli zao; wanasayansi hawaifundia ili kujifunza jinsi urekebishaji unaweza kufanikiwa kwa binadamu.

pt.fact: Sabias que os axolotes conseguem regenerar membros e órgãos inteiros?
pt.detail: Os axolotes regeneram ossos, músculos, nervos e pele perfeitamente após uma lesão ao reativarem programas de crescimento nas suas células; os cientistas estudam‑nos para perceber como a regeneração poderia funcionar em humanos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los ajolotes pueden regenerar extremidades y órganos enteros?
es.detail: Los ajolotes regeneran huesos, músculos, nervios y piel perfectamente tras una lesión activando programas de crecimiento en sus células; los científicos los estudian para aprender cómo podría funcionar la regeneración en humanos.

subject: biology
picture: A photo of a bowl of fiber-rich foods (beans, whole grains, fruits, vegetables) on a wooden table, shot from above.

en.fact: Did you know trillions of microbes live in your gut and help you digest food?
en.detail: Gut bacteria break down fibers and produce vitamins and molecules that affect digestion, immunity and even mood. A healthy microbiome supports digestion and protects against harmful microbes.

pcm.fact: You sabi say trillions of microbes dey live for your gut and dem dey help digest food?
pcm.detail: Gut bacteria break down fibers and produce vitamins and molecules that affect digestion, immunity and even mood. A healthy microbiome supports digestion and protects against harmful microbes.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé trilionu àwọn microbes ń gbé inú ìfun rẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì ràn é̩ lọ́wọ́ láti túun oúnjẹ?
yo.detail: Gut bacteria break down fibers and produce vitamins and molecules that affect digestion, immunity and even mood. A healthy microbiome supports digestion and protects against harmful microbes.

ig.fact: Ị ma na trilions nke microbes bi nʼime afọ gị ma na-enyere gị nwunye nri?
ig.detail: Bakterịa afọ na-eme ka fiber ghọọ ihe ndị a na-eri ma na-emepụta vitamin na ihe ndị metụtara afọ, nchebe na ọbụna ọnọdụ uche; microbiome dị mma na-akwado iyi nri ma na-echebe pụọ na microbes na-emerụ ahụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa tiriliyoyin kwayoyin halitta na zaune a hanjinka kuma suna taimaka maka narkar da abinci?
ha.detail: Bakteriyun hanji suna karya fiber kuma suna samar da bitamin da molécules da ke shafar narkewar abinci, garkuwar jiki har ma da yanayin zuciya; microbiome mai lafiya na tallafawa narkewa da kare jiki daga cututtuka.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Des trillions de microbes vivent dans votre intestin et vous aident à digérer les aliments.
fr.detail: Les bactéries intestinales décomposent les fibres et produisent des vitamines et des molécules qui influencent la digestion, l'immunité et même l'humeur; un microbiote sain soutient la digestion et protège contre les microbes nuisibles.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن تريليونات الميكروبات تعيش في أمعائك وتساعدك على هضم الطعام؟
ar.detail: Gut bacteria break down fibers and produce vitamins and molecules that affect digestion, immunity and even mood. A healthy microbiome supports digestion and protects against harmful microbes.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa trilioni za vimelea huishi kwenye tumbo lako na hukusaidia kunyonya chakula?
sw.detail: Bakteria za tumbo huvunja nyuzinyuzi na kutoa vitamini na molekuli ambazo huathiri mmeng'enyo, kinga na hata hisia; microbiome yenye afya inaunga mkono mmeng'enyo na kulinda dhidi ya vimelea hatari.

pt.fact: Sabias que trilhões de micróbios vivem no teu intestino e ajudam a digerir o alimento?
pt.detail: As bactérias intestinais degradam fibras e produzem vitaminas e moléculas que influenciam a digestão, o sistema imunitário e até o humor; um microbioma saudável apoia a digestão e protege contra micróbios nocivos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que billones de microbios viven en tu intestino y te ayudan a digerir los alimentos?
es.detail: Las bacterias intestinales descomponen fibras y producen vitaminas y moléculas que afectan la digestión, la inmunidad e incluso el estado de ánimo; un microbioma sano apoya la digestión y protege contra microbios dañinos.

subject: biology
picture: An underwater photograph of a shark swimming in clear blue ocean water, with no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know sharks have been swimming the oceans for over 400 million years?
en.detail: Fossil and genetic evidence show sharks existed well before dinosaurs and many modern groups are ancient. Their long history shows successful body designs and ecological roles.

pcm.fact: You sabi say sharks don dey swim for ocean for over 400 million years?
pcm.detail: Fossil and genetic evidence show sharks existed well before dinosaurs and many modern groups are ancient. Their long history shows successful body designs and ecological roles.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé shark ti ń ṣeré inú òkun fún ju 400 million ọdún lọ?
yo.detail: Fossil and genetic evidence show sharks existed well before dinosaurs and many modern groups are ancient. Their long history shows successful body designs and ecological roles.

ig.fact: Ị ma na sharks anwụla na oke osimiri ruo ihe karịrị 400,000,000 afọ?
ig.detail: Ihe akaebe fossil na nke gene na-egosi na sharks dị tupu dinosọ ma ọtụtụ ìgwè ha dị ugbu a bụ ihe ochie; akụkọ ha dị ogologo gosiri nhazi ahụ na ọrụ gburugburu ebe obibi ha nke gara nke ọma.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa sharks sun dade suna iyo a cikin tekuna fiye da shekaru 400 million?
ha.detail: Shaidar fossil da ta kwayar halitta tana nuna sharks sun wanzu kafin zamanin dinosaurs kuma rukuninsu na zamani da yawa tsofaffi ne; wannan dogon tarihin yana nuna nasarar tsarin jikinsu da rawar da suke takawa a muhalli.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Les requins peuplent les océans depuis plus de 400 millions d'années.
fr.detail: Les preuves fossiles et génétiques montrent que les requins existaient bien avant les dinosaures et que de nombreux groupes modernes sont anciens; leur longue histoire révèle des architectures corporelles et des rôles écologiques efficaces.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أسماك القرش تسبح في المحيطات منذ أكثر من 400 مليون سنة؟
ar.detail: Fossil and genetic evidence show sharks existed well before dinosaurs and many modern groups are ancient. Their long history shows successful body designs and ecological roles.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa papa wamekuwa wakienea katika bahari kwa zaidi ya 400,000,000 miaka?
sw.detail: Ushahidi wa fosili na vinasaba unaonyesha papa walikuwepo kabla ya dinosaur na makundi mengi ya kisasa ni ya zamani; historia yao ndefu inaonyesha muundo mzuri wa mwili na nafasi za kiikolojia zilizofanikiwa.

pt.fact: Sabias que os tubarões nadam nos oceanos há mais de 400 milhões de anos?
pt.detail: Evidência fóssil e genética mostra que os tubarões existiam muito antes dos dinossauros e muitos grupos modernos são antigos; a sua longa história reflete designs corporais e papéis ecológicos bem‑sucedidos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los tiburones llevan nadando por los océanos más de 400 millones de años?
es.detail: La evidencia fósil y genética muestra que los tiburones existieron mucho antes que los dinosaurios y que muchos grupos modernos son antiguos; su larga historia refleja diseños corporales y papeles ecológicos exitosos.

subject: human body
picture: Close-up photo of a clean cross-section of a long bone model showing spongy inner structure and compact outer layer, lit to show texture, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your bones are living tissues that constantly rebuild themselves?
en.detail: Bone cells break down old bone and build new bone in a process called remodeling. This keeps bones strong and helps heal fractures over time.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your bones na living tissue wey dey constantly rebuild themselves?
pcm.detail: Bone cells break down old bone and build new bone in a process called remodeling. This keeps bones strong and helps heal fractures over time.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé egungun rẹ̀ jẹ́ àtọ̀runwa tí ó ń tún ara rẹ̀ ṣe nígbà gbogbo?
yo.detail: Bone cells break down old bone and build new bone in a process called remodeling. This keeps bones strong and helps heal fractures over time.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọkpụkpụ gị bụ ndụụ na-emezu onwe ha mgbe niile?
ig.detail: Ụmụ sel ọkpụkpụ na-ebi ndụ iji kpochapụ ọkpụkpụ ochie na iwulite ọkpụkpụ ọhụrụ nʼusoro akpọrọ remodeling; nke a na-eme ka ọkpụkpụ sie ike ma na-enyere mmerụ ahụ gwọọ nʼoge.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ƙasusuwa naka su ne ƙwayoyin rayuwa da ke sabunta kansu kullum?
ha.detail: Kwayoyin ƙashi suna lalata tsofaffin ƙashi kuma suna gina sabbi a cikin tsari da ake kira remodeling; wannan yana kiyaye ƙasusuwa masu ƙarfi kuma yana taimakawa warkar da karyewar ƙashi a hankali.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Vos os sont des tissus vivants qui se reconstruisent constamment.
fr.detail: Les cellules osseuses détruisent l'os ancien et en construisent du nouveau dans un processus appelé remodelage; cela maintient les os solides et aide à la réparation des fractures au fil du temps.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن عظامك أنسجة حية تعيد بناء نفسها باستمرار؟
ar.detail: Bone cells break down old bone and build new bone in a process called remodeling. This keeps bones strong and helps heal fractures over time.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mifupa yako ni tishu hai zinazojijenga upya kila wakati?
sw.detail: Seli za mfupa zinavunja mfupa wa zamani na kujenga mpya katika mchakato unaoitwa remodeling; hii husaidia kuweka mifupa imara na kuponya kuvunjika kwa muda.

pt.fact: Sabias que os teus ossos são tecidos vivos que se renovam constantemente?
pt.detail: As células ósseas destroem o osso antigo e constroem novo osso num processo chamado remodelação; isto mantém os ossos fortes e ajuda a curar fraturas ao longo do tempo.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tus huesos son tejidos vivos que se reconstruyen constantemente?
es.detail: Las células óseas descomponen el hueso viejo y construyen hueso nuevo en un proceso llamado remodelación; esto mantiene los huesos fuertes y ayuda a curar fracturas con el tiempo.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a clear laboratory beaker with yellowish liquid and a small piece of corroded metal partly submerged, on a plain surface, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your stomach makes acid strong enough to break down metal objects in lab tests?
en.detail: Stomach acid (hydrochloric acid) has a very low pH that helps digest proteins and kill many microbes. Metal dissolving is slow and depends on the metal type, but the acid is chemically powerful.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your stomach dey make acid strong enough to break down some metal for lab tests?
pcm.detail: Stomach acid (hydrochloric acid) has a very low pH that helps digest proteins and kill many microbes. Metal dissolving is slow and depends on the metal type, but the acid is chemically powerful.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ikun rẹ̀ máa ń ṣe acid tó lágbára tó lè fọ irin ní ìdánwò yàrá ìmúlò?
yo.detail: Stomach acid (hydrochloric acid) has a very low pH that helps digest proteins and kill many microbes. Metal dissolving is slow and depends on the metal type, but the acid is chemically powerful.

ig.fact: Ị ma na afọ gị na-eme acid siri ike nke nwere ike ibibi ụfọdụ ihe metal na ule ụlọ ọrụ?
ig.detail: Acid afọ (hydrochloric acid) nwere pH nke dị ala nke ukwuu nke na-enyere iri protein na igbu ọtụtụ microbes; ịgbazite metal na-aga nwayọ ma dabere na ụdị metal, mana acid ahụ nwere ike kemịkal siri ike.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ciki yana ƙera acid mai ƙarfi har wanda zai iya rushe wasu ƙarfe a gwaje‑gwaje na dakin bincike?
ha.detail: Ruwan ciki (hydrochloric acid) yana da pH ƙasa sosai wanda ke taimakawa narkar da furotin da kashe yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta; narkar da ƙarfe yana tafiya a hankali kuma yana dogara da nau'in ƙarfen, amma acid ɗin na da ƙarfi a sinadari.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Votre estomac produit un acide assez fort pour attaquer des objets métalliques dans des tests de laboratoire.
fr.detail: L'acide gastrique (acide chlorhydrique) a un pH très bas qui aide à digérer les protéines et à tuer de nombreux microbes; la dissolution des métaux est lente et dépend du type de métal, mais l'acide est chimiquement puissant.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن معدتك تفرز حمضًا قويًا يمكن أن يذيب المعادن في الاختبارات المخبرية؟
ar.detail: Stomach acid (hydrochloric acid) has a very low pH that helps digest proteins and kill many microbes. Metal dissolving is slow and depends on the metal type, but the acid is chemically powerful.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa tumbo lako hutoa asidi yenye nguvu ya kutosha kuvunja vitu vya metali katika majaribio ya maabara?
sw.detail: Asidi ya tumbo (asidhi ya hidrokloriki) ina pH ya chini sana inayosaidia mmeng'enyo wa protini na kuuawa kwa vimelea wengi; kuoza metali ni polepole na kunategemea aina ya metali, lakini asidi ni kemikali yenye nguvu.

pt.fact: Sabias que o teu estômago produz ácido forte suficiente para dissolver objectos metálicos em testes de laboratório?
pt.detail: O ácido do estômago (ácido clorídrico) tem pH muito baixo e ajuda a digerir proteínas e a matar muitos microrganismos; a dissolução de metais é lenta e depende do tipo de metal, mas o ácido é quimicamente potente.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tu estómago produce ácido lo bastante fuerte como para disolver objetos metálicos en pruebas de laboratorio?
es.detail: El ácido gástrico (ácido clorhídrico) tiene un pH muy bajo que ayuda a digerir proteínas y matar muchos microbios; la disolución de metal es lenta y depende del tipo de metal, pero el ácido es químicamente potente.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a handful of calcium-rich dairy foods (milk, cheese, yogurt) arranged on a plain surface next to a small model of a bone, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your bones store calcium and release it to keep blood levels steady?
en.detail: Bones act as a reservoir for minerals like calcium and phosphate. Hormones signal bone cells to release or store calcium to maintain vital blood concentrations.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your bones dey store calcium and dem go release am to keep blood levels steady?
pcm.detail: Bones act as a reservoir for minerals like calcium and phosphate. Hormones signal bone cells to release or store calcium to maintain vital blood concentrations.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé egungun rẹ̀ ń tọju káĺsíọ̀mù tí ó sì tú u jáde láti mú kí ìsọ̀kan káĺsíọ̀mù nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ dàgbà?
yo.detail: Bones act as a reservoir for minerals like calcium and phosphate. Hormones signal bone cells to release or store calcium to maintain vital blood concentrations.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọkpụkpụ gị na-echekwa calcium ma na-ewepụ ya iji debe ọkwa calcium nʼọbara kwụsie ike?
ig.detail: Ọkpụkpụ na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ebe nchekwa maka mineral dịka calcium na phosphate; hormọn na-akpọ ụmụ sel ọkpụkpụ ka ha wepụta ma ọ bụ chekwaa calcium iji lekọta ọkwa ya dị mkpa nʼọbara.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ƙasusuwa suna ajiye calcium kuma suna sakin ta don kiyaye matakin jini?
ha.detail: Ƙasusuwa suna aiki a matsayin ma'ajiya na ma'adanai kamar calcium da phosphate; hormones na aika saƙonni ga ƙwayoyin ƙashi su saki ko ajiye calcium don kiyaye muhimman matakan jini.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Vos os stockent le calcium et le libèrent pour maintenir le taux sanguin stable.
fr.detail: Les os servent de réservoir pour des minéraux comme le calcium et le phosphate; des hormones signalent aux cellules osseuses de libérer ou de stocker le calcium pour maintenir des concentrations sanguines vitales.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن عظامك تخزن الكالسيوم وتفرزه للحفاظ على ثبات مستوياته في الدم؟
ar.detail: Bones act as a reservoir for minerals like calcium and phosphate. Hormones signal bone cells to release or store calcium to maintain vital blood concentrations.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa mifupa yako inahifadhi kalsiamu na kuiachilia ili kudumisha viwango vya damu?
sw.detail: Mifupa inafanya kazi kama hifadhi ya madini kama kalsiamu na fosfati; homoni zinamwagilia ama kuhifadhi au kuachilia kalsiamu ili kudumisha viwango muhimu kwenye damu.

pt.fact: Sabias que os teus ossos armazenam cálcio e libertam‑no para manter o nível no sangue estável?
pt.detail: Os ossos funcionam como reservatório de minerais como cálcio e fosfato; hormonas sinalizam às células ósseas para libertar ou guardar cálcio para manter concentrações vitais no sangue.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tus huesos almacenan calcio y lo liberan para mantener los niveles en la sangre estables?
es.detail: Los huesos actúan como depósito de minerales como calcio y fosfato; las hormonas señalan a las células óseas que liberen o almacenen calcio para mantener las concentraciones sanguíneas vitales.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a petri dish with cultured bacterial colonies in different colors under soft lab lighting, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your gut contains trillions of microbes that help digest food and train your immune system?
en.detail: The gut microbiome includes bacteria and other microbes that break down complex foods and produce helpful compounds. They also interact with immune cells to promote health.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your gut get trillions of microbes wey dey help digest food and teach your immune system?
pcm.detail: The gut microbiome includes bacteria and other microbes that break down complex foods and produce helpful compounds. They also interact with immune cells to promote health.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé inú rẹ̀ ní trilionu microbes tí wọ́n ràn é̩ lọ́wọ́ láti túun oúnjẹ àti láti kọ́ eto ajẹsára rẹ̀?
yo.detail: The gut microbiome includes bacteria and other microbes that break down complex foods and produce helpful compounds. They also interact with immune cells to promote health.

ig.fact: Ị ma na afọ gị nwere trillions nke microbes nke na-enyere imeghari nri ma na-azụ usoro mgbochi ọrịa gị?
ig.detail: Microbiome afọ gụnyere bakterịa na microbes ndị ọzọ nke na-ekewa nri siri ike ma na-emepụta ihe bara uru; ha na-emekọrịta ihe na sel mgbochi ọrịa iji kwalite ahụike.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa hanjinka na ɗauke da tiriliyoyin kwayoyin da ke taimaka narkar da abinci da horar da garkuwar jiki?
ha.detail: Microbiome na hanji ya haɗa da bacteria da sauran ƙwayoyin da ke karya abinci mai wahala kuma suna samar da abubuwa masu amfani; suna kuma mu'amala da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki don tallafawa lafiya.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Votre intestin contient des trillions de microbes qui aident à digérer les aliments et entraînent votre système immunitaire.
fr.detail: Le microbiote intestinal comprend des bactéries et d'autres microbes qui décomposent les aliments complexes et produisent des composés bénéfiques; ils interagissent aussi avec les cellules immunitaires pour promouvoir la santé.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أمعاءك تحتوي على تريليونات ميكروبات تساعد في هضم الطعام وتدريب جهازك المناعي؟
ar.detail: The gut microbiome includes bacteria and other microbes that break down complex foods and produce helpful compounds. They also interact with immune cells to promote health.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa matumbo yako yana trilioni za vimelea zinazosaidia kumeng'enya chakula na kumfundisha mfumo wako wa kinga?
sw.detail: Microbiome ya tumbo inajumuisha bakteria na vimelea vingine vinavyovunja vyakula ngumu na kuzalisha misombo yenye manufaa; pia huingiliana na seli za kinga ili kukuza afya.

pt.fact: Sabias que o teu intestino contém trilhões de micróbios que ajudam a digerir alimentos e a treinar o teu sistema imunitário?
pt.detail: O microbioma intestinal inclui bactérias e outros micróbios que degradam alimentos complexos e produzem compostos úteis; eles interagem com células imunitárias para promover a saúde.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tu intestino contiene billones de microbios que ayudan a digerir alimentos y educar tu sistema inmunitario?
es.detail: El microbioma intestinal incluye bacterias y otros microbios que descomponen alimentos complejos y producen compuestos útiles; también interactúan con las células inmunitarias para promover la salud.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a color gradient chart printed on paper lying flat, showing many subtle hues from red to violet, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your eyes can distinguish about 10 million different colours?
en.detail: Three types of cone cells respond to different wavelengths of light, and their combinations let the brain perceive millions of hues. This trichromatic vision varies slightly between people.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your eyes fit tell about 10 million different colours?
pcm.detail: Three types of cone cells respond to different wavelengths of light, and their combinations let the brain perceive millions of hues. This trichromatic vision varies slightly between people.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ojú rẹ̀ lè yàtọ̀sí nípa mímọ̀ tó to 10 million àwọn àwọ̀?
yo.detail: Three types of cone cells respond to different wavelengths of light, and their combinations let the brain perceive millions of hues. This trichromatic vision varies slightly between people.

ig.fact: Ị ma na anya gị nwere ike ịmata ihe dị ka 10,000,000 agba dị iche iche?
ig.detail: Ụdị cone atọ na-aza ụdị ìhè dị iche iche, na ngwakọta ha na-enyere ụbụrụ ahụ ịmata nde agba; echiche trichromatic a na-agbanwe ntakịrị nʼetiti mmadụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa idanunka na iya bambance kusan launuka miliyan 10?
ha.detail: Nau'i uku na ƙwayoyin cone suna amsawa ga tsawon igiyoyin haske daban‑daban, kuma haɗin su yana ba kwakwalwa damar hango miliyoyin launuka; wannan hangen trichromatic na iya bambanta ƙanƙanin haka tsakanin mutane.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous ? Vos yeux peuvent distinguer environ 10 millions de couleurs différentes.
fr.detail: Trois types de cônes répondent à différentes longueurs d'onde de la lumière, et leurs combinaisons permettent au cerveau de percevoir des millions de teintes; cette vision trichromatique varie légèrement selon les personnes.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن عيناك تميزان حوالي 10 مليون لون مختلف؟
ar.detail: Three types of cone cells respond to different wavelengths of light, and their combinations let the brain perceive millions of hues. This trichromatic vision varies slightly between people.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kuwa macho yako yanaweza kutofautisha takriban rangi 10,000,000 tofauti?
sw.detail: Aina tatu za seli za koni hujibu wavelengti tofauti za mwanga, na mchanganyiko wao huruhusu ubongo kuona mamilioni ya rangi; kuona trichromatic huenda ikatofautiana kidogo kati ya watu.

pt.fact: Sabias que os teus olhos conseguem distinguir cerca de 10 milhões de cores diferentes?
pt.detail: Três tipos de células cones respondem a diferentes comprimentos de onda de luz, e as combinações delas permitem ao cérebro perceber milhões de tonalidades; essa visão tricromática varia ligeiramente entre as pessoas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tus ojos pueden distinguir alrededor de 10 millones de colores diferentes?
es.detail: Tres tipos de células cónicas responden a distintas longitudes de onda de luz y sus combinaciones permiten al cerebro percibir millones de tonos; esta visión tricromática varía ligeramente entre las personas.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a model arm with visible forearm muscle tendons and a simple pulley demonstrating opposing action, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know muscles always pull and never push, so they work in opposing pairs?
en.detail: A muscle shortens to pull a bone one way while an opposing muscle pulls it back. This antagonistic pairing allows controlled movement and posture.

pcm.fact: You sabi say muscles dey always pull and no dey push, so dem dey work for opposite pairs?
pcm.detail: A muscle shortens to pull a bone one way while an opposing muscle pulls it back. This antagonistic pairing allows controlled movement and posture.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn iṣan máa fa nígbà gbogbo, wọ́n kò mọ́ ìtìpa, nígbà tí wọ́n sì ń ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ ní ìbápọ̀ alákòṣọ́?
yo.detail: Iṣan kan máa kúrò kí ó sì bójú tó egungun ní ìtòsọ́nà kan nígbà tí iṣan alatakò yóò fa a padà; ìbápọ̀ alatakò yìí ń jẹ́ kí ìrìn àti ìdúró ṣàkóso.

ig.fact: Ị ma na akwara na-adọta mgbe niile ma na ha anaghị ebugharị, ya mere ha na-arụ ọrụ n'ụgbọ abụọ na-asọ mpi?
ig.detail: Akwara na-ebelata iji dọta ọkpụkpụ otu ụzọ ebe akwa na-asọ mpi na-dọta ya azụ; nhazi antagonistic a na-enye mgbagharị na ịdị n'otu nke ahụ.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa tsokoki koyaushe suna jan abu ba sa tura shi, don haka suna aiki a cikin ma'aurata masu hamayya?
ha.detail: Tsoka na taƙaita don ta ja ƙashi ta wata hanya yayin da tsoka mai hamayya ke ja ta koma baya; wannan haɗin antagonistic yana ba da damar motsi mai sarrafawa da tsayuwa.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les muscles tirent toujours et ne poussent jamais, ils fonctionnent donc par paires antagonistes ?
fr.detail: Un muscle se raccourcit pour tirer un os d’un côté pendant que le muscle opposé le ramène, ce qui permet un mouvement contrôlé et le maintien de la posture.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن العضلات دائماً تسحب ولا تدفع، لذا تعمل في أزواج متعاكسة؟
ar.detail: تنقص العضلة طولها لتسحب عظمة باتجاه واحد بينما تسحب العضلة المعارضة العظمة إلى الخلف، وهذا التزاوج المضاد يسمح بالحركة والسيطرة على الوضعية.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua misuli huvuta tu na haziwezi kusukuma, kwa hivyo hufanya kazi kwa jozi zilizo kinyume?
sw.detail: A muscle shortens to pull a bone one way while an opposing muscle pulls it back. This antagonistic pairing allows controlled movement and posture.

pt.fact: Sabias que os músculos só puxam e nunca empurram, por isso trabalham em pares opostos?
pt.detail: Um músculo encurta para puxar um osso numa direção enquanto o músculo antagonista o puxa de volta; esse emparelhamento antagonista permite movimento controlado e manutenção da postura.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los músculos solo tiran y nunca empujan, por eso trabajan en pares opuestos?
es.detail: Un músculo se acorta para tirar de un hueso en una dirección mientras otro músculo opuesto lo devuelve, permitiendo movimiento y postura controlados.

subject: human body
picture: Scientific photo of clear plastic models of a DNA double helix on a dark background, showing the twisted ladder structure, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know your DNA, if stretched out from one cell, would be about two metres long?
en.detail: DNA is an extremely long molecule packaged tightly into the cell nucleus by winding around proteins. In human cells, that packed DNA still measures about two metres when fully extended.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your DNA, if you stretch am from one cell, e go be about two metres long?
pcm.detail: DNA is an extremely long molecule packaged tightly into the cell nucleus by winding around proteins. In human cells, that packed DNA still measures about two metres when fully extended.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé DNA rẹ, tí a bá fa kúrò ní sẹ́lù kan, ó lè jẹ́ 2 metres pípẹ́?
yo.detail: DNA jẹ́ molíkúlù púpọ̀ gan-an tí a fi pa mọ́ra sínú ìpínkìkì sẹ́lù nípa yíyí sílẹ̀ lórí amíró; ní sẹ́lù ènìyàn, DNA tí a ti pa mọ́ra náà tún lè jẹ́ 2 metres nígbà tí a bá fa a gígùn.

ig.fact: Ị ma na DNA gị, ma ọ bụrụ na a dọpụ ya site na otu sel, ga-adị ihe dị ka 2 mita n'ogologo?
ig.detail: DNA bụ nnukwu molekul nke ejiri wụnye nke ọma n'ime isi sel site n'ịkpụgharị ya gburugburu protein; n'ime sel mmadụ, ọbụlagodi mgbe e kpuchiri ya ọ ka bụ 2 mita mgbe a dọpụ ya kpamkpam.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa DNA ɗinka, idan an shimfiɗa shi daga ƙwayar halitta ɗaya, zai yi tsawon kusan 2 metres?
ha.detail: DNA guntu ne mai tsawo sosai da ake nannade shi sosai a cikin ƙwayar ƙwayar ta hanyar nannade shi a kusa da furotin; a cikin ƙwayoyin ɗan adam, wannan DNA da aka nade har yanzu yana auna kusan 2 metres idan an shimfiɗa shi.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que votre ADN, étiré à partir d'une seule cellule, mesurerait environ 2 mètres ?
fr.detail: L'ADN est une molécule très longue emballée dans le noyau en s'enroulant autour de protéines ; dans une cellule humaine, cet ADN compacté mesurerait encore environ 2 mètres une fois totalement étendu.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الحمض النووي في خلية واحدة إذا مدَّ بالكامل يكون طوله حوالي 2 متر؟
ar.detail: الحمض النووي جزيء طويل جداً يُلف بإحكام داخل نواة الخلية حول بروتينات، وفي الخلايا البشرية يبلغ طوله حوالي 2 متر عند تمدده بالكامل.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua DNA yako, ikiwa ingeenea kutoka kwa seli moja, ingekuwa about two metres long?
sw.detail: DNA is an extremely long molecule packaged tightly into the cell nucleus by winding around proteins. In human cells, that packed DNA still measures about two metres when fully extended.

pt.fact: Sabias que o teu ADN, se esticado numa única célula, teria cerca de 2 metros de comprimento?
pt.detail: O ADN é uma molécula extremamente longa enrolada em torno de proteínas para caber no núcleo; nas células humanas, esse ADN embalado ainda mede cerca de 2 metros quando totalmente estendido.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tu ADN, si se extendiera desde una sola célula, mediría unos 2 metros de largo?
es.detail: El ADN es una molécula muy larga empaquetada en el núcleo celular enrollándose alrededor de proteínas; en las células humanas ese ADN empaquetado mide unos 2 metros cuando se extiende.

subject: human body
picture: Macro photo of a tongue model showing papillae texture under bright lighting, no people or identifiable features.

en.fact: Did you know taste buds regenerate about every two weeks?
en.detail: Taste receptor cells have a short lifespan and are replaced regularly from stem cells in the tongue. This renewal helps maintain the sense of taste despite wear and damage.

pcm.fact: You sabi say taste buds dey regenerate about every two weeks?
pcm.detail: Taste receptor cells have a short lifespan and are replaced regularly from stem cells in the tongue. This renewal helps maintain the sense of taste despite wear and damage.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn amí-oyùn adún (taste buds) máa tún ara wọn ṣe ní gbogbo ìgbà tó jẹ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì kan?
yo.detail: Àwọn sẹ́lù olùgbọ́n adùn ní ìgbésí ayé kúkúrú, wọ́n sì ń jẹ́ ayípadà látinú sẹ́lù ìbímọ̀ lórí ahọn; ìmúlòyípadà yìí ń jẹ́ kó ṣetán láti pa ìmọ̀ràn adùn mọ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na mkpụrụ ụtọ na-emewokwa ọhụrụ ihe dịka izu 2 ọ bụla?
ig.detail: Ụdị sel nnata uto nwere ndụ dị mkpụmkpụ ma a na-agbanwe ha mgbe niile site na sel isi n'ọnụ; mmegharị a na-enyere aka idobe mmetụta ụtọ n'agbanyeghị mmebi.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa ƙwayoyin ɗanɗano suna sabunta kansu kusan kowane makonni biyu?
ha.detail: Ƙwayoyin masu karɓar ɗanɗano suna da ɗan gajeren rayuwa kuma ana maye gurbin su akai-akai daga ƙwayoyin tushen a harshen; wannan sabuntawa tana taimakawa kiyaye jin ɗanɗano duk da lalacewa.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les papilles gustatives se régénèrent environ toutes les deux semaines ?
fr.detail: Les cellules réceptrices du goût ont une durée de vie courte et sont régulièrement remplacées à partir de cellules souches de la langue, ce qui préserve le sens du goût malgré l'usure.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن براعم التذوق تتجدد كل حوالي أسبوعين؟
ar.detail: خلايا مستقبلات التذوق لها عمر قصير ويتم استبدالها بانتظام من خلايا جذعية في اللسان، وهذا التجدد يحافظ على حاسة التذوق رغم التلف والتآكل.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua ladha za kinywa zinajengwa upya takriban every two weeks?
sw.detail: Taste receptor cells have a short lifespan and are replaced regularly from stem cells in the tongue. This renewal helps maintain the sense of taste despite wear and damage.

pt.fact: Sabias que as papilas gustativas se regeneram aproximadamente a cada 2 semanas?
pt.detail: As células receptoras do paladar têm uma vida curta e são substituídas regularmente por células‑básicas na língua; essa renovação ajuda a manter o sentido do gosto apesar do desgaste e de danos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las papilas gustativas se regeneran aproximadamente cada dos semanas?
es.detail: Las células receptoras del gusto tienen una vida corta y se reemplazan regularmente a partir de células madre en la lengua, lo que mantiene el sentido del gusto pese al desgaste.

subject: human body
picture: Photo of a sunlit window with visible dust motes floating in a beam of light, captured on a plain background, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know you breathe in tiny particles and microbes every time you inhale?
en.detail: Air carries dust, pollen, droplets and microbes that enter the respiratory tract with each breath. The nose and lungs have filters and immune defenses to trap and remove many of them.

pcm.fact: You sabi say every time you breathe you dey inhale tiny particles and microbes?
pcm.detail: Air carries dust, pollen, droplets and microbes that enter the respiratory tract with each breath. The nose and lungs have filters and immune defenses to trap and remove many of them.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìgbàkúgbà tí o bá mí inú, o ń mí àwọn patíkúlù kékeré àti ọlọ́jẹ̀-àyíká (microbes)?
yo.detail: Afẹ́fẹ́ kún fún eruku, pollen, ìdọ̀tí omi àti ọlọ́jẹ̀-àyíká tí ń wọ ilé-ese mímú afẹ́fẹ́ nígbà mí-in; imu àti ẹdọfóró ní àbáwọlé àti agbára ajẹsára láti mu púpọ̀ nínú wọn dákẹ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ị na-eku ume obere mkpụrụ na microbes mgbe niile mgbe ị na-eku ume?
ig.detail: Ihu igwe na-eburu uzuzu, pollen, ntụ oyi na microbes nke na-abanye n'ahụ ịmị ume na ume; imi na iku ume nwere ihe nzacha na nchebe mgbochi iji jide ma wepu ọtụtụ n'ime ha.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa kuna shakar ƙananan ƙwayoyi da ƙwayoyin cuta a kowane numfashi?
ha.detail: Iska na ɗauke da ƙura, pollen, ƙananan drops, da ƙwayoyin cuta waɗanda ke shiga hanyoyin numfashi tare da kowanne numfashi; hanci da huhu suna da matattara da kariyar garkuwar jiki don kama da cire yawancinsu.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que vous inhalez de minuscules particules et microbes à chaque inspiration ?
fr.detail: L'air transporte poussières, pollens, gouttelettes et micro-organismes qui pénètrent dans les voies respiratoires à chaque respiration, et le nez et les poumons disposent de filtres et de défenses immunitaires pour les piéger et les éliminer.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنك تستنشق جزيئات وميكروبات صغيرة مع كل شهيق؟
ar.detail: الهواء يحمل غباراً وحبوب لقاح ورذاذاً وميكروبات تدخل الجهاز التنفسي مع كل نفس، والأنف والرئتان لهما مرشحات ودفاعات مناعية لاحتجاز وإزالة كثير منها.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua unaingiza chembe ndogo na vimelea kila unapopumua?
sw.detail: Air carries dust, pollen, droplets and microbes that enter the respiratory tract with each breath. The nose and lungs have filters and immune defenses to trap and remove many of them.

pt.fact: Sabias que inalas partículas e micróbios minúsculos a cada respiração?
pt.detail: O ar transporta pó, pólen, gotículas e microrganismos que entram nas vias respiratórias a cada inspiração; o nariz e os pulmões têm filtros e defesas imunitárias que capturam e removem muitos desses elementos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que inhalas partículas diminutas y microbios cada vez que respiras?
es.detail: El aire transporta polvo, polen, gotículas y microbios que entran al aparato respiratorio con cada inhalación; la nariz y los pulmones tienen filtros y defensas inmunitarias que atrapan y eliminan muchos de ellos.

subject: human body
picture: A close-up photo of a clean surgical tray showing a removed human liver lobe specimen (no people), lit for clinical clarity.

en.fact: Did you know your liver can regrow from as little as about one quarter of its tissue?
en.detail: The liver's cells can divide and grow back after injury or surgery. Even if 70–75% is removed, the remaining tissue can expand to restore function over weeks to months.

pcm.fact: You sabi say your liver fit regrow from as little as about one quarter of im tissue?
pcm.detail: The liver's cells can divide and grow back after injury or surgery. Even if 70–75% is removed, the remaining tissue can expand to restore function over weeks to months.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìrẹsì (liver) rẹ lè tún dàgbà láti bí ìkẹta kan (about one quarter) ti ìràn rẹ?
yo.detail: Àwọn sẹ́lù ìrẹsì lè pín-ń-pín kí wọ́n sì dagbasoke lẹ́yìn ìfarapa tàbí iṣẹ́ abẹ́; bí 70–75% ṣe bá yọ, apá tó kù lè gùn-ún padà kí ó sì tún pada sí iṣẹ́ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ àti oṣù.

ig.fact: Ị ma na akànụ gị nwere ike ibudata azụ site na naanị ihe dịka 1/4 nke anụ ya?
ig.detail: Sel akànụ nwere ike ịkekọrịta ma too azụ mgbe mmerụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ mwepụ; ọbụna ma e weere 70–75% pụọ, anụ fọdụrụ nwere ike ịgbasa iji weghachite ọrụ n'ime izu na ọnwa.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa hanta na iya sabunta kanta daga kashi kusan 25% na nama?
ha.detail: Kwayoyin hanta na iya raba kansu su girma bayan rauni ko tiyata; ko da an cire 70–75% za a iya faɗaɗa ragowar nama don dawo da aikin a cikin makonni zuwa watanni.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que votre foie peut repousser à partir d'environ un quart de son tissu ?
fr.detail: Les cellules du foie peuvent se diviser et croître après une blessure ou une opération : même si 70–75 % est retiré, le tissu restant peut s'agrandir pour restaurer la fonction en quelques semaines à quelques mois.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الكبد يمكن أن ينمو من ما يعادل حوالي ربع نسيجه؟
ar.detail: خلايا الكبد قادرة على الانقسام والنمو بعد الإصابة أو الجراحة، وحتى لو أُزيل 70–75% يمكن للنسيج المتبقي أن يتوسع ويستعيد الوظيفة خلال أسابيع إلى أشهر.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua ini lako linaweza kukua tena kutoka kwa kiasi cha karibu about one quarter ya tishu yake?
sw.detail: The liver's cells can divide and grow back after injury or surgery. Even if 70–75% is removed, the remaining tissue can expand to restore function over weeks to months.

pt.fact: Sabias que o teu fígado pode regenerar‑se a partir de apenas cerca de um quarto do seu tecido?
pt.detail: As células do fígado podem dividir‑se e crescer novamente após lesão ou cirurgia; mesmo que 70–75% seja removido, o tecido restante pode expandir para restaurar a função ao longo de semanas a meses.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tu hígado puede volver a crecer a partir de apenas cerca de una cuarta parte de su tejido?
es.detail: Las células hepáticas pueden dividirse y regenerar tejido tras una lesión o cirugía; incluso si se extirpan 70–75%, el tejido restante puede expandirse para restaurar la función en semanas o meses.

subject: animals
picture: A close-up photo of a common octopus (Octopus vulgaris) extending an arm over the seabed, showing texture and color; no people or text visible.

en.fact: Did you know octopuses have three hearts and blue blood?
en.detail: Two hearts pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the body. Their blood is blue because it uses copper-rich hemocyanin to carry oxygen in cold, low-oxygen water.

pcm.fact: You sabi say octopuses get three hearts and dem blood dey blue?
pcm.detail: Two hearts pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the body. Their blood is blue because it uses copper-rich hemocyanin to carry oxygen in cold, low-oxygen water.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé òkùnrin òwúrẹ̀ (octopus) ní ọkàn mẹ́ta àti pé ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn jẹ́ búlúù?
yo.detail: Mẹ́jì nínú àwọn ọkàn ń títẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ lọ sí ẹ̀fọ̀n, ọkàn kan sì ń títẹ sí ara; ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn jẹ́ búlúù nítorí pé ó lò hemocyanin tí ó ní kúpà (copper) láti gbe ọkúnrin-omi (oxygen) ní omi tí ó tútù tàbí tí kì í ní ọ̀pọ̀ afẹ́fẹ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na octopus nwere obi atọ na ọbara anụnụ anụnụ?
ig.detail: Obi abụọ na-emejuputa ọbara na nzacha, otu na-emejuputa ahụ; ọbara ha dị anụnụ anụnụ n’ihi na ha na-eji hemocyanin juputara na iko mee njem oxygen n’ime mmiri oyi nke nwere obere oxygen.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa octopus yana da zuciya uku kuma jinsa fari ne na shuɗi?
ha.detail: Zuciya biyu na turawa jini zuwa guiwoyi yayin da ɗaya ke turawa zuwa jiki; jinin su shuɗi ne saboda suna amfani da hemocyanin mai ɗauke da ƙarfe na tagulla don ɗaukar oxygen a cikin ruwan sanyi mai ƙarancin oxygen.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les poulpes ont trois cœurs et du sang bleu ?
fr.detail: Deux cœurs envoient le sang vers les branchies et un cœur l'envoie vers le reste du corps ; leur sang est bleu parce qu'il utilise l'hémocyanine riche en cuivre pour transporter l'oxygène dans des eaux froides et pauvres en oxygène.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأخطبوطات لها ثلاث قلوب ودم أزرق؟
ar.detail: قلبان يضخان الدم إلى الخياشيم وقلب واحد يضخ إلى الجسم، ودمها أزرق لأن ناقل الأكسجين فيه يحتوي على النحاس (الهيموسيانين) وهو مفيد في المياه الباردة ومنخفضة الأكسجين.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua churao wana mioyo mitatu na damu ya blue?
sw.detail: Two hearts pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the body. Their blood is blue because it uses copper-rich hemocyanin to carry oxygen in cold, low-oxygen water.

pt.fact: Sabias que os polvos têm três corações e sangue azul?
pt.detail: Dois corações bombeiam sangue para as brânquias e um bombeia para o corpo; o sangue é azul porque usa hemocianina rica em cobre para transportar oxigénio em águas frias e com pouco oxigénio.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los pulpos tienen tres corazones y sangre azul?
es.detail: Dos corazones bombean sangre a las branquias y uno al resto del cuerpo; su sangre es azul porque usa hemocianina rica en cobre para transportar oxígeno en aguas frías y con poco oxígeno.

subject: animals
picture: A clear underwater photo of a male seahorse (with slightly swollen brood pouch) clinging to seagrass; no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know male seahorses get pregnant and carry the babies?
en.detail: Female seahorses deposit eggs into a pouch on the male, where he fertilises and nurtures them. The male supplies oxygen and nutrients until he releases fully formed young.

pcm.fact: You sabi say na the male seahorses dey pregnant and carry the babies?
pcm.detail: Female seahorses deposit eggs into a pouch on the male, where he fertilises and nurtures them. The male supplies oxygen and nutrients until he releases fully formed young.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn màgà-màgà omi (seahorses) tíkára wọn ló ń lóyún, ìyẹn ni pé akọ ni ó mú ọmọ?
yo.detail: Obìnrin máa fi ẹyin rẹ sí apò kan lórí akọ, níbẹ̀ ni akọ yóò máa fọ́nrán, yọyọ́, tí ó sì ń pèsè ìmúra omi-ara àti onjẹ títí tí ó fi tu àwọn ọmọ tí wọ́n ti pé sílẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ndị nwoke seahorse na-enwe ime ma na-ebu ụmụaka?
ig.detail: Nwanyị seahorse na-etinye akpụkpọ anụ n'ime akpa dị n'aka nwoke, ebe ọ na-etinye na-edozi ma na-elekọta ha; nwoke na-enye oxygen na nri ruo mgbe o wepụtara ụmụaka zuru oke.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa maza na seahorse suna daukar ciki kuma su riƙe jariran?
ha.detail: Matan seahorse na ajiye ƙwayoyin a cikin aljihu a jikin namiji, inda shi ke yin tayin da reno su; namijin yana ba da oxygen da abinci har sai ya saki ƙananan kamar manya.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que ce sont les hippocampes mâles qui sont enceintes et portent les bébés ?
fr.detail: La femelle dépose ses œufs dans une poche du mâle, où il les féconde et les nourrit, fournissant oxygène et nutriments jusqu'à la naissance des jeunes complètement formés.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن ذكور فرس البحر تحبل وتحمل الصغار؟
ar.detail: تبيض إناث فرس البحر بيضها في جيب على ذكر فرس البحر حيث يقوم بتلقيحها وتغذيتها، ويزوّد الذكر الأكسجين والمواد المغذية حتى يطلق صغاراً مكتملة التكوين.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua faradhi wa baharini (seahorses) wa kiume hushinda mimba na kubeba watoto?
sw.detail: Female seahorses deposit eggs into a pouch on the male, where he fertilises and nurtures them. The male supplies oxygen and nutrients until he releases fully formed young.

pt.fact: Sabias que os cavalos‑marinhos machos ficam grávidos e carregam os filhotes?
pt.detail: As fêmeas depositam os ovos numa bolsa no macho, onde ele os fertiliza e os alimenta; o macho fornece oxigénio e nutrientes até libertar juvenis completamente formados.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los caballitos de mar machos se embarazan y llevan a las crías?
es.detail: Las hembras depositan los huevos en una bolsa del macho, donde él los fertiliza y los cuida, suministrando oxígeno y nutrientes hasta liberar crías ya formadas.

subject: animals
picture: A macro photo inside a beehive showing a worker bee performing the waggle dance on honeycomb with other bees nearby; no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know bees 'dance' to tell nestmates where food is?
en.detail: Foraging honeybees perform the waggle dance that encodes distance and direction relative to the sun. Other bees use different cues, but the waggle dance is a well-studied example of symbolic animal communication.

pcm.fact: You sabi say bees dey 'dance' to tell their nestmates where food dey?
pcm.detail: Foraging honeybees perform the waggle dance that encodes distance and direction relative to the sun. Other bees use different cues, but the waggle dance is a well-studied example of symbolic animal communication.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn oyin ń “jó” láti sọ ìtọ́na onjẹ fún àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ wọn?
yo.detail: Àwọn oyin oníṣe ìwákiri máa ṣe ìjo waggle tí ó kó ìjìnlẹ̀ àti ìtọ́na ní ìbáṣepọ̀ sí ìpo oòrùn; àwọn oyin míì lè lo àfihàn míì, ṣùgbọ́n ìjo waggle ni apẹẹrẹ tí wọ́n ti kọ́ jùlọ nípa ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ àmi nínú ẹranko.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ànyị na enyi ga-eji ịgba egwu gwa ibe ha ebe nri dị?
ig.detail: Ụmụbee na-aga ịchọ nri na-eme “waggle dance” nke na-enye ọdịiche anya na ogologo site na anyanwụ; bee ndị ọzọ na-eji mgbaàmà dị iche, ma egwu waggle bụ ihe ọmụmụ nke ọma banyere nkwukọrịta anụmanụ nwere akara.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa ƙanƙara suna "rawa" don gaya wa sauran ƙawaye inda abinci yake?
ha.detail: Zuma masu neman abinci suna yin rawar waggle wadda ke ƙunshe da nesa da shugabanci dangane da rana; sauran ƙananan bees na amfani da wasu alamomi, amma rawar waggle misali ne mai kyau na sadarwa alama a cikin dabbobi.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les abeilles « dansent » pour indiquer aux congénères où se trouvent des sources de nourriture ?
fr.detail: Les butineuses effectuent la danse en rond ou la danse frétillante qui encode la distance et la direction par rapport au soleil ; c'est un exemple bien étudié de communication symbolique animale.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن النحل "يرقص" ليخبر رفيقاته بمكان الغذاء؟
ar.detail: تنفذ النحلات الراجِحات رقصة تهتز بها لتنقل معلومات عن المسافة والاتجاه بالنسبة للشمس، وهذه الرقصة مثال معروف على التواصل الرمزي لدى الحيوانات.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua nyuki 'hucheza' kuonyesha wenzake mahali chakula kilipo?
sw.detail: Foraging honeybees perform the waggle dance that encodes distance and direction relative to the sun. Other bees use different cues, but the waggle dance is a well-studied example of symbolic animal communication.

pt.fact: Sabias que as abelhas 'dançam' para indicar aos congéneres onde há alimento?
pt.detail: As abelhas‑forrageiras realizam a dança do meneio que codifica distância e direção em relação ao sol; outras abelhas usam sinais diferentes, mas a dança do meneio é um exemplo bem estudado de comunicação simbólica animal.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las abejas «bailan» para indicar a sus compañeras dónde hay comida?
es.detail: Las abejas melíferas forrajeras realizan la danza del meneo que codifica distancia y dirección respecto al sol; otras abejas usan distintos indicios, pero la danza es un ejemplo bien estudiado de comunicación simbólica animal.

subject: animals
picture: A woodland scene with a wood frog partially camouflaged on leaf litter in late winter; no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know some frogs can freeze solid and survive thawing?
en.detail: Species like the wood frog stop breathing and freeze most body water, while tissues are protected by sugars acting like antifreeze. They thaw and resume normal activity in spring.

pcm.fact: You sabi say some frogs fit freeze solid and still survive when dem thaw?
pcm.detail: Species like the wood frog stop breathing and freeze most body water, while tissues are protected by sugars acting like antifreeze. They thaw and resume normal activity in spring.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé díẹ̀ lára àwọn frog lè tú di dì tí wọ́n sì lè yọ̀ sílẹ̀ láì kú?
yo.detail: Àwọn irú bí wood frog máa dá ìmí wọn dúró kí wọ́n sì tú gbogbo omi ara pọ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá tú, nígbà tí suga kan ń bójú tó ara gẹ́gẹ́ bí antifreeze; wọn máa tú padà kí wọ́n sì tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́ ààyè bí wọ́n ṣe ń rí ìrìnnà.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụfọdụ frog nwere ike ịkụchi kpamkpam ma bie ndụ mgbe ha gbazịrị?
ig.detail: Ụdị dị ka wood frog kwụsịrị iku ume ma ha na-akpụ ọtụtụ mmiri ahụ, ebe tissues na-echebe site na shuga ndị na-arụ ọrụ dịka antifreeze; ha na-eku ume ọzọ ma laa ọrụ n'oge opupu ihe ubi.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa wasu frogs na iya daskare gaba ɗaya su rayu bayan sun jika?
ha.detail: Nau'in kamar wood frog suna dakatar da numfashi kuma suna daskare mafi yawan ruwan jiki, yayin da nama ke samun kariya ta suga kamar antifreeze; sukan jika su koma aikin al'ada a lokacin bazara.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que certaines grenouilles peuvent geler complètement et survivre à la décongélation ?
fr.detail: Des espèces comme la grenouille des bois arrêtent de respirer et gèlent la majeure partie de leur eau corporelle, tandis que des sucres protègent les tissus comme un antifreeze ; elles dégèlent et reprennent une activité normale au printemps.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن بعض الضفادع يمكن أن تتجمد تماماً وتنجو عند الذوبان؟
ar.detail: أنواع مثل ضفدع الخشب توقف التنفس ويتجمد معظم ماء جسمها، وتُحمي السكريات أنسجتها كنوع من مضاد التجمد، فتذوب الضفادع مع الربيع وتستأنف نشاطها الطبيعي.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua baadhi ya chura wanaweza kuganda kabisa na kuishi wakati wa kuyeyuka?
sw.detail: Species like the wood frog stop breathing and freeze most body water, while tissues are protected by sugars acting like antifreeze. They thaw and resume normal activity in spring.

pt.fact: Sabias que algumas rãs podem congelar‑se completamente e sobreviver ao descongelamento?
pt.detail: Espécies como a rã‑da‑madeira deixam de respirar e congelam a maior parte da água corporal, enquanto os tecidos são protegidos por açúcares que atuam como anticongelante; depois descongelam e retomam a actividade normal na Primavera.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que algunas ranas pueden congelarse por completo y sobrevivir al descongelamiento?
es.detail: Especies como la rana de los bosques dejan de respirar y congelan la mayor parte del agua corporal, mientras azúcares protegen los tejidos como anticongelantes; luego se descongelan y reanudan la actividad en primavera.

subject: animals
picture: A nocturnal photo of a bat in mid-flight against a twilight sky, wings spread wide; no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know bats are the only mammals that fly actively?
en.detail: Bats have wings formed from a membrane stretched over elongated fingers, enabling powered flight. Other mammals glide but do not sustain true flapping flight.

pcm.fact: You sabi say bats na only mammals wey fit fly properly?
pcm.detail: Bats have wings formed from a membrane stretched over elongated fingers, enabling powered flight. Other mammals glide but do not sustain true flapping flight.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé bats ni àwọn mammal péré tí ń fò ní fífi ìyára pọ̀?
yo.detail: Báts ní ìrókò ìka gigun tí a fi aṣọ aṣọ kan kó sílẹ̀ lórí rẹ̀ láti dàwọ̀n-ọwọ́, èyí sì fún wọn ní agbára fò; àwọn mammal míì lè lù-fọ́ (glide) ṣùgbọ́n kò fò pẹ̀lú ìmúlòlùú gẹ́gẹ́ bí bats.

ig.fact: Ị ma na bats bụ naanị mamal ndị na-efe efe nke nwere ike ịgba ọsọ?
ig.detail: Bats nwere ite aka nke siri ike n’elu mkpụrụ aka ogologo, nke na-enye ha ohere ịgba efe; ndị ọzọ na anụmanụ na-apịa ma ọ bụghị na ha anaghị enwe flapping flight n'ezie.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa bats su ne kawai mammals da ke yin tashi mai rai?
ha.detail: Bats suna da fikafikai da aka ƙirƙira daga membrane da aka shimfiɗa kan dogayen yatsu, wanda ke ba su damar tashi mai ƙarfi; sauran mammals na iya yin gungurawa amma ba sa riƙe gaske da tashi na flapping.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les chauves‑souris sont les seuls mammifères à voler activement ?
fr.detail: Les chauves‑souris ont des ailes formées d'une membrane tendue sur des doigts allongés qui leur permettent un vol battu et propulsé ; d'autres mammifères planent mais ne pratiquent pas le vol actif.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الخفافيش هي الثدييات الوحيدة التي تطير بنشاط؟
ar.detail: للخفافيش أجنحة تتكوّن من غشاء مشدود فوق أصابع مطوّلة مما يمكّنها من طيران فعلي بالطيران المجدَّف، بينما الثدييات الأخرى تنزلق فقط ولا تقوم بطيران مجدَّف مستمر.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua popo ndizo pekee kati ya mamalia zinazoruka kwa nguvu halisi?
sw.detail: Bats have wings formed from a membrane stretched over elongated fingers, enabling powered flight. Other mammals glide but do not sustain true flapping flight.

pt.fact: Sabias que os morcegos são os únicos mamíferos que voam activamente?
pt.detail: Os morcegos têm asas formadas por uma membrana esticada sobre dedos alongados, permitindo voo propulsado; outros mamíferos planam mas não sustentam um voo batido verdadeiro.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los murciélagos son los únicos mamíferos que vuelan activamente?
es.detail: Tienen alas formadas por una membrana estirada sobre dedos alargados que permiten el vuelo propulsado; otros mamíferos planean pero no baten las alas para volar sostenidamente.

subject: animals
picture: An elephant approaching a large mirror-like surface at a sanctuary, trunk raised; no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know elephants can recognise themselves in mirrors?
en.detail: Asian elephants have passed mirror self-recognition tests, showing behaviors that indicate self-awareness like touching marks on their bodies. This is rare in animals and linked to complex social intelligence.

pcm.fact: You sabi say elephants fit recognise themselves for mirror?
pcm.detail: Asian elephants have passed mirror self-recognition tests, showing behaviors that indicate self-awareness like touching marks on their bodies. This is rare in animals and linked to complex social intelligence.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé erin lè mọ ara wọn ní àfihàn digi?
yo.detail: Erin Asia ti kọja ìdánwò ìmúlòye ara ní digi, wọ́n sì hàn ìwà bí fífi ọwọ́ kan mọ ami lórí ara wọn—ìwà tí ó tọ́ka sí ìmúlòye ara; èyí kúkú wọ́pọ̀ díẹ̀ nínú ẹranko tí ó sì jọmọ ìmọ̀-ọgbọ́n àjọṣepọ̀ tó ní ilodisi.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ndị elefant nwere ike ịmata onwe ha n'ìhè iko?
ig.detail: Elephant Asia gosipụtara omume nwalere iche onwe n'elu ìhè iko, gụnyere imetụ akara dị n’ahụ ha, nke na-egosi mmụta onwe; nke a bụ ihe na-agaghị ekwe omume na anụmanụ ole na ole ma na-ejikọta ọnụ ọgụgụ ọgụgụ mmekọrịta dị mgbagwoju anya.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa giwaye na iya gane kansu a madubi?
ha.detail: Giwayen Asian sun wuce gwajin gane kai a madubi, suna nuna halaye da ke nuni da sanin kai kamar taɓa alama a jikinsu; wannan abu ne mai wuya a cikin dabbobi kuma ana danganta shi da hankali na zamantakewa mai rikitarwa.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les éléphants peuvent se reconnaître dans un miroir ?
fr.detail: Les éléphants d'Asie ont réussi des tests de reconnaissance de soi au miroir, montrant des comportements tels que toucher des marques sur leur corps, ce qui indique une forme d'auto‑conscience liée à une intelligence sociale complexe.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأفيال تستطيع التعرف على نفسها في المرايا؟
ar.detail: نجحت أفيال آسيوية في اختبارات التعرف الذاتي بالمرايا، وأظهرت سلوكيات تشير إلى الوعي الذاتي مثل لمس علامات على أجسامها، وهذا نادر ويرتبط بذكاء اجتماعي معقَّد.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua tembo wanaweza kujitambua mbele ya kioo?
sw.detail: Asian elephants have passed mirror self-recognition tests, showing behaviors that indicate self-awareness like touching marks on their bodies. This is rare in animals and linked to complex social intelligence.

pt.fact: Sabias que os elefantes conseguem reconhecer‑se num espelho?
pt.detail: Elefantes asiáticos passaram em testes de autorreconhecimento diante de espelhos, exibindo comportamentos que indicam autoconsciência, como tocar marcas no próprio corpo; isto é raro entre animais e associa‑se a inteligência social complexa.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los elefantes pueden reconocerse en un espejo?
es.detail: Elefantes asiáticos han pasado pruebas de autorreconocimiento en espejo, mostrando comportamientos como tocar marcas en su cuerpo, lo que se asocia a una inteligencia social compleja.

subject: animals
picture: A clear underwater photo of a platypus foraging along a riverbed, bill close to the substrate; no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know the platypus detects prey using electric fields?
