en.detail: Platypuses close their eyes and use electroreceptors in their bills to sense tiny muscle and nerve impulses from prey. This electroreception is rare in mammals but ideal for hunting underwater.

pcm.fact: You sabi say platypus dey detect prey with electric fields?
pcm.detail: Platypuses close their eyes and use electroreceptors in their bills to sense tiny muscle and nerve impulses from prey. This electroreception is rare in mammals but ideal for hunting underwater.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé platypus ń mọ ìjẹun nípa mímú àfiyèsílẹ̀ ina-ọkọ (electric fields)?
yo.detail: Platypus máa sun oju tí ó sì lò àwọn olùgbọ́ ina-elekitiriki nínú imu rẹ̀ láti rí ìkìlọ̀-ara (muscle) àti ìmúlẹ̀-ara (nerve) kékeré láti ọdọ ẹran tí wọ́n ń wá; ìmúlò ina-elekitiriki náà ṣòro lára àwọn mammal ṣùgbọ́n o yẹra fún ìwé-ìmúni inú omi.

ig.fact: Ị ma na platypus na-achọpụta anụ ahụ site n'iji ubi eletrik?
ig.detail: Platypus na-emechi anya ha ma na-eji electroreceptors n'ọnụ ha iji chọpụta obere mkpali akwara na eriri site n'azụ; electroreception a na-adịghị ahụkarị n'etiti mamal ma dị mma maka ịkụ azụ n'oké mmiri.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa platypus na gano abinci ta amfani da filayen lantarki?
ha.detail: Platypus suna rufe idanuwansu suna amfani da electroreceptors a bakin su don jin ƙananan motsin tsoka da jijiyoyi daga abinci; wannan ikon electroreception abin ƙyama ne a cikin mammals amma ya dace da farauta a cikin ruwa.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que l'ornithorynque détecte ses proies grâce aux champs électriques ?
fr.detail: L'ornithorynque ferme les yeux et utilise des électrorécepteurs dans son bec pour sentir les minuscules impulsions musculaires et nerveuses des proies, une capacité rare chez les mammifères et idéale pour chasser sous l'eau.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن خلد الماء يكتشف فريسته باستخدام الحقول الكهربائية؟
ar.detail: يغمض خلد الماء عينيه ويستخدم مستقبلات كهربائية في منقاره لالتقاط نبضات عضلية وعصبية صغيرة من الفريسة، وهذه القدرة نادرة بين الثدييات ومناسبة للصيد تحت الماء.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua platypus inapata mawindi ya wadudu kwa kutumia nyanja za umeme?
sw.detail: Platypuses close their eyes and use electroreceptors in their bills to sense tiny muscle and nerve impulses from prey. This electroreception is rare in mammals but ideal for hunting underwater.

pt.fact: Sabias que o ornitorrinco detecta presas através de campos eléctricos?
pt.detail: O ornitorrinco fecha os olhos e usa electroreceptores no bico para sentir minúsculos impulsos musculares e nervosos das presas; esta electrorecepção é rara em mamíferos, mas ideal para caçar debaixo de água.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el ornitorrinco detecta presas mediante campos eléctricos?
es.detail: Cierran los ojos y usan electrorreceptores en el pico para sentir pequeños impulsos musculares y nerviosos de las presas; esta electrorecepción es rara en mamíferos y muy útil para cazar bajo el agua.

subject: animals
picture: A cheetah in mid-sprint across savanna grass, body extended in full stride; no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know cheetahs accelerate faster than most cars from 0 to 60 km/h?
en.detail: Cheetahs reach high speeds quickly thanks to flexible spines, long limbs, and powerful muscles. Their sprinting focuses on short bursts for hunting, not long-distance running.

pcm.fact: You sabi say cheetahs dey accelerate faster than most cars from 0 to 60 km/h?
pcm.detail: Cheetahs reach high speeds quickly thanks to flexible spines, long limbs, and powerful muscles. Their sprinting focuses on short bursts for hunting, not long-distance running.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé cheetah máa yára ju ọ̀pọ̀ ọkọ̀ lọ láti 0 sí 60 km/h?
yo.detail: Cheetah máa de iyára ga pẹ̀lú kíákíá nítorí iha ẹyọrùn wọn tí ó rọ, ìka ẹsẹ̀ gígùn àti iṣan alágbára; ìpèsè ìsẹ́ wọn jẹ́ fún ìgbésẹ̀ kékeré nígbà ìwàhálà, kì í ṣe fún ìrìn àjò pípẹ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na cheetah na-akawanye ọsọ ngwa ngwa karịa ọtụtụ ụgbọ ala site na 0 ruo 60 km/h?
ig.detail: Cheetahs na-erute ọsọ ngwa ngwa n'ihi spain ngwa ngwa, ụkwụ ogologo na akwara ndị dị ike; ọsọ ha bụ maka mgbapụ mkpụmkpụ maka ịkụ nzuzu, ọ bụghị ịgba ọsọ ogologo.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa cheetahs suna ƙara sauri fiye da yawancin motoci daga 0 zuwa 60 km/h?
ha.detail: Cheetahs na samun sauri sosai godiya ga lanƙwasa ƙashin baya, dogayen ƙafafu, da ƙwayoyin tsoka masu ƙarfi; gudun su na mai da hankali ne kan gajerun fashe-fashe don farauta, ba gudu mai nisa ba.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que le guépard accélère plus vite que la plupart des voitures de 0 à 60 km/h ?
fr.detail: Les guépards atteignent rapidement de grandes vitesses grâce à leur colonne vertébrale flexible, leurs membres longs et leurs muscles puissants, mais ils sprinteront sur de courtes distances pour chasser, pas sur de longues distances.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الفهود تتسارع أسرع من معظم السيارات من 0 إلى 60 كم/س؟
ar.detail: تصل الفهود لسرعات عالية بسرعة بفضل عمود فقري مرن وأطراف طويلة وعضلات قوية، وتركز اندفاعاتها على فترات قصيرة للصيد وليس للجري لمسافات طويلة.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua chita zinaweza kuongezeka kwa kasi zaidi kuliko magari mengi kutoka 0 hadi 60 km/h?
sw.detail: Cheetahs reach high speeds quickly thanks to flexible spines, long limbs, and powerful muscles. Their sprinting focuses on short bursts for hunting, not long-distance running.

pt.fact: Sabias que as chitas aceleram mais depressa do que a maioria dos carros de 0 a 60 km/h?
pt.detail: As chitas atingem altas velocidades rapidamente graças a colunas vertebrais flexíveis, membros longos e músculos potentes; as suas corridas focam‑se em rajadas curtas para caçar, não em percursos longos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los guepardos aceleran más rápido que la mayoría de los coches de 0 a 60 km/h?
es.detail: Alcanzan grandes velocidades muy rápidamente gracias a una columna vertebral flexible, extremidades largas y músculos potentes; su carrera se centra en ráfagas cortas para cazar, no en distancias largas.

subject: animals
picture: A close-up of a starfish on a rocky tide pool showing one regrowing arm; no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know starfish can regrow whole arms and sometimes entire bodies?
en.detail: Many starfish regenerate lost arms by growing new tissue from remaining parts; in some species a detached arm can grow into a complete individual. Regeneration involves specialised cells and slow tissue organization.

pcm.fact: You sabi say starfish fit regrow whole arms and sometimes whole bodies?
pcm.detail: Many starfish regenerate lost arms by growing new tissue from remaining parts; in some species a detached arm can grow into a complete individual. Regeneration involves specialised cells and slow tissue organization.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìràwọ̀ omi (starfish) lè tún dagbasoke gbogbo ọwọ́ wọn padà, nígbà míì sì tún lè dàgbà sí ara tuntun patapata?
yo.detail: Ọ̀pọ̀ ìran starfish lè tún abẹrẹ tí wọ́n pàdánù ṣe nípa àwọn sẹ́lù amọ̀ràn tó ń dagbasoke láti apá tó kù; ní àwọn ẹ̀yà kan, apá tí ó yà kúrò lè dà sí ara tuntun; ìmúlòyípadà yìí ní ìfarapa pẹ̀lú ìtọ́nisọ́nà sẹ́lù pẹ̀lú.

ig.fact: Ị ma na starfish nwere ike imeghari ogwe niile ma mgbe ụfọdụ ọbụna ahụ dum?
ig.detail: Ọtụtụ starfish na-eto ogwe efu site n'iwulite anụ ọhụrụ site na akụkụ fọdụrụ; n'ọtụtụ species, ogwe kewara nwere ike too bụrụ onye zuru ezu; regeneration na-achọ sel pụrụ iche na nhazi dị nwayọ.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa starfish na iya sabunta hannuwa gaba ɗaya kuma wani lokaci dukan jikinsu?
ha.detail: Yawancin starfish na mayar da ɓarnar hannu da haɓaka sabon nama daga sassan da suka rage; a wasu nau'ikan, hannu da ya yanyanka na iya girma ya zama cikakken mutum; gyarawa na buƙatar ƙwayoyin musamman da tsari mai jinkiri.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les étoiles de mer peuvent régénérer complètement des bras et parfois tout leur corps ?
fr.detail: Beaucoup d'étoiles de mer régénèrent des bras perdus en faisant croître de nouveaux tissus à partir des parties restantes ; chez certaines espèces, un bras détaché peut se développer en un individu entier, processus impliquant des cellules spécialisées et une réorganisation lente des tissus.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن نجوم البحر تستطيع أن تجدد أذرعها كلها وأحياناً أجسامها بالكامل؟
ar.detail: تجدد العديد من نجوم البحر الأذرع المفقودة بنمو نسيج جديد من الأجزاء المتبقية؛ وفي بعض الأنواع يمكن للذراع المقطوعة أن تنمو لتصبح فرداً كاملاً، ويشمل التجدد خلايا متخصِّصة وتنظيم نسيجي بطيء.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua nyota za baharini zinaweza kukua tena mkono mzima na wakati mwingine miili yote?
sw.detail: Many starfish regenerate lost arms by growing new tissue from remaining parts; in some species a detached arm can grow into a complete individual. Regeneration involves specialised cells and slow tissue organization.

pt.fact: Sabias que as estrelas‑do‑mar regeneram braços inteiros e, por vezes, corpos inteiros?
pt.detail: Muitas estrelas‑do‑mar regeneram braços perdidos ao crescer novo tecido a partir das partes remanescentes; em algumas espécies um braço separado pode desenvolver‑se num indivíduo completo, processo que envolve células especializadas e organização lenta dos tecidos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las estrellas de mar pueden regenerar brazos enteros y a veces cuerpos completos?
es.detail: Muchas especies regeneran brazos perdidos creciendo nuevo tejido desde las partes restantes; en algunas, un brazo desprendido puede convertirse en un individuo completo mediante células especializadas y lenta reorganización tisular.

subject: animals
picture: A photograph of a small bird (e.g., sparrow or crow) perched on a branch, showing feathers and beak clearly; no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know birds are living dinosaurs?
en.detail: Birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs; they share feathers, hollow bones, and many skeletal features. Modern birds are considered the only surviving dinosaur lineage.

pcm.fact: You sabi say birds na living dinosaurs?
pcm.detail: Birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs; they share feathers, hollow bones, and many skeletal features. Modern birds are considered the only surviving dinosaur lineage.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹyẹ jẹ́ àwọn dinosaur alààyè?
yo.detail: Àwọn ẹyẹ ti yọ láti inú àwọn theropod dinosaur; wọ́n ní irun-ìfurujẹ́ (feathers), egungun àgbàra tó ní iho, àti ọ̀pọ̀ àfihàn oníṣe egungun; àwọn ẹyẹ ìgbà yìí ni a kà sí ẹ̀ka dinosaur kan ṣoṣo tí ó ṣi wà.

ig.fact: Ị ma na nnụnụ bụ dinosaurs bi ndụ?
ig.detail: Nnụnụ mepụtara site na theropod dinosaurs; ha nwere feathers, ọkpụkpụ oghere na ọtụtụ atụmatụ skeletal; nnụnụ oge a ka a na-ahụ dị ka naanị ahịrị ndụ dinosaurs fọdụrụ.

ha.fact: Ko kun sani cewa tsuntsaye dabbobin dinosaur ne na rayuwa?
ha.detail: Tsuntsaye sun samo asali ne daga theropod dinosaurs; suna da yawa abubuwa iri ɗaya kamar feathers, ƙasusuwa masu ramuka, da fasali na ƙashin; ana ɗaukar tsuntsaye a matsayin ragowar layin dinosaur da ya tsira.

fr.fact: Saviez-vous que les oiseaux sont des dinosaures vivants ?
fr.detail: Les oiseaux ont évolué à partir de dinosaures théropodes : ils partagent des plumes, des os creux et de nombreuses caractéristiques squelettiques, et les oiseaux modernes sont considérés comme la seule lignée de dinosaures encore vivante.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الطيور هي ديناصورات حية؟
ar.detail: الطيور تطورت من ديناصورات ثيروبودية؛ تشترك مع الديناصورات في الريش والعظام المجوفة والعديد من السمات الهيكلية، وتُعتبر الطيور اليوم السلالة الوحيدة الباقية من الديناصورات.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua ndege ni dinosaur wanaoishi?
sw.detail: Birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs; they share feathers, hollow bones, and many skeletal features. Modern birds are considered the only surviving dinosaur lineage.

pt.fact: Sabias que as aves são dinossauros vivos?
pt.detail: As aves evoluíram a partir de dinossauros terópodes; partilham penas, ossos ocos e muitas características esqueléticas, sendo as aves modernas consideradas a única linha sobrevivente de dinossauros.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las aves son dinosaurios vivos?
es.detail: Las aves evolucionaron de dinosaurios terópodos y comparten plumas, huesos huecos y rasgos esqueléticos; las aves modernas son la única línea de dinosaurios que sigue viva.

subject: chemistry
picture: A clear photo of a lake in winter showing floating ice sheets on dark liquid water, with no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know ice floats because solid water is less dense than liquid water?
en.detail: When water freezes its molecules form a crystalline shape with more open space. That makes ice occupy more volume and float on liquid water.

pcm.fact: You sabi say ice dey float because solid water less dense pass liquid water?
pcm.detail: When water freezes its molecules form a crystalline shape with more open space. That makes ice occupy more volume and float on liquid water.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé yinyin ń yo lórí omi nitori omi tí ó di líle kéré síi ní díẹ̀jú ju omi olómi lọ?
yo.detail: Nígbà tí omi bá di, àwọn molíkúlù rẹ̀ kó aṣọ ìṣàkóso kristali tí ó ní ìsípọ̀ ààyè síi, èyí sì fà á kí yinyin gba ìwọn pọ̀ síi tí kò sì rọ̀ mọ́ omi olómi.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ice na-efe elu n’elu mmiri n’ihi na mmiri siri ike nwere njupụta dị ntakịrị karịa mmiri dị mmiri?
ig.detail: Mgbe mmiri na-apụta ice, mkpụrụ ndụ ya na-etolite usoro kristal nwere oghere karịa, nke na-eme ka ice were nnukwu ntụpọ (volume) ma jiri ya mee ka ọ dị elu n’elu mmiri mmiri.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa kankara tana iyo saboda ruwan daskarewa ya fi ruwa a halin ruwa ƙasa a wajen yawa?
ha.detail: Idan ruwa ya daskare ƙwayoyin sa suna yin tsarin kristal wanda ke da ƙarin sarari a ciki; hakan yana sa kankara ta ɗauki ƙarin ƙima na ƙara girma kuma ta iya iyo a saman ruwa.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que la glace flotte parce que l'eau solide est moins dense que l'eau liquide ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الثلج يطفو لأن الماء الصلب أقل كثافة من الماء السائل؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba barafu hupaa kwa sababu maji ya kioo yana msongamano mdogo kuliko maji ya kioevu?
sw.detail: Maji yanapoganda molekuli zake huunda muundo wa kioo wenye nafasi zaidi wazi; hiyo inafanya barafu kuchukua kiasi kikubwa cha ujazo na kuvimba juu ya maji ya kioevu.

pt.fact: Sabias que o gelo flutua porque a água sólida é menos densa do que a água líquida?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el hielo flota porque el agua sólida es menos densa que el agua líquida?
es.detail: Cuando el agua se congela sus moléculas forman una estructura cristalina con más espacio abierto, por eso el hielo ocupa más volumen y flota sobre el agua líquida.

subject: chemistry
picture: Close-up of a lemon with a copper coin and a zinc-coated nail inserted, connected by thin wires, on a plain surface.

en.fact: Did you know tiny amounts of acid can power a simple battery from a lemon or potato?
en.detail: Acidic juice or electrolytes let two different metals transfer electrons, creating a small electric current. This is how classic classroom 'fruit batteries' work.

pcm.fact: You sabi say small amount of acid fit power simple battery from lemon or potato?
pcm.detail: Acidic juice or electrolytes let two different metals transfer electrons, creating a small electric current. This is how classic classroom 'fruit batteries' work.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé díẹ̀ lára àcidì lè fúnni ní agbára bí bátiri tó rọrùn láti lẹ́mọnì tàbí iṣu?
yo.detail: Òjò àcidì tàbí àwọn electrolytes ń jẹ́ kí irin méjì tó yàtọ̀ lè rán àwọn elektronù láti ṣe ìbòyà, tí yóò sì dá ìsọdọtun ina kékeré sílẹ̀; ìyẹn ni bí “bátiri ẹ̀fọ́” tó wà lélẹ́kọ̀ọ̀ ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na obere ihe acidic nwere ike ịnye obere batrị site na lemon ma ọ bụ ọrịa (potato)?
ig.detail: Mmiri acidic ma ọ bụ electrolyte na-enyere metal abụọ dị iche iche iji nyefe elektrọn, na-emepụta obere ọkụ eletrik; nke a bụ otu batrị ‘mkpụrụ osisi’ n’ụlọ akwụkwọ si arụ ọrụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ƙananan ƙwayoyi na acid na iya samar da ƙaramin batir daga lemun tsami ko dankali?
ha.detail: Ruwan 'ya'yan acidic ko electrolytes yana ba damar ƙaramin canja wurin lantarki tsakanin ƙarfe biyu daban, yana ƙirƙirar ƙaramin ƙarfin lantarki; wannan shi ne koyarwar 'fruit battery' a aji.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que de petites quantités d'acide peuvent alimenter une pile simple à partir d'un citron ou d'une pomme de terre ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن كميات صغيرة من الحمض يمكن أن تولد بطارية بسيطة من ليمون أو بطاطا؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba kiasi kidogo cha asidi kinaweza kutoa umeme katika betri rahisi ya limao au viazi?
sw.detail: Juisi yenye asidi au elektrolaiti inaruhusu metali mbili tofauti kuhamisha elektroni, hivyo kuzalisha mzunguko mdogo wa umeme; hii ndiyo jinsi 'betri za tunda' za darasani zinavyofanya kazi.

pt.fact: Sabias que pequenas quantidades de ácido podem alimentar uma pilha simples feita de limão ou batata?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que pequeñas cantidades de ácido pueden alimentar una batería simple hecha con un limón o una patata?
es.detail: El jugo ácido o los electrolitos permiten que dos metales distintos transfieran electrones, creando una pequeña corriente eléctrica; así funcionan las clásicas 'pilas de fruta' de clase.

subject: chemistry
picture: Microscopic-style photo of a powdered catalyst material (granules) in a laboratory dish, with no labels or people.

en.fact: Did you know catalysts speed reactions but are not used up themselves?
en.detail: A catalyst provides an easier route for reactants to form products so reactions happen faster. After the reaction it is unchanged and can act again.

pcm.fact: You sabi say catalysts dey speed reactions but dem no dey finish?
pcm.detail: A catalyst provides an easier route for reactants to form products so reactions happen faster. After the reaction it is unchanged and can act again.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé katalísì ń yara ìbáṣepọ̀ ṣùgbọ́n kò máa parí nipò ara rẹ̀?
yo.detail: Katalísì ń pèsè ipa-ọna tí kò nira tó fún àwọn olùdarí láti di àwọn ọja, nítorí náà ìbáṣepọ̀ máa ṣẹlẹ̀ yarayara; lẹ́yìn ìbáṣepọ̀ ó wà bí ó ti wà, ó sì lè tún ṣiṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kansi.

ig.fact: Ị ma na katalyst na-eme ka mgbaàmà (reactions) gbaa ọsọ ma ha onwe ha anaghị akwụsị agwụ?
ig.detail: Katalyst na-enye ụzọ dị mfe maka ndị na-emeghari (reactants) iji mepụta ngwaahịa, si otú a na-eme ka mmeghachi omume mee ngwa; mgbe mmeghachi ahụ gasịrị, katalyst adịghị agbanwe ma o nwere ike iji ya ọzọ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ƙwayar mai hanzarta sinadarai (catalyst) tana hanzarta amsoshi amma ba ta ƙarewa kanta ba?
ha.detail: Catalyst yana ba da hanya mai sauƙi ga masu amsa su haɗu su samar da samfurori don haka amsoshi su faru da sauri; bayan amsawar catalyst ba a canza shi kuma zai iya aiki nan gaba.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que les catalyseurs accélèrent les réactions sans être consommés eux-mêmes ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن المحفزات تسرّع التفاعلات لكنها لا تُستهلك؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba kichocheo huharakisha mmenyuko lakini hakitumiki kabisa?
sw.detail: Kichocheo hutoa njia rahisi kwa reaktanti kuunda bidhaa, hivyo mmenyuko unafanyika haraka zaidi; baada ya mmenyuko kichocheo hubaki kuwa kisibadilike na kinaweza kutumika tena.

pt.fact: Sabias que os catalisadores aceleram as reações químicas sem se consumirem?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los catalizadores aceleran reacciones pero no se consumen?
es.detail: Un catalizador ofrece una ruta más fácil para que los reactivos formen productos y así las reacciones ocurren más rápido; después de la reacción queda sin cambiar y puede actuar de nuevo.

subject: chemistry
picture: Ground-level photo of a road surface with scattered salt granules melting nearby slushy ice, no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know common salt melts ice by lowering its freezing point?
en.detail: Salt dissolves in the thin water layer on ice and disrupts ice formation, so the freezing point drops and ice melts at lower temperatures. That's why road salt helps clear snow.

pcm.fact: You sabi say common salt dey melt ice because e lower the freezing point?
pcm.detail: Salt dissolves in the thin water layer on ice and disrupts ice formation, so the freezing point drops and ice melts at lower temperatures. That's why road salt helps clear snow.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé iyọ̀ àgbéléwọ̀n máa ń tú yinyin nítorí pé ó dín ìtọ́jú didi rẹ̀ kù?
yo.detail: Iyọ̀ ń tú sínú omi seré tó wà lórí yinyin tí ó sì dá ìmúlò ìmọ́lẹ̀ yinyin dúró, nítorí náà ìtọ́jú didi kù ní iye, yinyin sì máa yo ní iwọn otutu tó kéré jù; ìdí nìyẹn tí wọ́n fi máa fi iyọ̀ kó òrùlé òjò.

ig.fact: Ị ma na nnu nkịtị na-eme ka ice gbanwee site n’ịbelata isi ntụpọ oyi (freezing point)?
ig.detail: Nnu na-agbaze n’ọkwa mmiri dị ntakịrị n’elu ice ma na-emerụ usoro ịmepụta ice, nke na-eme ka isi ntụpọ oyi daa ma ice tụọ n’okpomọkụ ndị dị ala; nke a bụ ihe mere a ji etinye nnu n’ụzọ iji dozie snow.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa gishiri yana narkar da kankara ta hanyar rage matsakaicin maki daskararre?
ha.detail: Gishiri yana narkewa cikin siririn ruwan dake kan kankara yana tsoma tsarin samar da kankara, don haka maki daskararre ya sauka kuma kankara na narke a yanayin zafi mafi ƙasƙanci; shi ya sa ake amfani da gishiri a kan hanyoyi.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que le sel fait fondre la glace en abaissant son point de congélation ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن ملح الطعام يذيب الجليد عن طريق خفض نقطة تجمده؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba chumvi ya kawaida huletsa theluji kwa kushusha kiwango chake cha kufungika?
sw.detail: Chumvi inayoyeyuka ndani ya safu nyembamba ya maji juu ya barafu husababisha kuharibika kwa kuundwa kwa barafu, hivyo joto la kufungika hupungua na barafu kuyeyuka kwa joto la chini; ndiyo maana chumvi ya barabara husaidia kuondoa theluji.

pt.fact: Sabias que o sal faz o gelo derreter ao baixar o seu ponto de congelação?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la sal común derrite el hielo al bajar su punto de congelación?
es.detail: La sal se disuelve en la fina capa de agua sobre el hielo y dificulta la formación de hielo, por lo que el punto de congelación baja y el hielo se funde a temperaturas más bajas; por eso se usa sal para limpiar las carreteras.

subject: chemistry
picture: Macro photo of lots of soap bubbles on a dish with shimmering surfaces, no labels or people.

en.fact: Did you know soap traps greasy dirt by forming tiny spheres called micelles?
en.detail: Soap molecules have a water-loving head and an oil-loving tail, so they surround oily particles with tails inward to form micelles. The micelles stay suspended and wash away with water.

pcm.fact: You sabi say soap dey trap greasy dirt by forming tiny spheres wey dem dey call micelles?
pcm.detail: Soap molecules have a water-loving head and an oil-loving tail, so they surround oily particles with tails inward to form micelles. The micelles stay suspended and wash away with water.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ọ̀ṣùpọ̀ ń gba ìmúra ọra mọ́ra nípa fọ́ọ̀mù pẹ̀lú àwọn kíkèké tí a ń pè ní micelles?
yo.detail: Àwọn ọmọlẹ́yìn ọ̀ṣọ̀pẹ̀ ní orí tí ó fẹ́ omi àti ìpitàn tí ó fẹ́ ọra, bé̩ẹ̀ ni wọ́n yí awọn patikulu ọra ká pẹ̀lú ìpitàn wọn sí inú, nígbà tí ìkékè micelle náà sì wà ní ìfarapa omi kí wọ́n sì wẹ̀ jáde.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ncha (soap) na-ejide unyi mmanụ site n’ịmepụta obere mkpụrụ (micelles) dị ka bọlụ?
ig.detail: Molekul ncha nwere isi na-achọ mmiri na ntị na-achọ mmanụ, yabụ ha na-ebute ihe mmanụ n’etiti ntị ha, mepụta micelles; micelles ndị a na-anọgide na mmiri ma a saa ya apụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa sabulu yana haɗa datti mai ta hanyar ƙirƙirar ƙananan ƙwayoyi da ake kira micelles?
ha.detail: Tsarin sabulu yana da kai mai son ruwa da wutsiya mai son mai, don haka suna kewaye ɓangarorin mai tare da wutsiyoyi a ciki suna ƙirƙirar micelles; micelles ɗin suna zaune a cikin ruwa kuma ana wanke su.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que le savon emprisonne la saleté grasse en formant de petites sphères appelées micelles ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الصابون يحاصر الأوساخ الدهنية بتشكيل كُرات صغيرة تُسمى ميسيلات؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba sabuni inashika uchafu wenye mafuta kwa kuunda mizinga midogo iitwayo micelle?
sw.detail: Molekuli za sabuni zina kichwa kinachopenda maji na mkia unaopenda mafuta; hivyo zinazunguka chembe za mafuta kwa mikia ndani na kuunda micelle, ambazo zinaabaki katika suluhisho na kusafishwa kwa maji.

pt.fact: Sabias que o sabão prende a sujidade gordurosa formando pequenas esferas chamadas micelas?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el jabón atrapa la suciedad grasa formando pequeñas esferas llamadas micelas?
es.detail: Las moléculas de jabón tienen una cabeza que le gusta el agua y una cola que le gusta la grasa, así rodean las partículas grasas con las colas hacia dentro formando micelas; las micelas permanecen suspendidas y se eliminan con el agua.

subject: chemistry
picture: High-resolution photo of green leaves in bright sunlight with visible veins, no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know plants turn sunlight into chemical energy by making sugars?
en.detail: Photosynthesis uses light to combine carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. The process stores energy in chemical bonds that living things can use.

pcm.fact: You sabi say plants dey turn sunlight to chemical energy by making sugars?
pcm.detail: Photosynthesis uses light to combine carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. The process stores energy in chemical bonds that living things can use.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn ọ̀gbìn yí ìmọ́lẹ̀ oorun padà sí agbára kemikali nípasẹ̀ ṣíísọ̀sọ́kàn sugars?
yo.detail: Fótósínthésì ń lò ìmọ́lẹ̀ láti darapọ̀ karbónì dàọ́tásáìdì àti omi síi di glúkósì àti òksíjẹnì; ìlànà yìí ń fipamọ́ agbára sí inú ìbòmọ́ kemikali tí àwọn èèyàn àti ẹranko lè lo.

ig.fact: Ị ma na osisi na-agbanwe anyanwụ ka ọ bụrụ ume kemịkal site n’ịmepụta shuga?
ig.detail: Photosynthesis na-eji ìhè jikọta carbon dioxide na mmiri mepụta glucose na oxygen; usoro a na-echekwa ume n’ime njikọ kemịkal nke ihe ndị ndụ nwere ike iji.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa tsirrai suna mayar da hasken rana zuwa makamashin sinadari ta hanyar yin sukari?
ha.detail: Photosynthesis yana amfani da haske don haɗa carbon dioxide da ruwa zuwa glucose da oxygen; wannan aikin yana adana makamashi a cikin dangin sinadarai wanda rayayyun halittu za su iya amfani da shi.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que les plantes transforment la lumière du soleil en énergie chimique en fabriquant des sucres ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن النباتات تحول ضوء الشمس إلى طاقة كيميائية بصنع السكريات؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba mimea hubadilisha mwanga wa jua kuwa nishati ya kemikali kwa kutengeneza sukari?
sw.detail: Fotosintesi hutumia mwanga kuunganisha dioksidi kaboni na maji kuwa glukosi na oksijeni; mchakato huu unaweka nishati katika viungo vya kemikali ambavyo viumbe hai vinaweza kutumia.

pt.fact: Sabias que as plantas transformam a luz do sol em energia química ao produzir açúcares?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las plantas convierten la luz solar en energía química formando azúcares?
es.detail: La fotosíntesis usa luz para combinar dióxido de carbono y agua en glucosa y oxígeno; el proceso almacena energía en enlaces químicos que los seres vivos pueden usar.

subject: chemistry
picture: Photo of small glass vials glowing different faint colors in a dark box, representing gas discharge, with no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know noble gases are mostly unreactive because their outer shells are full?
en.detail: Atoms react to fill or empty their outer electron shells; noble gases already have full valence shells. That makes helium, neon and others very reluctant to form compounds.

pcm.fact: You sabi say noble gases no dey react much because their outer shells full?
pcm.detail: Atoms react to fill or empty their outer electron shells; noble gases already have full valence shells. That makes helium, neon and others very reluctant to form compounds.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn gaṣì aláyẹ̀wò (noble gases) hàn gbangba pé wọn kì í rọrùn láti fọ́ pọ̀ nítorí pé inú àwọ̀n ẹ̀yẹ wọn kún tán?
yo.detail: Àwọn atómù ń bákọ́ tàbí kó ìkọ̀kọ̀ ni àwọ̀n ìta wọn láti kún tàbí sí ìkọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn gaṣì aláyẹ̀wò ti ní àwọ̀n valẹ́nsì kún, nítorí náà bí helium, neon àti àwọn míì ṣe ṣọ́ra láti dá àwọn ìṣọ̀kan pọ̀ jẹ́ kedere.

ig.fact: Ị ma na gas ndị a pụrụ iche (noble gases) na-adịghị emeghachi ihe n’ozuzu n’ihi na mpụga mkpụrụ ha jupụtara?
ig.detail: Atoms na-emeghachi iji jupụta ma ọ bụ kpochapụ mpụga electron ha; noble gases nwere mpụga valence juputara, nke na-eme ka helium, neon na ndị ọzọ sie ike ịmepụta ihe jikọrọ ha.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa iskar mai daraja (noble gases) ba sa yawan yin haɗin gwiwa saboda ƙwayoyin su na waje cike suke?
ha.detail: Atoma suna yin mu'amala don cika ko fasa ƙwayoyin lantarki na waje; noble gases tuni suna da cike valence shells, wanda ke sa helium, neon da sauransu su yi jinkiri wajen yin haɗe-haɗe.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que les gaz nobles sont surtout inertes parce que leurs couches externes d'électrons sont complètes ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الغازات النبيلة غير فعّالة في التفاعل لأن أغلفتها الإلكترونية الخارجية ممتلئة؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba gesi za heshima hazireagi sana kwa sababu tabaka zao za nje zimejaa?
sw.detail: Atomi hureagia ili kujaza au kutokomeza tabaka zao za elektroni za nje; gesi za heshima tayari zina tabaka za vali iliyojazwa, hivyo helium, neon na nyingine hazipendi kuunda misombo.

pt.fact: Sabias que os gases nobres são em grande parte pouco reativos porque têm as camadas externas de elétrons completas?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los gases nobles son mayormente poco reactivos porque sus capas externas están completas?
es.detail: Los átomos reaccionan para llenar o vaciar sus capas electrónicas externas; los gases nobles ya tienen capas de valencia completas, por eso helio, neón y otros son muy reacios a formar compuestos.

subject: chemistry
picture: Photo of a molecular model set showing many connected black (carbon) and white (hydrogen) balls forming chains and rings on a plain background.

en.fact: Did you know carbon forms millions of compounds because it makes strong chains and rings?
en.detail: Carbon atoms can bond to four neighbors and form stable single, double or triple bonds, enabling vast structures. This versatility is why organic chemistry is so rich.

pcm.fact: You sabi say carbon fit make millions of compounds because e dey form strong chains and rings?
pcm.detail: Carbon atoms can bond to four neighbors and form stable single, double or triple bonds, enabling vast structures. This versatility is why organic chemistry is so rich.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé kábonù ṣe ìṣọ̀kan mọ́ńkún fún ìkẹ̀ta àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọ̀nà nítorí pé ó lè dá pq àti ìyí padà?
yo.detail: Àwọn atómù kábonù lè sopọ̀ mọ́ mọ́rin aládùúgbò, wọ́n lè dá ìbáṣepọ̀ alákẹ̀tà, alákẹ̀jì tàbí alákẹ̀ọ̀kan, tó sì jẹ́ kí ó lè kọ́pọ̀ àwọn ọna tí ó dùn mí; ìmọ̀ kábonù nìyí tó fi jẹ́ pé kemistri àjàpọ̀ gan-an ni.

ig.fact: Ị ma na carbon na-akpọpụta ọtụtụ nde mkpụrụ ndụ kemịkal n’ihi na ọ nwere ike ịmepụta eriri na mgbanaka siri ike?
ig.detail: Carbon nwere ike ijikọ na ndị agbata obi atọ ma ọ bụ anọ ma mepụta njikọta single, double ma ọ bụ triple kwụsiri ike, na-enye ohere maka ọtụtụ usoro; ịdị iche iche a bụ ihe kpatara organic chemistry ji baa ụba.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa carbon yana samar da miliyoyin haɗe-haɗe saboda yana iya yin dogayen sarkoki da zobe mai ƙarfi?
ha.detail: Atoman carbon na iya haɗa wa da abokai huɗu kuma su kafa haɗin single, double ko triple masu ɗorewa, wanda ke ba da damar gina manyan tsaruka; wannan bambanci shi ya sa kimiyyar organic ta yi wadataccen abu.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que le carbone forme des millions de composés parce qu'il peut créer de longues chaînes et des anneaux solides ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الكربون يشكّل ملايين المركبات لأنه يستطيع تكوين سلاسل وحلقات قوية؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba kaboni huunda mamilioni ya misombo kwa sababu inaweza kuunda minyororo na pete imara?
sw.detail: Atomi za kaboni zinaweza kuunganisha na majirani wanne na kuunda viungo thabiti vya single, double au triple, kuruhusu miundo mingi; uhodari huu ndio sababu kemia ya kikaboni ni tajiri sana.

pt.fact: Sabias que o carbono forma milhões de compostos porque consegue ligar-se em cadeias e anéis muito estáveis?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el carbono forma millones de compuestos porque puede hacer cadenas y anillos fuertes?
es.detail: Los átomos de carbono pueden enlazarse a cuatro vecinos y formar enlaces simples, dobles o triples estables, permitiendo estructuras vastas; esa versatilidad explica la riqueza de la química orgánica.

subject: chemistry
picture: Close-up photo of a rusted iron object with flaky red-brown surface texture, no identifiable location or people.

en.fact: Did you know rust is iron turning into iron oxide by combining with oxygen and water?
en.detail: Iron atoms lose electrons (oxidize) when exposed to air and moisture, creating reddish iron oxides. Preventing water or oxygen contact slows rusting.

pcm.fact: You sabi say rust na iron wey don turn iron oxide after e combine with oxygen and water?
pcm.detail: Iron atoms lose electrons (oxidize) when exposed to air and moisture, creating reddish iron oxides. Preventing water or oxygen contact slows rusting.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé rust jẹ́ irin tí ó yípadà sí irin-oxide nígbà tí ó bá darapọ̀ mọ́ òksíjẹnì àti omi?
yo.detail: Àwọn atómù irin ń padà èlékítírónù (oxidize) nígbà tí afẹ́fẹ́ àti ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì omi bá dé, tí ó sì ń ṣẹ̀dá àwọn irin-oxide pupa; kíkó omi tàbí òksíjɛnì kúrò ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú irin á dín ìrora rust ku.

ig.fact: Ị ma na rust bụ ígwè na-agbanweghachi ghọọ iron oxide site n’ịjikọta ya na oxygen na mmiri?
ig.detail: Mgbe ígwè na-ekpughe na ikuku na mmiri, ihe ígwè na-efunahụ elektrọn (oxidize) ma mepụta iron oxides na-acha uhie; izere mmetụ mmiri ma ọ bụ oxygen na-enyere igbochi ịrust.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa tsatsa ita ce ƙarfe (iron) na canzawa zuwa iron oxide ta haɗuwa da oxygen da ruwa?
ha.detail: Atoman iron na rasa electrons (oxidize) idan suka fallasa iska da danshi, suna samar da jan-rinjaye na iron oxides; hana ruwa ko iska kusantar surface zai rage tsatsar.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que la rouille, c'est du fer qui devient de l'oxyde de fer en se combinant avec l'oxygène et l'eau ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الصدأ هو تحول الحديد إلى أكسيد الحديد عندما يتحد مع الأكسجين والماء؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba kutu ni chuma cha chuma kinavyogeuka kuwa oksidi ya chuma kwa kuungana na oksijeni na maji?
sw.detail: Atomi za chuma hupoteza elektroni (kuoksidishwa) zinapofichuliwa kwa hewa na unyevu, na kuunda oksidi za chuma zenye rangi ya kahawia; kuzuia mguso wa maji au oksijeni kunapunguza kutu.

pt.fact: Sabias que a ferrugem é ferro a transformar‑se em óxidos de ferro ao reagir com oxigénio e água?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el óxido se forma cuando el hierro se combina con oxígeno y agua?
es.detail: El hierro pierde electrones (se oxida) al exponerse al aire y la humedad, creando óxidos rojizos de hierro; evitar el contacto con agua u oxígeno ralentiza la corrosión.

subject: chemistry
picture: Macro photo of a small silver droplet of mercury on a plain glass surface reflecting light, no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know mercury is the only common metal liquid at room temperature?
en.detail: Mercury's atoms slide past each other as a liquid because of its weak metallic bonding at room temperature. It's used in some thermometers and must be handled carefully.

pcm.fact: You sabi say mercury be the only common metal wey dey liquid for room temperature?
pcm.detail: Mercury's atoms slide past each other as a liquid because of its weak metallic bonding at room temperature. It's used in some thermometers and must be handled carefully.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé mercuri ni irin àtọkànwá kan ṣoṣo tí ó jẹ́ olójú omi ní iwọn otutu yàrá?
yo.detail: Àwọn atómù mercuri ń yí ká bí omi nítorí ìbáṣepọ̀ irin rẹ̀ tí kò lagbara ní iwọn otutu yàrá; a máa lò ó ninu dígí tómọ́métà àti ó yẹ kí a bójú tó ní pẹ̀lú ìṣọ́ra.

ig.fact: Ị ma na mercury bụ naanị metal a na-ahụkarị nke na-adịghị siri ike ma dị mmiri na okpomọkụ ụlọ?
ig.detail: Atoms mercury na-agagharị n’ebe ha nọ dị ka mmiri n’ihi adịghị ike nke njikọta metal na okpomọkụ ụlọ; a na-eji ya na ụfọdụ thermometers ma a ga-esi na ya rụọ ọrụ nlezianya.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa mercury shine kadai ƙarfe gama gari da yake ruwa a ɗakin zafi?
ha.detail: Atoman mercury suna iya zamewa juna kamar ruwa saboda rauni a haɗin ƙarfe a yanayin dakin zafi; ana amfani da shi a wasu thermometers kuma dole a kula da shi sosai.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que le mercure est le seul métal courant liquide à température ambiante ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الزئبق هو المعدن الشائع الوحيد السائل في درجة حرارة الغرفة؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba zebaki ndio metali pekee ya kawaida iliyokuwa kioevu kwenye joto la kawaida?
sw.detail: Atomi za zebaki zinaweza kusogea kwa urahisi kama kioevu kwa sababu ya uunganishaji dhaifu wa kielektroni kwenye joto la kawaida; inatumiwa kwenye termometri fulani na lazima itolewe kwa tahadhari.

pt.fact: Sabias que o mercúrio é o único metal comum que é líquido à temperatura ambiente?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el mercurio es el único metal común que es líquido a temperatura ambiente?
es.detail: Los átomos de mercurio se deslizan unos sobre otros como líquido debido a su débil enlace metálico a temperatura ambiente; se usa en algunos termómetros y debe manipularse con cuidado.

subject: physics
picture: A realistic computer-rendered image of a grid-like fabric warped by a large sphere representing a planet, with a smaller sphere following a curved path around it, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know gravity curves space so planets follow bent paths, not invisible pulling lines?
en.detail: Einstein showed mass and energy tell spacetime how to curve, and objects move along those curves. Orbits are straight paths in curved spacetime, not forces acting across empty space.

pcm.fact: You sabi say gravity dey curve space so planets dey follow bent paths, no be invisible string wey dey pull dem?
pcm.detail: Einstein showed mass and energy tell spacetime how to curve, and objects move along those curves. Orbits are straight paths in curved spacetime, not forces acting across empty space.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìyọ̀rísí (gravity) ń yí àkókò àti àyè padà torí náà àwọn planetì ń tọ́pa tí a ti rọ́, kì í ṣe àwọn ìlànà míì tí ń fa wọn?
yo.detail: Einstein fi hàn pé ìwà láti inú wúra àti agbára sọ spacetime di rọ̀, àwọn nkan sì ń rìn nígbà tí wọ́n bá tẹ̀lé ìrìn yẹn; ìwòran orbit jẹ́ ipa-ọna tó rọ̀ nínú spacetime, kì í ṣe agbára tí ń fa kọja àyè ofo.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ike ndọda (gravity) na-eme ka oghere-oge (space) bụrụ usoro gbawara, yabụ planet na-eso ụzọ ezughị oke kama ahịrị ịdọkpụ anya?
ig.detail: Einstein gosiwo na massa na ume na-agwa spacetime otu esi nwere mgbanaka, na ihe na-eme njem na-eso mgbanaka ndị ahụ; ụzọ orbital bụ ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n’ime spacetime gbawara, ọ bụghị ike na-adọta gafee oghere efu.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa nauyi (gravity) yana lanƙwasa sarari don haka manyan duniya suna tafiya a hanyoyi masu lankwasa, ba layukan jan hankali marasa gani ba?
ha.detail: Einstein ya nuna cewa massa da makamashi suna gaya wa spacetime yadda zai lanƙwasa, kuma abubuwa suna motsawa a kan waɗannan lankwasassun; zagayowar taurari su ne hanyoyi madaidaiciya a cikin spacetime mai lankwasa, ba ƙarfin da ke aiki ta cikin sarari mai komai babu abu ba.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que la gravité courbe l'espace, si bien que les planètes suivent des trajectoires courbées plutôt que des lignes invisibles de tirage ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الجاذبية تقوّس الزمكان فتجعل الكواكب تتبع مسارات منحنية بدلاً من خطوط جذب مرئية؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba mvutano wa mvuto unazungusha nafasi hivyo sayari zinafuata njia zilizoinuliwa, sio nyaya za kuvuta zinazoonekana?
sw.detail: Einstein alionyesha kwamba wingi wa nyenzo na nishati unasema nafasi-nyakati jinsi ya kufunguka, na vitu vinatembea kwenye mikunjo hiyo; mizunguko ni njia za moja kwa moja katika nafasi iliyoinuka, si nguvu zinazopita kwenye nafasi tupu.

pt.fact: Sabias que a gravidade curva o espaço, por isso os planetas seguem caminhos curvos e não linhas invisíveis de atração?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la gravedad curva el espacio para que los planetas sigan trayectorias dobladas, no líneas de atracción invisibles?
es.detail: Einstein mostró que la masa y la energía dicen al espacio‑tiempo cómo curvarse y los objetos se mueven por esas curvaturas; las órbitas son trayectorias rectas en un espacio‑tiempo curvado, no fuerzas actuando a distancia sobre vacío.

subject: physics
picture: A clean laboratory scene showing a long evacuated tube with a laser beam visible as a faint line, equipment around it, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know the speed of light in a vacuum is the same for all observers, no matter how fast they move?
en.detail: Special relativity postulates light's vacuum speed is constant (~299,792 km/s), forcing time and space to adjust. This leads to time dilation and length contraction that we can measure with clocks and particle experiments.

pcm.fact: You sabi say speed of light for vacuum dey same for everybody no matter how fast dem dey move?
pcm.detail: Special relativity postulates light's vacuum speed is constant (~299,792 km/s), forcing time and space to adjust. This leads to time dilation and length contraction that we can measure with clocks and particle experiments.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé iyara ìmọ́lẹ̀ ní àfọwọ́fẹ̀ (vacuum) jẹ́ ìkan náà fún gbogbo olùṣàkóso, kò sí ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú bí wọ́n ṣe yarọ̀?
yo.detail: Ìmúlòlùfẹ́ pàtàkì nípa ìbànújẹ́ (special relativity) sọ pé iyara ìmọ́lẹ̀ ní vacuum jẹ́ aropọ̀ (~299,792 km/s), èyí sì mú kí àkókò àti àyè yí padà; èyí ṣe dènà ìkúnlẹ̀kùnlẹ̀ àkókò àti ìdín ìwọn tí a lè ṣe ìwọn pẹ̀lú ago àti ìwádìí pátíkùlù.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọsọ ọkụ n’enweghị ikuku (speed of light in a vacuum) bụ otu maka ndị na-ekiri niile, ọbụna ma ha na-aga ngwa ọsọ dị iche?
ig.detail: Special relativity na-ekwu na ọsọ ọkụ n’enweghị ikuku dị ka ~299,792 km/s bụ nke a na-ahụ mgbe niile, nke na-eme ka oge na oghere gbanwee; nke a na-eduga na mgbatị oge na ịbelata ogologo nke enwere ike ịlele site na igwe elekere na nyocha mkpụrụ particle.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa saurin haske a cikin vacuum iri ɗaya ne ga duk masu kallo, komai yadda suke sauri?
ha.detail: Special relativity tana ɗauka cewa saurin haske a vacuum ya kasance dindindin (~299,792 km/s), wanda hakan ya tilasta lokaci da sarari su daidaita; wannan yana haifar da dilation na lokaci da takurewar tsawo waɗanda ake iya auna su da agogo da gwaje-gwajen ƙwayoyin zarra.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que la vitesse de la lumière dans le vide est la même pour tous les observateurs, quelle que soit leur vitesse (~299,792 km/s) ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن سرعة الضوء في الفراغ ثابتة لكل المراقبين مهما كانت سرعتهم؟ (~299,792 km/s)

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba mwendo wa mwanga katika utupu ni sawa kwa watazamaji wote, bila kujali wangapi kasi yao?
sw.detail: Relativity maalum inaweka mwendo wa mwanga katika utupu kama thabiti (~299,792 km/s), na hivyo wakati na nafasi vinabadilika; hii inasababisha kupotoshwa kwa wakati na kukokotoa kwa urefu vinavyoweza kupimwa na saa na majaribio ya chembe.

pt.fact: Sabias que a velocidade da luz no vácuo é a mesma para todos os observadores, não importa a rapidez com que se movam (~299,792 km/s)?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la velocidad de la luz en el vacío es la misma para todos los observadores, sin importar cuán rápido se muevan?
es.detail: La relatividad especial postula que la velocidad de la luz en el vacío es constante (~299,792 km/s), lo que obliga al tiempo y al espacio a ajustarse; esto provoca dilatación del tiempo y contracción de longitudes medibles con relojes y experimentos de partículas.

subject: physics
picture: A simulated atomic model showing colorful, fuzzy electron probability clouds surrounding a small nucleus at the center, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know electrons don't orbit nuclei like planets but exist as fuzzy probability clouds?
en.detail: Quantum mechanics describes electrons by wavefunctions giving probabilities of where they may be found. Experiments like electron diffraction match these cloud-shaped probability patterns.

pcm.fact: You sabi say electrons no dey orbit nucleus like planets but dem dey show as fuzzy probability cloud?
pcm.detail: Quantum mechanics describes electrons by wavefunctions giving probabilities of where they may be found. Experiments like electron diffraction match these cloud-shaped probability patterns.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn elektronù kì í yí ká núkílíù bí àwọn planetì; dipo náà wọn wà gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkóríta ìṣeese?
yo.detail: Mẹ́kánìkì kwáńtùmù ṣàpèjúwe elektronù pẹ̀lú iṣẹ́-ìfẹ̀nukò (wavefunction) tí ń fi ìṣeese hàn níbí tí a lè rí wọn; ìwádìí bíi didákẹ́sẹ̀ elektronù fihan ìràpadà ìmúlẹ̀ ìṣeese wọ̀nyẹn.

ig.fact: Ị ma na elektrọn anaghị emegharị gburugburu nucleus dịka planet mana ha dị ka igwe ojii nwere ohere ebe ha nwere ike ịnọ?
ig.detail: Quantum mechanics na-akọwa elektrọn site na wavefunction nke na-enye ohere (probability) ebe a ga-ahụ ha; nyocha dị ka electron diffraction na-egosi ụdị igwe ojii probability ndị a.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa electrons ba sa kewaye nucleus kamar duniyoyi amma suna kasancewa a matsayin gajimare masu yiyuwar kasancewa?
ha.detail: Quantum mechanics tana bayyana electrons ta hanyar wavefunctions waɗanda ke ba da yiyuwar inda za a same su; gwaje-gwaje kamar electron diffraction suna dacewa da waɗannan samfurorin gajimare na yiyuwa.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que les électrons ne tournent pas autour des noyaux comme des planètes mais existent sous forme de nuages de probabilité flous ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الإلكترونات لا تدور حول النوى مثل الكواكب بل توجد كسحب احتمال غامضة؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba elektroni hazizunguki nyuso za atomu kama sayari bali zipo kama mawingu ya uwezekano yaliyofifia?
sw.detail: Mikanda ya quantum inaelezea elektroni kwa njia za mawimbi (wavefunctions) zinazotoa uwezekano wa mahali pa kupatikana; majaribio kama kupindika kwa elektroni yanaonyesha picha za mawimbi hizi za uwezekano.

pt.fact: Sabias que os eletrões não orbitam o núcleo como planetas, mas existem como nuvens difusas de probabilidade?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los electrones no orbitan el núcleo como planetas sino que existen como nubes de probabilidad difusas?
es.detail: La mecánica cuántica describe a los electrones mediante funciones de onda que dan probabilidades de dónde pueden encontrarse; experimentos como la difracción de electrones concuerdan con esos patrones de probabilidad en forma de nube.

subject: physics
picture: A photo-real image of a smooth, polished superconducting coil cooled by visible vapor (liquid helium-like fog) in a lab, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know some materials conduct electricity with zero resistance when very cold?
en.detail: Superconductors let current flow without energy loss below a critical temperature because electrons pair up and move coherently. This is used in MRI magnets and particle accelerators.

pcm.fact: You sabi say some materials dey carry electricity with zero resistance when dem very cold?
pcm.detail: Superconductors let current flow without energy loss below a critical temperature because electrons pair up and move coherently. This is used in MRI magnets and particle accelerators.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé díẹ̀ lára ohun elo máa ń gba ẹ̀rọ itanna kọjá láìsí ìdènà nígbà tí wọ́n bá tutu gan-an?
yo.detail: Àwọn superconductors jẹ́ kí ìsọdọtun ina rìn láìsí ìsonu agbára níwọ̀n igba tí wọ́n bá wà lábé ìwọn otutu ìpinnu kan torí pé àwọn elektronù pọ̀ jọ ní ìmúlòlùkan; a máa lò wọn ní magneti MRI àti amúlùmọ́ pátíkùlù.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụfọdụ ihe na-ebu ọkụ eletrik na-enweghị nguzogide mgbe ha dị oyi nke ukwuu?
ig.detail: Superconductors na-ahapụ ugbu a ka ọ gafee n’enweghị ọnwụ ume n’okpuru okpomọkụ mikilọ (critical temperature) n’ihi na eletrọn na-ajikọta ma na-emegharị ọnụ; a na-eji nke a eme ihe na MRI magnets na akụrụngwa mgbazinye particle.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa wasu kayan suna ɗaukar wutar lantarki ba tare da juriya ba lokacin da su suka yi sanyi sosai?
ha.detail: Superconductors suna barin ƙarin lantarki ya gudana ba tare da ɓatarwa ba ƙasa da wani zafin jiki na ƙasa saboda electrons suna haɗuwa a ma'aurata kuma suna motsawa a daidaito; ana amfani da wannan a maganadisu na MRI da masu hanzarta zarra.

fr.fact: Le saviez-vous que certains matériaux conduisent l'électricité sans résistance quand ils sont très froids ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن بعض المواد توصل الكهرباء بدون مقاومة عندما تكون باردة جداً؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba nyenzo fulani hupeleka umeme bila upinzani wowote wakati zinapopozwa sana?
sw.detail: Superconductors huruhusu mzunguko kuendelea bila hasara ya nishati chini ya joto maalum kwa sababu elektroni hupanga jozi na kusogea kwa ushirikiano; hii inatumiwa katika magineti za MRI na kasi ya chembe.

pt.fact: Sabias que certos materiais conduzem eletricidade sem resistência quando estão muito frios?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que algunos materiales conducen la electricidad sin resistencia cuando están muy fríos?
es.detail: Los superconductores permiten que la corriente fluya sin pérdida de energía por debajo de una temperatura crítica porque los electrones se emparejan y se mueven de forma coherente; esto se usa en imanes de MRI y aceleradores de partículas.

subject: physics
picture: A scientific illustration of a particle wave packet partially penetrating and appearing beyond a barrier, shown as a smooth gradient, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know tiny particles can Quantum tunnel through barriers they couldn't cross classically?
en.detail: Quantum tunneling lets particles appear on the other side of energy barriers due to their wave-like nature. Tunneling is essential in devices like tunnel diodes and in nuclear fusion in stars.

pcm.fact: You sabi say tiny particles fit quantum tunnel through barrier wey classically dem no fit pass?
pcm.detail: Quantum tunneling lets particles appear on the other side of energy barriers due to their wave-like nature. Tunneling is essential in devices like tunnel diodes and in nuclear fusion in stars.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn pátíkù kékeré lè túnṣe tún-nípa-ìkùnà (quantum tunneling) kọja ààrẹ tí kíkọlẹ̀ ìṣe sáyé ní kílá sí?
yo.detail: Quantum tunneling jẹ́ kí pátíkù lè hàn ní ẹgbẹ́ kejì àwọn ààrẹ agbára níwọ̀n igba tí ìwa wọn bá dà bí ìfẹ́nukò, ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yìí wúlò nínú ẹ̀rọ bíi tunnel diodes àti nínú ìfọ̀kàn-balẹ̀ ìmúlẹ̀ nínú ìpapọ̀ nukelià nínú àwọn ìràwọ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na obere mkpụrụ nwere ike ime Quantum tunneling gafere ihe mgbochi nke ha agaghị enwe ike gafere n’akparamaagwa klasịkal?
ig.detail: Quantum tunneling na-eme ka mkpụrụ pụta n’akụkụ ọzọ nke mgbochi ume n’ihi àgwà ha dị ka igwe (wave-like); tunneling dị mkpa n’ime ngwaọrụ dịka tunnel diodes na n’ime arụ ọrụ ike nuklia na kpakpando.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ƙananan ƙwayoyin na iya yin quantum tunneling ta wuraren da ba za su iya ketare su a tsarin al'ada ba?
ha.detail: Quantum tunneling yana ba ƙwayoyin damar bayyana a ɗaya gefen shingen makamashi saboda halayyar su ta gami da wannan yanayi; tunneling yana da muhimmanci a na'urori kamar tunnel diodes kuma a haɗin nukiliya a cikin taurari.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الجسيمات الصغيرة يمكنها أن تخترق الحواجز كمياً عبر النفق حتى لو لم تستطع عبوره طبقياً؟

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba chembe ndogo zinaweza kupita kupitia vizingiti kwa njia ya uwezekano wa Quantum hata watu wa kimantiki wasingeweza?
sw.detail: Tunneling ya quantum inawawezesha chembe kujitokeza upande mwingine wa kizingiti cha nishati kutokana na asili yao ya mawimbi; tunneling ni muhimu katika vitu kama diodi za tunnel na katika fusion ya nyota.

pt.fact: Sabias que partículas muito pequenas podem fazer tunelamento quântico e atravessar barreiras que não conseguiriam classically?

es.fact: ¿Sabías que partículas diminutas pueden hacer tunelamiento cuántico y atravesar barreras que no cruzarían clásicamente?
es.detail: El tunelamiento cuántico permite que partículas aparezcan al otro lado de barreras energéticas debido a su naturaleza ondulatoria; el tunelamiento es esencial en dispositivos como diodos túnel y en la fusión nuclear en las estrellas.

subject: mathematics
picture: Photoreal image of three wooden sticks arranged into a right triangle on a plain surface, forming a clear right angle, no markings or people.

en.fact: Did you know the Pythagorean theorem works only for right-angled triangles?
en.detail: If a triangle has a right angle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other sides. Other triangles need the law of cosines instead.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Pythagoras theorem dey work only for right-angled triangles?
pcm.detail: If a triangle has a right angle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other sides. Other triangles need the law of cosines instead.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìtẹ́numọ́ Pythagoras ṣiṣẹ́ fún onigun mẹ́ta tí ó ní igun ọ̀tun nìkan?
yo.detail: If a triangle has a right angle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other sides. Other triangles need the law of cosines instead.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụkpụrụ Pythagoras na-arụ ọrụ naanị na triangle nwere akuku ziri ezi?
ig.detail: Ọ bụrụ na triangle nwere akuku ziri ezi, square nke hypotenuse hà nha nke mgbakwunye squares nke akụkụ ndị ọzọ; triangles ndị ọzọ chọrọ iwu cosines kama.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa ka'idar Pythagoras tana aiki ne kawai ga kusurwa madaidaici (right-angled) na triangle?
ha.detail: Idan triangle yana da kusurwa madaidaici, murabba'in hypotenuse ɗin ya yi daidai da jumlar murabba'in sauran gefuna; sauran triangles na buƙatar dokar cosine (law of cosines).

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le théorème de Pythagore ne vaut que pour les triangles rectangle ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن نظرية فيثاغورس تنطبق فقط على المثلثات ذات الزاوية القائمة؟
ar.detail: إذا كان لدى المثلث زاوية قائمة، فإن مربع الوتر يساوي مجموع مربعي الضلعين الآخرين؛ والمثلثات الأخرى تحتاج إلى قانون جيب التمام بدلاً من ذلك.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba theorem ya Pythagoras inafanya kazi kwa pembetatu zenye pembe ya kulia pekee?
sw.detail: Ikiwa pembetatu ina pembe ya kulia, mraba wa hipotenuzi ni sawa na jumla ya mraba za pande nyingine; pembetatu nyingine zinahitaji sheria ya kosaini badala yake.

pt.fact: Sabias que o teorema de Pitágoras só funciona em triângulos com ângulo recto?
pt.detail: Se um triângulo tem um ângulo recto, o quadrado da hipotenusa é igual à soma dos quadrados dos outros lados; triângulos não rectângulos exigem a lei dos cossenos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el teorema de Pitágoras sólo funciona para triángulos con ángulo recto?
es.detail: If a triangle has a right angle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other sides. Other triangles need the law of cosines instead.

subject: mathematics
picture: High-resolution photo of the central part of a sunflower head showing the dense spiral seed pattern, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know Fibonacci numbers appear in sunflower seed spirals and pinecones?
en.detail: Seeds and scales pack efficiently following two spiral counts that are consecutive Fibonacci numbers. This pattern optimizes space and sunlight exposure.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Fibonacci numbers dey show for sunflower seed spirals and pinecones?
pcm.detail: Seeds and scales pack efficiently following two spiral counts that are consecutive Fibonacci numbers. This pattern optimizes space and sunlight exposure.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé nọ́mbà Fibonacci máa hàn nínú ìyípo irugbin ẹ̀sun sunflower àti àwọn pinecone?
yo.detail: Seeds and scales pack efficiently following two spiral counts that are consecutive Fibonacci numbers. This pattern optimizes space and sunlight exposure.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọnụọgụ Fibonacci na-apụta n’usoro mkpụrụ sunflower na pinecones?
ig.detail: Mkpụrụ na scales na-etinye onwe ha nke ọma soro ọnụọgụ spirals abụọ nke bụ Fibonacci soro; usoro a na-eme ka oghere na ìhè anyanwụ bụrụ nke kacha mma.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa lambobin Fibonacci suna fitowa a cikin jujjuyawar tsaba a fure-furen sunflower da ƙwayoyin pinecone?
ha.detail: Tsaba da sikeli suna shiryawa cikin yadda ya dace ta bin ƙidaya biyu na jujjuyawa waɗanda su ne lambobin Fibonacci na jere; wannan tsarin yana daidaita amfani da sarari da hasken rana.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les nombres de Fibonacci apparaissent dans les spirales des graines de tournesol et des pommes de pin ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أعداد فيبوناتشي تظهر في دوامات بذور دوار الشمس ومخاريط الصنوبر؟
ar.detail: تحزم البذور واللقاحات بكفاءة باتباع عددين لولبيين متتاليين من فيبوناتشي، وهذا النمط يحسن استغلال المساحة والتعرض لأشعة الشمس.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba nambari za Fibonacci zinaonekana katika mviringo wa mbegu za alizeti na maganda ya pinecone?
sw.detail: Mbegu na mizani hupangwa kwa ufanisi kufuata hesabu za mviringo mbili ambazo ni nambari mfululizo za Fibonacci; muundo huu unaongeza matumizi ya nafasi na upokezaji wa mwangaza wa jua.

pt.fact: Sabias que os números de Fibonacci aparecem nas espirais das sementes de girassol e nos pinhões?
pt.detail: Sementes e escamas organizam-se eficientemente seguindo duas contagens de espirais que são números consecutivos de Fibonacci, optimizando espaço e exposição ao sol.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los números de Fibonacci aparecen en las espirales de semillas de los girasoles y en las piñas?
es.detail: Seeds and scales pack efficiently following two spiral counts that are consecutive Fibonacci numbers. This pattern optimizes space and sunlight exposure.

subject: mathematics
picture: Photoreal image of a sliced fruit (like an orange) with one segment slightly separated to show a fraction of the whole, no labels or text.

en.fact: Did you know fractional numbers extend whole-number ideas to divide things fairly?
en.detail: Fractions represent parts of a whole and obey rules like addition and multiplication by converting to common denominators or using reciprocals. They model portions, ratios and probabilities.

pcm.fact: You sabi say fractional numbers extend whole-number ideas to divide things fair?
pcm.detail: Fractions represent parts of a whole and obey rules like addition and multiplication by converting to common denominators or using reciprocals. They model portions, ratios and probabilities.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn nọ́mbà apá (fractions) fa ìmọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ nù sí ìpín apá láti pín ohun lòdodo?
yo.detail: Fractions represent parts of a whole and obey rules like addition and multiplication by converting to common denominators or using reciprocals. They model portions, ratios and probabilities.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọnụọgụ fractional na-eme ka echiche nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu gbasaa iji kee ihe nke ọma?
ig.detail: Ikewapụrụ na-anọchi akụkụ nke ihe dum ma na-eso iwu dịka mgbakwunye na mgbanaka site n'ịgbanwe denominators ma ọ bụ iji reciprocals; ha na-akọwa akụkụ, ọkọlọtọ na ohere.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa lambobin rabo (fractions) suna faɗaɗa tunanin lambobi cikakku don raba abubuwa da adalci?
ha.detail: Fractions suna wakiltar sassa na cikakken abu kuma suna bin ƙa'idodi kamar haɗawa da ninki ta hanyar mayar da su zuwa makarantes na kasa (common denominators) ko amfani da madogara (reciprocals); suna wakiltar sassa, rabo da yiwuwar abu (probabilities).

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les nombres fractionnaires étendent les idées des entiers pour diviser les choses équitablement ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأعداد الكسرية تمدد أفكار الأعداد الصحيحة لتقسيم الأشياء بعدل؟
ar.detail: الكسور تمثل أجزاءً من الكل وتخضع لقواعد مثل الجمع والضرب عبر تحويل المقامات المشتركة أو استخدام المقلوب؛ وهي تُستخدم لتمثيل الأنسباء والنِّسَب والاحتمالات.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba nambari za sehemu (fractions) zinaeneza dhana za nambari kamili ili kugawa vitu kwa haki?
sw.detail: Sehemu zinawakilisha sehemu za jumla na zinafuata kanuni kama kuongeza na kuzidisha kwa kubadilisha kwa majina ya pamoja au kutumia viwango vya kugeuza; zinatumika kwa vipimo, uwiano na uwezekano.

pt.fact: Sabias que os números fraccionários estendem as ideias dos números inteiros para dividir coisas de forma justa?
pt.detail: As fracções representam partes de um todo e obedecem a regras como adição e multiplicação, usando denominadores comuns ou recíprocos; modelam porções, razões e probabilidades.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las fracciones extienden las ideas de los números enteros para dividir cosas con justicia?
es.detail: Fractions represent parts of a whole and obey rules like addition and multiplication by converting to common denominators or using reciprocals. They model portions, ratios and probabilities.

subject: mathematics
picture: Photoreal image of a patterned tile or carved geometric rosette showing rotational and reflection symmetry, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know symmetry in shapes links to equations and group theory?
en.detail: Symmetries are transformations that leave an object unchanged. Studying them leads to groups, which organize those transformations algebraically.

pcm.fact: You sabi say symmetry for shapes connect to equations and group theory?
pcm.detail: Symmetries are transformations that leave an object unchanged. Studying them leads to groups, which organize those transformations algebraically.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìwòkànsí (symmetry) nínú àwọn àwọ̀n so mọ́ ìṣírò àti ìmọ̀ ẹgbẹ́ (group theory)?
yo.detail: Symmetries are transformations that leave an object unchanged. Studying them leads to groups, which organize those transformations algebraically.

ig.fact: Ị ma na nhata (symmetry) n’ụdị jikọrọ ya na yhtụrụ na group theory?
ig.detail: Nhata bụ ntụgharị ndị na-ahapụ ihe ka ọ dị ka mbụ; ịmụ ha na-eduga na ìgwè (groups) nke na-ahazi ntụgharị ndị a n’ụdị algebra.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa daidaito (symmetry) a sifofi yana da alaƙa da ƙa'idodi da theory na rukuni (group theory)?
ha.detail: Daidaito su ne sauye-sauye da ke barin abu ya kasance ba tare da canji ba; nazarin su yana kaiwa ga rukuni, waɗanda ke tsara waɗannan sauye-sauyen a cikin ilimin algebra.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que la symétrie des formes est liée aux équations et à la théorie des groupes ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن التماثل في الأشكال يرتبط بالمعادلات ونظرية الزمر؟
ar.detail: التماثلات هي تحولات تترك الجسم دون تغيير، ودراستها تقود إلى الزمر التي تنظم هذه التحولات جبريًا.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba usawa wa maumbo (symmetry) unaunganishwa na mlinganyo na nadharia ya vikundi?
sw.detail: Symmetries ni mabadiliko yanayoyaacha kitu bila kubadilika; kuyasoma kunatoa vikundi, vinavyoandaa mabadiliko hayo kwa njia ya aljebra.

pt.fact: Sabias que a simetria nas formas está ligada a equações e à teoria dos grupos?
pt.detail: Simetrias são transformações que deixam um objecto inalterado; estudá‑las leva a grupos, que organizam essas transformações de forma algébrica.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la simetría de las figuras se relaciona con ecuaciones y la teoría de grupos?
es.detail: Symmetries are transformations that leave an object unchanged. Studying them leads to groups, which organize those transformations algebraically.

subject: mathematics
picture: Photoreal image of a globe on a plain surface with a thin thread stretched along a curved great-circle path, no text or people.

en.fact: Did you know the shortest path between two points on Earth is a great-circle arc, not a straight line on a map?
en.detail: On a sphere, geodesics (great circles) give shortest routes. Plane maps distort these, which is why long flights curve when drawn on flat maps.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the shortest path between two points for Earth na great-circle arc, no be straight line for map?
pcm.detail: On a sphere, geodesics (great circles) give shortest routes. Plane maps distort these, which is why long flights curve when drawn on flat maps.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ipa kúkúrú jùlọ láàárín ọ̀pọ̀ méjì lórílẹ̀-èdè Ayé ni ìpẹ̀yà ìgbẹ̀yìn-àgbọ̀n (great-circle arc), kì í ṣe líní taara lórí maapu?
yo.detail: On a sphere, geodesics (great circles) give shortest routes. Plane maps distort these, which is why long flights curve when drawn on flat maps.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụzọ kacha mkpụmkpụ n’etiti isi abụọ n’elu Earth bụ arc nke nnukwu okirikiri, ọ bụghị ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n’map?
ig.detail: Na bọl, geodesics (okirikiri ukwu) na-enye ụzọ kacha mkpụmkpụ; map kwụ ọtọ na-emebi ihe, nke bụkwa ihe kpatara ụgbọ elu ogologo ji pụta dị ka arc na map efu.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa mafi guntu hanya tsakanin maki biyu a Duniya ƙirar arc ta ƙwallon ƙasa (great-circle), ba layi madaidaici a taswira ba?
ha.detail: A kan ƙwallon duniya, geodesics (great circles) sune hanyoyin gajeru; taswirar fili na ɓata su, shi ya sa jiragen mai tafiya nesa ke bayyana kamar suna lanƙwasa idan an nuna su a kan taswira mai fadi.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le plus court chemin entre deux points sur la Terre est un arc de grand cercle, pas une ligne droite sur une carte ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أقصر مسار بين نقطتين على الأرض هو قوس دائرة عظمى، وليس خطًا مستقيماً على الخريطة؟
ar.detail: على الكُرة، المقاطع الجيوديسية (دوائر عظمى) تعطي أقصر الطرق، وتشوّه الخرائط المسطحة هذه الخطوط، ولهذا تبدو مسارات الرحلات الطويلة منحنية على الخرائط.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba njia fupi kati ya pointi mbili duniani ni mzunguko mkubwa, sio mstari wa moja kwa moja kwenye ramani?
sw.detail: Katika duara, geodesics (mizunguko mikubwa) ndizo njia fupi; ramani za plane zinapofanya mviringo kuharibika ndiyo sababu safari ndefu zinaonekana zikikumbuka mviringo kwenye ramani za usawa.

pt.fact: Sabias que o caminho mais curto entre dois pontos na Terra é um arco de círculo máximo, não uma linha recta num mapa?
pt.detail: Numa esfera, geodésicas (círculos máximos) dão as rotas mais curtas; os mapas planos distorcem-nas, por isso voos longos parecem curvos quando desenhados num mapa plano.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la ruta más corta entre dos puntos en la Tierra es un arco de círculo máximo, no una línea recta en el mapa?
es.detail: On a sphere, geodesics (great circles) give shortest routes. Plane maps distort these, which is why long flights curve when drawn on flat maps.

subject: geography
picture: A wide aerial photo of a vast, white Antarctic landscape with flat ice plains and distant mountain peaks under a clear sky.

en.fact: Did you know Antarctica is the largest desert on Earth, even though it's icy?
en.detail: Deserts are defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives very little snow, making it the biggest desert by area.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Antarctica na the biggest desert for Earth, even though e full ice?
pcm.detail: Deserts are defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives very little snow, making it the biggest desert by area.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé Antarctica ni aginjù tó tobi jù lọ lórílẹ̀-àyé, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ó kún fún yìyọ̀ ìdá?
yo.detail: Deserts are defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives very little snow, making it the biggest desert by area.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Antarctica bụ oke ifufe kacha buru ibu n’ụwa, ọbụlagodi na o jupụtara n’ice?
ig.detail: A na-akọwa ọdachi dị ka ebe nwere ntakịrị mmiri ozuzo, ọ bụghị okpomọkụ; Antarctica na-anata ntakịrị snow, na-eme ya ka ọ bụrụ ọdachi kachasị nke ukwuu site na mpụta.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa Antarctica ita ce babban hamada a Duniya, ko da yake kankara take da yawa?
ha.detail: Ana bayyana hamada da ƙarancin ruwa mai sauka (precipitation), ba da zafi ba; Antarctica tana samun ƙanƙan ruwan ƙanƙara, wanda ya sa ta zama hamadar da tafi girma a fadin ƙasa.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que l'Antarctique est le plus grand désert de la Terre, même s'il est glacé ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن القارة القطبية الجنوبية هي أكبر صحراء على الأرض رغم أنها جليدية؟
ar.detail: الصحراء تُعرف بقلة هطول الأمطار وليس بالحرارة؛ القارة القطبية الجنوبية تتلقى ثلوجًا قليلة جدًا، مما يجعلها أكبر صحراء من حيث المساحة.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Antaktika ni jangwani kubwa zaidi duniani, ingawa imefunikwa na barafu?
sw.detail: Jangwa linatafsiriwa kwa mvua ndogo, si joto; Antaktika hupokea theluji kidogo sana, ikifanya iwe jangwa kubwa kwa eneo.

pt.fact: Sabias que a Antárctida é o maior deserto da Terra, mesmo sendo gelado?
pt.detail: Desertos definem‑se por precipitação baixa, não por calor; a Antárctida recebe muito pouca neve, o que a torna o maior deserto em área.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la Antártida es el desierto más grande de la Tierra, aunque esté helado?
es.detail: Deserts are defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives very little snow, making it the biggest desert by area.

subject: geography
picture: A panoramic photo of rolling sand dunes and a bright blue sky in a classic Saharan desert scene, no people present.

en.fact: Did you know the Sahara is the biggest hot desert, covering much of North Africa?
en.detail: The Sahara spans about 9 million square kilometers across many African countries. Its hot, dry climate and sand seas define the region.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Sahara na the biggest hot desert, e cover plenty North Africa?
pcm.detail: The Sahara spans about 9 million square kilometers across many African countries. Its hot, dry climate and sand seas define the region.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé Sahara ni aginjù gbóná tó tobi jù lọ, tí ó bo púpọ̀ nínú Ariwa Áfíríkà?
yo.detail: The Sahara spans about 9 million square kilometers across many African countries. Its hot, dry climate and sand seas define the region.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Sahara bụ ọdachi ọkụ kacha ibu, na-ekpuchi ọtụtụ ebe nke North Africa?
ig.detail: Sahara na-agafe ihe dị ka 9 million km^2 gafee ọtụtụ mba Afrịka; ihu igwe ya dị ọkụ ma dị oke ifufe na oke aja na-akọwa mpaghara ahụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa Sahara ita ce babbar hamadar zafi, tana rufe babban ɓangare na Arewacin Afirka?
ha.detail: Sahara tana shimfiɗa kusan 9 million square kilometers a fadin ƙasashe da dama na Afirka; yanayinta mai zafi da bushewa da hamada na yashi su ne ke ƙayyade yankin.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le Sahara est le plus grand désert chaud, couvrant une grande partie de l'Afrique du Nord ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الصحراء الكبرى هي أكبر صحراء حارة وتغطي جزءًا كبيرًا من شمال أفريقيا؟
ar.detail: تمتد الصحراء الكبرى على حوالي 9 million square kilometers عبر عدة دول أفريقية، ومناخها الحار والجاف وبحار الرمال يميزون المنطقة.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Sahara ni jangwa la moto kubwa zaidi, likifunika takriban 9,000,000 km²?
sw.detail: Sahara inashika takriban 9,000,000 km² ikivuka nchi nyingi za Afrika Kaskazini; hali yake ya joto kavu na bahari za mchanga ndiyo inayoitofautisha.

pt.fact: Sabias que o Saara é o maior deserto quente, cobrindo grande parte do Norte de África?
pt.detail: O Saara estende‑se por cerca de 9 milhões de km² por vários países africanos; o seu clima quente e seco e os seus mares de areia definem a região.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el Sáhara es el mayor desierto cálido, cubriendo gran parte del norte de África?
es.detail: The Sahara spans about 9 million square kilometers across many African countries. Its hot, dry climate and sand seas define the region.

subject: geography
picture: A clear view of Mount Kilimanjaro showing the snow-capped summit above flat surrounding plains, taken from a distance.

en.fact: Did you know Africa contains both the highest and one of the deepest free-standing mountains: Kilimanjaro?
en.detail: Mount Kilimanjaro rises from near sea-level plains up to 5,895 m without being part of a mountain chain. Its height and isolation make it the tallest free-standing mountain in the world.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Africa get Kilimanjaro wey be highest and one of the biggest free-standing mountains?
pcm.detail: Mount Kilimanjaro rises from near sea-level plains up to 5,895 m without being part of a mountain chain. Its height and isolation make it the tallest free-standing mountain in the world.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé Áfíríkà ní Kilimanjaro, òkè gíga jùlọ tí kò so pọ̀ mọ́ pq òkè míì?
yo.detail: Mount Kilimanjaro rises from near sea-level plains up to 5,895 m without being part of a mountain chain. Its height and isolation make it the tallest free-standing mountain in the world.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Afrịka nwere ugwu kachasị elu ma bụrụkwa otu n’ime ugwu kachasị dị iche n’azụ ụwa: Kilimanjaro?
ig.detail: Ugwu Kilimanjaro na-arịgo site n’ugwu ala fọdụụrụ nso n’ọkwa oké osimiri ruo 5,895 m na-enweghị ịbụ akụkụ nke ọgbọ ugwu; ịdị elu ya na nkwụsị ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ugwu kacha elu n'ụwa nke kwụ n’ọdụ.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa Afirka tana ɗauke da dutsen mafi tsayi kuma ɗaya daga cikin mafi zurfi masu zaman kansu: Kilimanjaro?
ha.detail: Dutsen Kilimanjaro ya tashi daga ƙanana daidai matakin teku zuwa 5,895 m ba tare da kasancewa ɓangare na jerin duwatsu ba; tsawonsa da keɓancinsa sun sa shi zama mafi tsayin dutse mai zaman kansa a duniya.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que l'Afrique abrite le plus haut et l'un des plus imposants sommets isolés : le Kilimandjaro ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أفريقيا تضم جبل كليمنجارو الأعلى وأحد أعلى الجبال المنفردة؟
ar.detail: يرتفع جبل كليمنجارو من سهول قريبة من مستوى سطح البحر إلى 5,895 m دون أن يكون جزءًا من سلسلة جبلية، مما يجعله أعلى جبل قائم بذاته في العالم.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Afrika ina Mlima Kilimanjaro, mlima mrefu na mmoja wa miamba isiyo ya mnyororo, unaoinuka hadi 5,895 m?
sw.detail: Mlima Kilimanjaro unainuka kutoka karibu viwango vya nyasi hadi 5,895 m bila kuwa sehemu ya mnyororo wa milima; urefu na upweke wake unaufanya kuwa mlima mrefu wa kujitegemea duniani.

pt.fact: Sabias que África tem uma das maiores montanhas isoladas do mundo: o Kilimanjaro?
pt.detail: O Monte Kilimanjaro eleva‑se desde planícies quase ao nível do mar até 5,895 m sem fazer parte de uma cadeia montanhosa, sendo a maior montanha independente do mundo.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el Kilimanjaro es una de las montañas aisladas más altas y se eleva 5,895 m desde planicies casi al nivel del mar?
es.detail: Mount Kilimanjaro rises from near sea-level plains up to 5,895 m without being part of a mountain chain. Its height and isolation make it the tallest free-standing mountain in the world.

subject: geography
picture: A shoreline photo of a calm, shimmering salt lake with crystalline salt deposits along the edge and barren surrounding hills.

en.fact: Did you know the Dead Sea is Earth's lowest land elevation and is saltier than the ocean?
en.detail: The surface of the Dead Sea is the planet's lowest exposed land, about 430 meters below sea level. High evaporation concentrates salts, making its water much denser than seawater.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Dead Sea na Earth's lowest land level and e dey salt pass ocean?
pcm.detail: The surface of the Dead Sea is the planet's lowest exposed land, about 430 meters below sea level. High evaporation concentrates salts, making its water much denser than seawater.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé Dead Sea ni ìpò ilẹ̀ tó kéré jùlọ lórí ilẹ̀-ayé, ó sì ju òkun lọ ní ìrun-ọdẹ?
yo.detail: The surface of the Dead Sea is the planet's lowest exposed land, about 430 meters below sea level. High evaporation concentrates salts, making its water much denser than seawater.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Dead Sea bụ ebe ala kacha ada ala n’ụwa ma siekwa mmiri karịa oke osimiri?
ig.detail: Elu nke Dead Sea bụ ala kacha ada anya pụọ n’osimiri, ihe dị ihe dịka 430 meters n’okpuru ọkwa mmiri; ntupu mmiri na-eme ka nnu dịtụkọbara, na-eme ka mmiri ya dị oke arọ karịa mmiri oke osimiri.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa Dead Sea ita ce mafi ƙananan tazara daga cikin ƙasa a Duniya kuma gishiyarta ta fi teku yawa?
ha.detail: Fuskar Dead Sea ita ce mafi ƙananan ƙasa da ke bayyane, kusan 430 meters ƙasa da matakin teku; yawan tafasa yana mai da gishiri ya taru, yana sa ruwanta ya fi maiko (denser) fiye da ruwan teku.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que la mer Morte est l'altitude terrestre la plus basse et qu'elle est plus saline que l'océan ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن البحر الميت هو أدنى سطح أرضي على الأرض وأكثر ملوحة من المحيط؟
ar.detail: سطح البحر الميت هو أدنى أرض مكشوفة على الكوكب، بحوالي 430 meters تحت مستوى سطح البحر؛ والترسبات العالية للتبخر تركز الأملاح وتزيد كثافة مياهه عن مياه البحر.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Bahari ya Wafu ndio eneo la chini kabisa la ardhi duniani, takriban 430 m chini ya usawa wa bahari, na maji yake ni chumvi zaidi kuliko bahari?
sw.detail: Uso wa Bahari ya Wafu ni sehemu ya chini kwa ardhi iliyo wazi, takriban 430 m chini ya usawa wa bahari; uvukaji mkubwa unaweka chumvi nyingi, na kufanya maji yake kuwa nzito zaidi kuliko maji ya bahari.

pt.fact: Sabias que o Mar Morto é a elevação de terra mais baixa da Terra e é mais salgado que o oceano?
pt.detail: A superfície do Mar Morto está cerca de 430 metros abaixo do nível do mar; a elevada evaporação concentra sais, tornando a sua água muito mais densa que a água do mar.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el Mar Muerto es la elevación de tierra más baja de la Tierra y es más salado que el océano?
es.detail: The surface of the Dead Sea is the planet's lowest exposed land, about 430 meters below sea level. High evaporation concentrates salts, making its water much denser than seawater.

subject: geography
picture: Aerial view of a wide tropical river with muddy water, multiple channels, and dense rainforest on both banks.

en.fact: Did you know the Nile and Amazon rivalry: the Nile is longest by tradition, the Amazon by water volume?
en.detail: The Nile has long been considered the longest river, but measurement methods vary. The Amazon carries far more water and has the largest drainage basin on Earth.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Nile and Amazon dey fight: Nile long pass by tradition, Amazon carry more water?
pcm.detail: The Nile has long been considered the longest river, but measurement methods vary. The Amazon carries far more water and has the largest drainage basin on Earth.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìjagun Nile àti Amazon: Nile ni gigun ni ìbílẹ̀, Amazon sì ni omi púpọ̀ jù lọ?
yo.detail: The Nile has long been considered the longest river, but measurement methods vary. The Amazon carries far more water and has the largest drainage basin on Earth.

ig.fact: Ị ma na asọmpi Nile na Amazon: Nile bụ ogologo site n’omume, Amazon karịa mmiri site n’olu?
ig.detail: A na-akpọ Nile ogologo river n’oge gara aga, ma usoro tụọ nwere ike ịdị iche; Amazon na-ebute mmiri karịrị nke ukwuu ma nwee nnukwu basịn mmiri nke kacha ibu n’ụwa.

ha.fact: Ka san cewa takaddamar Nile da Amazon: Nile ana ɗaukar ta mafi tsawo da al'ada, Amazon kuma ta fi ruwa yawan tafkawa?
ha.detail: An dade ana ɗaukar Nile a matsayin kogi mafi tsawo, amma hanyoyin auna suna bambanta; Amazon tana ɗauke da ruwa mai yawa kuma tana da babbar rumbun ruwa (drainage basin) a Duniya.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que la rivalité Nil‑Amazonie : le Nil est le plus long par tradition, l'Amazone l'est par débit d'eau ?

ar.fact: هل تعلم عن تنافس النيل والأمازون: النيل يُعتبر الأطول تقليديًا والأمازون الأكبر من حيث حجم المياه؟
ar.detail: طُرح النيل طويلاً كأطول نهر، لكن طرق القياس تختلف؛ الأمازون يحمل ماءً أكثر بكثير وله أكبر حوض صرف في العالم.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba mto Nile na Mto Amazon wana ushindani: Nile kwa jadi hubakia mrefu zaidi, Amazon hubeba maji mengi zaidi?
sw.detail: Nile imekuwa ikizingatiwa kuwa mto mrefu zaidi kwa jadi, lakini mbinu za upimaji zinatofautiana; Amazon inapita maji mengi zaidi na ina bonde kubwa zaidi la mifereji duniani.

pt.fact: Sabias que na rivalidade entre Nilo e Amazonas: o Nilo é o mais longo por tradição, o Amazonas tem mais caudal?
pt.detail: O Nilo tem sido considerado o rio mais longo, mas os métodos de medição variam; o Amazonas transporta muito mais água e possui a maior bacia hidrográfica da Terra.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el Nilo y el Amazonas compiten: el Nilo es el más largo por tradición y el Amazonas porta más agua?
es.detail: The Nile has long been considered the longest river, but measurement methods vary. The Amazon carries far more water and has the largest drainage basin on Earth.

subject: geography
picture: A rainforest hillside scene showing lush, unique plant life and a small, non-human primate perched on a branch (face not recognizably human).

en.fact: Did you know Madagascar split from Africa and has unique plants and animals found nowhere else?
en.detail: Madagascar separated from mainland Africa about 160 million years ago, allowing isolated evolution. Over 80% of its species are endemic, like lemurs and many plants.
