pcm.fact: You sabi say Madagascar don cut from Africa and e get plants and animals wey no dey any other place?
pcm.detail: Madagascar separate from mainland Africa about 160 million years ago, make evolution do im own work. Over 80% of the species for there na endemic, like lemurs and many plants.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Madagascar yà kúrò ní Áfíríkà àti pé ó ní irugbin àti ẹranko aláìmọ̀ tí a kò rí níbi míì?
yo.detail: Madagascar ya kúrò ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà nípa ọdún 160 mílíọ̀nù sẹ́yìn, tí ó jẹ́ kí ìyípadà nípò pẹ̀lú ìyàtọ̀ ṣẹlẹ̀; ju 80% àwọn ẹ̀yà rẹ̀ jẹ́ alágbèéká (endemic), bíi lemurs àti ọ̀pọ̀ igi àti ọ̀gbìn.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Madagascar kewara site na Afrika ma nwee osisi na anụmanụ pụrụ iche nke adịghị ebe ọzọ?
ig.detail: Madagascar kewara na mpaghara Afrika gbasara 160 miliọn afọ gara aga, nke nyere ndụ ebe ahụ ohere ịmepụta ụdị pụrụ iche na-enweghị mgbakwunye; karịrị 80% ụdị ya bụ ndị e nwere naanị n'ebe ahụ, dịka lemur na ọtụtụ osisi.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Madagascar ta rabu da Afirka kuma tana da tsirrai da dabbobi na musamman da ba a same su a ko'ina ba?
ha.detail: Madagascar ta rabu da nahiyar Afirka kusan shekaru 160 million da suka wuce, abin da ya ba da damar ci gaban halittu a keɓe; fiye da 80% na nau’o’in da ke can suna da keɓantattu, kamar lemurs da yawa daga tsirrai.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Madagascar s’est séparée de l’Afrique et abrite des plantes et des animaux uniques qu’on ne trouve nulle part ailleurs.
fr.detail: Madagascar s’est séparée du continent africain il y a environ 160 millions d’années, permettant une évolution isolée. Plus de 80 % de ses espèces sont endémiques, comme les lémuriens et de nombreuses plantes.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن مدغشقر انفصلت عن أفريقيا وتضم نباتات وحيوانات فريدة لا توجد في أي مكان آخر؟
ar.detail: انفصلت مدغشقر عن البر الرئيسي لأفريقيا منذ حوالي 160 مليون سنة، مما سمح بتطور معزول. أكثر من 80% من أنواعها متوطنة، مثل الليمور والعديد من النباتات.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Madagascar ilitengana na Afrika na ina mimea na wanyama wa kipekee ambao hawapatikani mahali pengine?
sw.detail: Madagascar ilitengana na Bara la Afrika takriban miaka 160 milioni iliyopita, ikiruhusu ueneaji wa viumbe kwa kutengwa; zaidi ya 80% ya spishi zake ni endemiki, kama lemuri na mimea mingi.

pt.fact: Sabias que Madagascar se separou de África e tem plantas e animais únicos que não existem em mais lado nenhum?
pt.detail: Madagascar separou‑se do continente africano há cerca de 160 milhões de anos, o que permitiu uma evolução isolada; mais de 80% das suas espécies são endémicas, como os lémures e muitas plantas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que Madagascar se separó de África y tiene plantas y animales únicos que no existen en ningún otro lugar?
es.detail: Madagascar separated from mainland Africa about 160 million years ago, allowing isolated evolution. Over 80% of its species are endemic, like lemurs and many plants.

subject: geography
picture: A dramatic landscape photo of a rift valley with steep escarpments, a river or lake in the valley, and layered rock formations.

en.fact: Did you know the East African Rift is slowly tearing a continent apart?
en.detail: The East African Rift is a system of faults where the African Plate is splitting into two. Over millions of years this rifting can form new ocean basins.

pcm.fact: You sabi say East African Rift dey slowly tear one continent apart?
pcm.detail: The East African Rift na system of faults wey the African Plate dey split into two. Over millions of years this rifting fit create new ocean basins.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Ilẹ̀ Rífù Ìlà-Oòrùn Áfíríkà ń wé kó ilẹ̀ kan sọ́ọ̀tọ̀ ní fífi ara rẹ̀ yọ?
yo.detail: Ilẹ̀ Rífù Ìlà-Oòrùn Áfíríkà jẹ́ eto ìfarapa ilẹ̀ (faults) níbi tí Apá Áfíríkà ti ń ya sí méjì; nígbà ọ̀pọ̀ mílíọ̀nù ọdún, ìyí yìí lè dáwọ̀n ìpẹ̀yà òkun tuntun sílẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Ogbugbu-East African Rift na-agbaji kọntinent nwayọ nwayọ?
ig.detail: East African Rift bụ usoro ntụpọ ebe Plọtụ Afrịka na-ekewa n'ime akụkụ abụọ; n’ime ọtụtụ nde afọ rifting a nwere ike ịmepụta ọdọ mmiri oke osimiri ọhụrụ.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Rafin Gabashin Afirka yana hankali-hankali yana shimfiɗa ƙasa yana raba nahiyar?
ha.detail: Rafin Gabashin Afirka tsarin tudu ne inda farantin Afirka ke fara rabuwa zuwa biyu; a cikin miliyoyin shekaru irin wannan rarrabuwa na iya haifar da sabbin tabkuna na teku.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La vallée du Rift est en train de déchirer lentement un continent.
fr.detail: La vallée du Rift d’Afrique de l’Est est un système de failles où la plaque africaine se scinde en deux. Sur des millions d’années, ce rift peut former de nouveaux bassins océaniques.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن صدع شرق أفريقيا يمزق القارة ببطء؟
ar.detail: صدع شرق أفريقيا نظام من الفوالق حيث تنقسم الصفيحة الأفريقية إلى جزأين. على مدى ملايين السنين يمكن لهذا التصدع أن يشكل أحواضًا محيطية جديدة.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Mteremko wa Afrika Mashariki unavunjwa taratibu na kuanza kutenganisha bara?
sw.detail: Mteremko wa Afrika Mashariki ni mfumo wa nyufa ambapo Pliti ya Afrika inagawanyika kuwa sehemu mbili; kwa mamilioni ya miaka mchakato huu unaweza kusababisha kuzaliwa kwa vibanzi vipya vya bahari.

pt.fact: Sabias que o Rifte da África Oriental está a afastar lentamente um continente?
pt.detail: O Rifte da África Oriental é um sistema de falhas onde a placa africana está a dividir‑se em duas; ao longo de milhões de anos este rifte pode formar novas bacias oceânicas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la Falla del Este de África está desgarrando lentamente un continente?
es.detail: The East African Rift is a system of faults where the African Plate is splitting into two. Over millions of years this rifting can form new ocean basins.

subject: geography
picture: An expansive canopy view of dense tropical rainforest with a winding river cutting through, photographed from above.

en.fact: Did you know the world's largest rainforest after the Amazon is the Congo Basin in Africa?
en.detail: The Congo Basin rainforest spans several central African countries and stores vast amounts of carbon. It's a global biodiversity and climate system hotspot.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the world's biggest rainforest after the Amazon na the Congo Basin for Africa?
pcm.detail: The Congo Basin rainforest spread across several central African countries and e dey store plenty carbon. E be global biodiversity and climate hotspot.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé igbó àgbáyé tó tobi lẹ́yìn Amazon ni Agbègbè Congo ní Áfíríkà?
yo.detail: Igbó Agbègbè Congo bo orílẹ̀-èdè arin Áfíríkà púpọ̀, ó sì tọju iye ńlá kárbònù; ó jẹ́ ibùgbé ìpínkiri ìmúlò oníyẹ̀lu àti ibi pàtàkì fún onírúurú ẹ̀dá àti afefe.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ebe ọhịa kachasị ukwuu n'ụwa mgbe Amazon gasịrị bụ Congo Basin na Afrịka?
ig.detail: Ebe ọhịa Congo Basin gbasaa n'ime ọtụtụ mba nke etiti Afrịka ma na-echekwa nnukwu miktarị karbon; ọ bụ ebe dị mkpa maka iche iche ụdị ndụ na usoro ihu igwe ụwa.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa gandun dajin da ya fi na biyu girma bayan Amazon shine Kwalamn Kongo a Afirka?
ha.detail: Gandun dajin Kogin Kongo ya mamaye ƙasashe da dama na tsakiyar Afirka kuma yana adana manyan ƙididdigar carbon; wuri ne mai matuƙar muhimmanci ga bambancin halittu da tsarin yanayi na duniya.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Après l’Amazonie, la plus grande forêt tropicale du monde est le bassin du Congo en Afrique.
fr.detail: La forêt du bassin du Congo couvre plusieurs pays d’Afrique centrale et stocke d’énormes quantités de carbone. C’est un point chaud mondial pour la biodiversité et le climat.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن ثاني أكبر غابة مطيرة في العالم بعد الأمازون هي حوض الكونغو في أفريقيا؟
ar.detail: تمتد غابات حوض الكونغو المطيرة عبر عدة دول في وسط أفريقيا وتخزن كميات هائلة من الكربون. إنها نقطة ساخنة عالمية للتنوع البيولوجي ونظام مناخي مهم.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba msitu mkubwa zaidi wa mvua duniani baada ya Amazon ni Bonde la Congo barani Afrika?
sw.detail: Msitu wa Bonde la Congo unashughulikia nchi kadhaa za Afrika ya Kati na unahifadhi kiasi kikubwa cha kaboni; ni kitovu cha utofauti wa viumbe na mfumo wa hali ya hewa duniani.

pt.fact: Sabias que a maior floresta tropical do mundo depois da Amazónia é a Bacia do Congo em África?
pt.detail: A floresta da Bacia do Congo estende‑se por vários países da África central e armazena enormes quantidades de carbono, sendo um ponto crítico de biodiversidade e do sistema climático global.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que después del Amazonas la selva tropical más grande del mundo es la cuenca del Congo en África?
es.detail: The Congo Basin rainforest spans several central African countries and stores vast amounts of carbon. It's a global biodiversity and climate system hotspot.

subject: geography
picture: A satellite-style photo of the Australian landmass showing its coastline, arid interior, and surrounding blue ocean, no labels.

en.fact: Did you know Australia is both the smallest continent and a very large country?
en.detail: Australia is the only landmass classified as a continent that is made up mostly of a single country. Its continental size is much larger than most countries but smallest among continents.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Australia na the smallest continent but na very big country too?
pcm.detail: Australia be the only landmass wey dem classify as continent wey mostly consist of one country. E big pass most countries but na the smallest among continents.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Australia jẹ́ kíkàn bíi ilẹ̀kùn-àyé kékeré jù lọ ṣùgbọ́n orílẹ̀-èdè ńlá púpọ̀?
yo.detail: Australia ni ìkan ṣoṣo lára àwọn apá-ilẹ̀ tí a kà sí kóntínẹ́ńtì tí ó jẹ́ ní púpọ̀ orílẹ̀-èdè kan ṣoṣo; ìwọn rẹ̀ jẹ́ ńlá ju òpò orílẹ̀-èdè lọ ṣùgbọ́n ó kéré jù àwọn kóntínẹ́ńtì mìíràn lọ.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Ọstrelia bụ kọntinent kacha nta ma ọ bụkwa nnukwu obodo nke onwe ya?
ig.detail: Ọstrelia bụ naanị ala a na-akpọ kọntinent nke e nwere otu obodo buru ibu n’ime ya; nha continental ya buru nnukwu karịa ọtụtụ mba mana ọ bụ nke kacha nta n’etiti kọntinent.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Ostiraliya ƙaramin nahiya ce amma ƙasa ce mai girma sosai?
ha.detail: Ostiraliya ita ce kadai ƙasa mai rata da aka ƙididdige a matsayin nahiya wadda galibi ƙasa ɗaya take kunshe da ita; girman nahiyar ya fi yawancin ƙasashe yawa amma ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin nahiyoyi.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? L’Australie est à la fois le plus petit continent et un très grand pays.
fr.detail: L’Australie est le seul continent constitué majoritairement d’un seul pays. Sa superficie continentale est beaucoup plus grande que celle de la plupart des pays, mais la plus petite parmi les continents.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أستراليا هي أصغر قارة وفي نفس الوقت دولة كبيرة جدًا؟
ar.detail: أستراليا هي الكتلة الأرضية الوحيدة المصنفة كقارة وتتألف في الغالب من دولة واحدة. مساحتها القارية أكبر بكثير من معظم الدول لكنها الأصغر بين القارات.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Australia ni bara ndogo kabisa na pia nchi kubwa sana?
sw.detail: Australia ndiyo eneo pekee lililoainishwa kama bara ambalo kwa sehemu kubwa linaundwa na nchi moja; ukubwa wa bara lake ni mkubwa zaidi kuliko nchi nyingi lakini ndogo miongoni mwa mabara.

pt.fact: Sabias que a Austrália é ao mesmo tempo o menor continente e um país muito grande?
pt.detail: A Austrália é a única massa terrestre classificada como continente que é composta em grande parte por um único país; é maior que a maioria dos países, mas é o menor entre os continentes.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que Australia es el continente más pequeño y a la vez un país muy grande?
es.detail: Australia is the only landmass classified as a continent that is made up mostly of a single country. Its continental size is much larger than most countries but smallest among continents.

subject: geography
picture: A vertical photo of a very tall, narrow waterfall plunging from a tabletop mountain into a misty forested gorge.

en.fact: Did you know the highest waterfall by total drop isn't the widest—Angel Falls drops far deeper than Niagara?
en.detail: Angel Falls in Venezuela has a single uninterrupted plunge of 979 meters, making it the tallest. Niagara is much wider and more powerful but far shorter.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the highest waterfall by total drop no be the widest—Angel Falls drop much deeper pass Niagara?
pcm.detail: Angel Falls for Venezuela get single uninterrupted plunge of 979 meters, that one make am the tallest. Niagara dey wider and powerful but e much shorter.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé ìwọ̀n omi tó ga jùlọ ní apapọ kì í ṣe pé ó pọ̀ jù—Angel Falls rì lórí jù Niagara lọ ní ìgbẹ̀yìn èèrò?
yo.detail: Angel Falls ní Venezuela ni ìjùmọ̀rọ̀ kan pàápàá tí ó tó 979 m, tó jẹ́ kí ó ga jùlọ; Niagara pọ̀ sí i ní ìwọ̀n àti agbára ṣùgbọ́n kúrò ní ìtòpiojú sílẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọdọ mmiri dara elu kacha ukwuu n'ụwa abụghị nke sara mbara—Angel Falls dara nke ukwuu karịa Niagara?
ig.detail: Angel Falls na Venezuela nwere nnukwu mmiri dara ozugbo 979 mita, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke kachasị elu; Niagara sara mbara ma nwee ike mmiri karịa ma dị mkpụmkpụ.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa rafin ruwa mafi tsayi ta jimilla ba shine mafi faɗi ba—Angel Falls ya faɗi nesa fiye da Niagara?
ha.detail: Angel Falls a Venezuela tana da tsalle guda mara tsagewa na 979 meters, wanda ke sanya ta mafi tsayi; Niagara tana da faɗi da ƙarfi amma tana da gajarta sosai.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La plus haute chute d’eau par dénivelé total n’est pas la plus large—Angel Falls tombe beaucoup plus bas que Niagara.
fr.detail: Les chutes d’Angel au Venezuela ont une chute ininterrompue de 979 mètres, ce qui en fait la plus haute. Niagara est bien plus large et plus puissante mais beaucoup moins haute.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أعلى شلال من حيث الانحدار الكلي ليس الأعرض—شلال أنجيل أعمق بكثير من نياغارا؟
ar.detail: يبلغ هبوط شلال أنجيل في فنزويلا 979 مترًا في سقوط واحد متواصل، مما يجعله الأعلى. نياغارا أعرض بكثير وأكثر قوة لكنه أقصر بكثير.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba mto wa maji kuanguka kwa urefu wa juu kabisa si mpana—Angel Falls unaanguka kwa kina kuliko Niagara?
sw.detail: Angel Falls nchini Venezuela ina maporomoko ya moja kwa moja ya 979 mita, na hii inafanya iwe ya juu zaidi; Niagara ni pana zaidi na yenye nguvu lakini ni fupi kwa urefu.

pt.fact: Sabias que a maior queda de água do mundo por altura total não é a mais larga—o Salto Ángel cai muito mais fundo do que as Cataratas do Niágara?
pt.detail: O Salto Ángel na Venezuela tem uma queda contínua de 979 metros, sendo a mais alta; as Cataratas do Niágara são muito mais largas e potentes, mas muito mais baixas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la cascada más alta por caída total no es la más ancha—el Salto Ángel cae mucho más profundo que las Cataratas del Niágara?
es.detail: Angel Falls in Venezuela has a single uninterrupted plunge of 979 meters, making it the tallest. Niagara is much wider and more powerful but far shorter.

subject: history
picture: A wide-angle photo of the Great Pyramid of Giza at sunrise, showing its four smooth faces and precise rectangular base against a clear sky, with no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know the Great Pyramid is aligned within minutes of true north?
en.detail: Surveyors show the Great Pyramid of Giza's sides face almost exactly north, south, east and west. Builders used careful astronomical observations, not modern tools, to achieve that precision.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Great Pyramid align almost dead-on to true north?
pcm.detail: Surveyors show the Great Pyramid of Giza sides face nearly exactly north, south, east and west. The builders use careful astronomical observation, no modern tools, to achieve that precision.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Ilẹ̀kùn Píramíì Nlá ti dàgbà sí ìtọ́ka inú ìṣọ́kan pẹ̀lú ìmú kan sí ìpínlà oòrùn gangan?
yo.detail: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìṣirò fi hàn pé ẹgbẹ́ Píramíì Giza dúró pẹ̀lú ìtọ́ka tó fẹrẹ̀ẹ́ tọ́ sí ìlà-àríwá, ìlà-níwọ̀n-ìwọ̀n, ìlà-òrùn àti ìlà-ìwọ̀-oòrùn; àwọn aṣáájú kọ́kọ́ lo ìmúlò ìràwọ̀ àti ìṣírò àgbáyé, kì í ṣe irinṣẹ́ ìgbà-ọwọ́, láti gbé àgbára yìí kalẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Ugwu Pyramid buru ibu dị n’Giza kwụ n’akụkụ nleta nke true north n’ime nkeji ole na ole?
ig.detail: Nnyocha egosila na akụkụ Great Pyramid of Giza na-ele fọdụrịta n’okpuruchi nke ọma—nke na-egosi na ndị owuwu jiri ịmụ kpakpando nke ọma kama ha ejighị ngwaọrụ oge a iji nweta izi ezi ahụ.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Babban Kwarin Masar an daidaita shi kusa da dakikoki daga arewa na gaskiya?
ha.detail: Binciken ma’aikata ya nuna gefen Babban Kwarin Giza sun fuskanci kusan daidai arewa, kudu, gabas da yamma; masu gini sun yi amfani da lura da taurari sosai ba tare da kayan zamani ba don cimma wannan daidaito.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La grande pyramide est alignée à quelques minutes près sur le vrai nord.
fr.detail: Les relevés montrent que les côtés de la Grande Pyramide de Gizeh sont presque exactement orientés vers le nord, le sud, l’est et l’ouest. Les bâtisseurs ont utilisé des observations astronomiques précises, sans outils modernes, pour atteindre cette précision.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الهرم الأكبر محاذٍ لشمال حقيقي بدقة دقائق؟
ar.detail: تُظهر قياسات المسّاحين أن جوانب الهرم الأكبر في الجيزة تواجه الشمال والجنوب والشرق والغرب تقريبًا بدقة عالية. استخدم البنّاؤون ملاحظات فلكية دقيقة، لا أدوات حديثة، لتحقيق هذه الدقة.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Piramidi Kuu imepangwa ndani ya dakika chache kutoka kaskazini halisi?
sw.detail: Ukaguzi unaonyesha kuwa pande za Piramidi Kuu za Giza zinaelekea karibu kabisa kaskazini, kusini, mashariki na magharibi; wajenzi walitumia uchunguzi wa anga kwa umakini, sio zana za kisasa, kupata usahihi huo.

pt.fact: Sabias que a Grande Pirâmide está alinhada com o norte verdadeiro com uma precisão de minutos?
pt.detail: Levantamentos mostram que os lados da Grande Pirâmide de Gizé apontam quase exatamente para norte, sul, este e oeste; os construtores alcançaram essa precisão usando observações astronómicas cuidadosas, não ferramentas modernas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la Gran Pirámide está alineada con el norte verdadero con solo unos minutos de diferencia?
es.detail: Surveyors show the Great Pyramid of Giza's sides face almost exactly north, south, east and west. Builders used careful astronomical observations, not modern tools, to achieve that precision.

subject: history
picture: A reconstructed mudbrick worker village site near ancient monuments, with bread ovens and stacked pottery, photographed from above, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Egyptian workers who built pyramids were paid food and shelter, not slaves?
en.detail: Archaeology finds worker villages, bakeries and health care near pyramid sites. Records and graves show organized laborers who received rations and medical treatment.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Egyptian workers wey build pyramids dem dey pay with food and shelter, dem no be slaves?
pcm.detail: Archaeology find worker villages, bakeries and health care near pyramid sites. Records and graves show organised labourers who receive rations and medical treatment.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé àwọn oṣiṣẹ́ Egypt tí kọ píramídì gba oúnjẹ àti ibùsùn, kì í ṣe ẹrú?
yo.detail: Ìwádìí onímọ̀-ònà ṣàfihàn ìlú àwọn oṣiṣẹ́, ibi idáná ìbàmẹ́sìn àti ìtọju ilera lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ ibùsítì píramídì; ìwé àti ibojì fi hàn pé wọ́n jẹ́ oṣiṣẹ́ amúṣepọ̀ tí ìjọ ṣe n pèsè rations àti ìtọju ìlera fun wọn.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ndị ọrụ ndị wuru pyramids ndị Ijipt na-enweta nri na ebe obibi kama ha abụghị ohu?
ig.detail: Nnyocha ihe ochie chọpụtara ime obodo ndị ọrụ, ebe esi achịọ acha na ụlọ ọgwụ nso saịtị pyramids; ndekọ na ụlọ ọnwụ gosipụtara ndị ọrụ e chepụtara nke ọma nke na-enweta nri na nlekọta ahụike.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa ma’aikatan Masar da suka gina kwarin an biya su da abinci da mafaka, ba bayi ba?
ha.detail: Gano wuraren zama ma’aikata, makera burodi da kulawar lafiya kusa da wuraren ginawa ya tabbatar; rubuce-rubuce da kaburbura sun nuna ma’aikata masu tsari waɗanda suke karɓar rabon abinci da maganin lafiya.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Les ouvriers qui ont construit les pyramides étaient payés en nourriture et logement, pas tous des esclaves.
fr.detail: Les fouilles archéologiques ont mis au jour des villages d’ouvriers, des boulangeries et des soins de santé près des sites des pyramides. Les archives et les sépultures montrent des travailleurs organisés qui recevaient des rations et des soins médicaux.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن العمال المصريين الذين بنوا الأهرامات كانوا يتقاضون طعامًا ومأوى وليسوا عبيدًا؟
ar.detail: تكشف الحفريات عن قرى للعمال ومخابز ورعاية صحية قرب مواقع الأهرامات. تظهر السجلات والقبور أن العمال المنظمين كانوا يتلقون حصصًا وعلاجًا طبيًا.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba wafanyakazi wa Misri waliounga mkono ujenzi wa piramidi walilipwa kwa chakula na makazi, si kama watumwa?
sw.detail: Utambuzi wa kihistoria unaonyesha makazi ya wafanyakazi, mabaki ya mabaki ya kuoka mkate na huduma za afya karibu na maeneo ya piramidi; rekodi na makaburi yanaonyesha wafanyakazi waliopangwa waliopokea rationi na matibabu.

pt.fact: Sabias que os trabalhadores que construíram as pirâmides eram pagos com comida e abrigo, não eram escravos?
pt.detail: A arqueologia revelou aldeias de trabalhadores, padarias e cuidados de saúde perto dos locais das pirâmides; registos e tumbas mostram trabalhadores organizados que recebiam rações e tratamento médico.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los trabajadores que construyeron las pirámides recibían comida y alojamiento, no eran esclavos?
es.detail: Archaeology finds worker villages, bakeries and health care near pyramid sites. Records and graves show organized laborers who received rations and medical treatment.

subject: history
picture: A close-up photo of the Rosetta Stone replica showing three distinct blocks of carved script textures, with museum display lighting but no visitors.

en.fact: Did you know the Rosetta Stone unlocked ancient Egyptian writing?
en.detail: The stone has the same text in hieroglyphs, Demotic and Ancient Greek. Comparing these scripts let scholars like Champollion decipher hieroglyphs in the 1820s.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Rosetta Stone na wetin unlock ancient Egyptian writing?
pcm.detail: The stone get the same text for hieroglyphs, Demotic and Ancient Greek. Comparing these scripts make scholars like Champollion decipher hieroglyphs in the 1820s.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Òkúta Rosetta ló ṣàfihàn bí a ṣe lè tú ìkọ̀wé ara Egypt atijọ́?
yo.detail: Òkúta náà ní ọrọ̀ kan náà ní hieroglyphs, Demotic àti Griiki Atijọ́; ìfiwéra àwọn àmì yìí jẹ́ kí àwọn onímọ̀ bí Champollion lè tú hieroglyphs ní ọdún 1820s.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Nkume Rosetta mepere ụzọ iji tụgharịa ide ihe ochie Ndị Ijipt?
ig.detail: Nkume ahụ nwere otu ederede n’ime hieroglyphs, Demotic na Greek ochie; ịtụnyere asụsụ ndị a nyere ndị amamihe dị ka Champollion ohere ịkọwa hieroglyphs na 1820s.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Dutsen Rosetta ya buɗe asirin rubutun Masar na dā?
ha.detail: Dutsen yana dauke da rubutu iri ɗaya cikin hieroglyphs, Demotic da Ancient Greek; kwatanta waɗannan rubutun ya ba wa masu ilimi kamar Champollion damar fassara hieroglyphs a shekarun 1820s.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La pierre de Rosette a permis de déchiffrer l’écriture égyptienne ancienne.
fr.detail: La pierre porte le même texte en hiéroglyphes, en démotique et en grec ancien. La comparaison de ces écritures a permis à des savants comme Champollion de déchiffrer les hiéroglyphes dans les années 1820.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن حجر رشيد فك شفرة الكتابة المصرية القديمة؟
ar.detail: يحوي الحجر نفس النص بالهيروغليفية والديموطيقية واليونانية القديمة. سمح المقارنة بين هذه الخطوط لعلماء مثل شامبوليون بتفكيك الهيروغليفية في عشرينيات القرن التاسع عشر.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Jiwe la Rosetta lilifungua siri ya uandishi wa Misri ya kale?
sw.detail: Jiwe hilo lina maandishi yale yale kwa herufi za hieroglyphic, Demotic na Kigiriki cha Kale; kulinganisha maandishi haya kuliwawezesha wataalamu kama Champollion kufasiri hieroglyphs katika miaka ya 1820.

pt.fact: Sabias que a Pedra de Roseta desbloqueou a escrita do antigo Egito?
pt.detail: A pedra contém o mesmo texto em hieróglifos, demótico e grego antigo; comparar esses sistemas permitiu a estudiosos como Champollion decifrar os hieróglifos na década de 1820.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la Piedra de Rosetta permitió descifrar la escritura egipcia antigua?
es.detail: The stone has the same text in hieroglyphs, Demotic and Ancient Greek. Comparing these scripts let scholars like Champollion decipher hieroglyphs in the 1820s.

subject: history
picture: A clay tablet with clear wedge-shaped cuneiform impressions resting on a neutral background, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know cuneiform was the first widespread writing system?
en.detail: Sumerians used wedge-shaped marks on clay tablets from about 3200 BCE to record laws, trade and stories. This breakthrough let civilizations keep long-term records.

pcm.fact: You sabi say cuneiform na the first widespread writing system?
pcm.detail: Sumerians dey use wedge-shaped marks on clay tablets from about 3200 BCE to record laws, trade and stories. This breakthrough allow civilizations keep long-term records.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé cuneiform ni eto ìkọ̀wé tó gbòòrò jùlọ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀?
yo.detail: Àwọn Sumeria máa ń lò àmì oní-Ẹrẹ̀kùsí (wedge-shaped) lórí amọ́ṣọ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ 3200 BCE láti forúkọṣilẹ̀ òfin, ìtajà àti ìtàn; ìmúlò yìí jẹ́ kí àwọn ìṣe ìjọba lè pa àkọsílẹ̀ pẹ́.

ig.fact: Ị ma na cuneiform bụ usoro ide mbụ gbasara nke ukwuu?
ig.detail: Sumerian jiri mgbakwunye akpụkpọkụ dị ka-ụkwụ n’elu mbadamba aja site na ihe dị ka 3200 BCE iji depụta iwu, ahịa na akụkọ; ngwọta a nyere ókèala ohere ịchekwa ndekọ ogologo oge.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa cuneiform ita ce tsarin rubutu na farko da ya bazu sosai?
ha.detail: Sumeriyawa sun yi amfani da alamomin kusurwa a kan allunan laka tun kusan 3200 BCE don rubuta doka, ciniki da labarai; wannan ci gaban ya ba da damar rikodin dogon lokaci ga al’ummomi.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Le cunéiforme a été le premier système d’écriture largement utilisé.
fr.detail: Les Sumériens ont tracé des signes en forme de clou sur des tablettes d’argile dès environ 3200 av. J.‑C. pour enregistrer lois, échanges et récits. Cette avancée a permis aux civilisations de conserver des archives sur le long terme.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الكتابة المسمارية كانت أول نظام كتابة واسع الانتشار؟
ar.detail: استخدم السومريون علامات إسفين على ألواح طينية منذ حوالي 3200 قبل الميلاد لتسجيل القوانين والتجارة والقصص. أتاح هذا الاختراع للحضارات حفظ سجلات طويلة الأمد.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba kuandikwa kwa cuneiform ilikuwa mfumo wa kwanza wa kuenea kwa upana?
sw.detail: Wasumer walitumia alama za umbo la kiwiko kwenye vidonge vya udongo kuanzia takriban 3200 BCE kurekodi sheria, biashara na hadithi; uvumbuzi huu uliwasaidia ustaarabu kuhifadhi rekodi za muda mrefu.

pt.fact: Sabias que a escrita cuneiforme foi o primeiro sistema de escrita amplamente usado?
pt.detail: Os sumérios usavam marcas em forma de cunha em tabuletas de barro desde cerca de 3200 a.C. para registar leis, comércio e histórias, permitindo às civilizações manter registos a longo prazo.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la escritura cuneiforme fue el primer sistema de escritura ampliamente usado?
es.detail: Sumerians used wedge-shaped marks on clay tablets from about 3200 BCE to record laws, trade and stories. This breakthrough let civilizations keep long-term records.

subject: history
picture: A panoramic shot of the stone enclosures and circular towers of Great Zimbabwe ruins set on a grassy hill, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Great Zimbabwe was built by local African societies, not outsiders?
en.detail: Archaeology links its massive stone walls and trade goods to indigenous Shona-speaking peoples between the 11th and 15th centuries. Excavations show local craftsmanship and continuity.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Great Zimbabwe build by local African societies, no be outsiders?
pcm.detail: Archaeology connect the massive stone walls and trade goods to indigenous Shona-speaking peoples between the 11th and 15th centuries. Excavations show local craftsmanship and continuity.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Great Zimbabwe ni àwọn agbègbè Afirika tó wà nítòsí kọ́, kì í ṣe àwọn ará òkèèrè, ló dá?
yo.detail: Ìwádìí onímọ̀-ìtàn-àyé fi ìjọpọ̀ ogiri apata ńlá àti ohun ìtajà hàn sí àwọn ènìyàn abinibi tí wọ́n sọ Shona láàrin ọrundún 11 sí 15; ìkànìyàn ṣewádìí fi hàn iṣẹ́ ọgbọ́n ọwọ́ abinibi àti ìtẹ̀síwájú.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Great Zimbabwe wuru site n’aka ọha ndị Afrịka obodo, ọ bụghị ndị si mba ọzọ?
ig.detail: Nnyocha ihe ochie jikọtara mgbidi nkume buru ibu na ngwa ahịa ahịa ya na ndị Shona na-asụ asụsụ isi obodo n’etiti narị afọ 11 ruo 15; nchọpụta gosiri nka ndị obodo na nbido nke ọdịnala.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Great Zimbabwe an gina shi ne da al’ummomin Afirka na gida, ba daga wuraren waje ba?
ha.detail: Binciken kayan tarihi ya danganta manyan bangarorin dutse da kayan ciniki da mutane masu magana da harshen Shona na gida tsakanin ƙarni na 11 da na 15; haƙar ƙasa ta nuna ƙwarewar gida da ci gaba.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Le Grand Zimbabwe a été construit par des sociétés africaines locales, pas par des étrangers.
fr.detail: Les recherches archéologiques relient ses immenses murailles de pierre et ses objets d’échange aux peuples autochtones de langue shona entre le XIe et le XVe siècle. Les fouilles montrent un savoir‑faire local et une continuité culturelle.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن زيمبابوي العظمى بناها مجتمعات أفريقية محلية وليس أجانب؟
ar.detail: تربط الحفريات جدرانها الحجرية الضخمة والسلع التجارية بشعوب شونا المتحدثة المحلية بين القرنين الحادي عشر والخامس عشر. تظهر الحفريات الحرفية المحلية والاستمرارية الثقافية.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Great Zimbabwe ilijengwa na jamii za wenyeji wa Afrika, sio watu wa nje?
sw.detail: Ariadhablaji inaunganisha kuta zake za mawe mazito na bidhaa za biashara na watu wetu wa asili wanaozungumza Kishona kati ya karne ya 11 na 15; uchimbaji unaonyesha ufundi wa ndani na muendelezo wa kitamaduni.

pt.fact: Sabias que Great Zimbabwe foi construído por sociedades africanas locais, não por forasteiros?
pt.detail: A arqueologia liga as enormes paredes de pedra e os bens comerciais aos povos indígenas falantes de língua shona entre os séculos XI e XV; as escavações mostram artesanato e continuidade local.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que Gran Zimbabue fue construido por sociedades africanas locales, no por forasteros?
es.detail: Archaeology links its massive stone walls and trade goods to indigenous Shona-speaking peoples between the 11th and 15th centuries. Excavations show local craftsmanship and continuity.

subject: history
picture: A historic-style glass vaccine vial and a clean syringe on a sterile tray, photographed close-up with a plain background and no people.

en.fact: Did you know smallpox was the first disease to be eradicated by vaccination?
en.detail: Global vaccination campaigns led by WHO eliminated naturally occurring smallpox by 1980. The approach began with Jenner's 18th-century work on cowpox protection.

pcm.fact: You sabi say smallpox na the first disease wey vaccination finish?
pcm.detail: Global vaccination campaigns led by WHO eliminate naturally occurring smallpox by 1980. The approach start with Jenner's 18th-century work on cowpox protection.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé ọrùn òfóró (smallpox) ni àìsàn àkọ́kọ́ tí a parípatá nípasẹ̀ ajẹsara?
yo.detail: Àwọn ìṣèjọba ajẹsara àgbáyé, tí WHO darí, pa àìsàn smallpox run nípa 1980; ìlànà yìí bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú iṣẹ́ Jenner ní ọ̀rúndún 18 nípa aabo cowpox.

ig.fact: Ị ma na smallpox bụ ọrịa mbụ ewepụrụ kpamkpam site n’ogo ọgwụ mgbochi?
ig.detail: Mmasị ọgwụ mgbochi ụwa nke WHO duziri mere ka smallpox nke na-emetụta ụwa kwụsịrị site n’aka okwukwe n’afọ 1980; usoro a malitere na ọrụ Jenner na narị afọ 18 banyere nchebe cowpox.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa cutar ƙuraje (smallpox) ita ce cuta ta farko da aka kawar ta hanyar rigakafi?
ha.detail: Kamfen ɗin rigakafi na duniya da WHO ta jagoranta sun kawar da faruwar smallpox ta halitta nan da 1980; hanyar ta fara ne da aikin Jenner a ƙarni na 18 kan kariyar cowpox.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La variole a été la première maladie éradiquée par la vaccination.
fr.detail: Les campagnes mondiales de vaccination menées par l’OMS ont permis d’éliminer la variole naturelle en 1980. Cette approche remonte aux travaux de Jenner au XVIIIe siècle sur la protection par la vaccine.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الجدري كان أول مرض يُقضى عليه بالتطعيم؟
ar.detail: قادت حملات التطعيم العالمية التي نظمتها منظمة الصحة العالمية إلى القضاء على الجدري المستمرار طبيعيًا بحلول 1980. بدأ النهج بعمل جينر في القرن الثامن عشر حول حماية مرض البقر.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba ugonjwa wa kichaa wa ndovu (smallpox) ulikuwa ugonjwa wa kwanza kuondolewa kwa chanjo?
sw.detail: Kampeni za chanjo za kimataifa ziliongozwa na WHO zilipelekea kuondolewa kwa smallpox kwa asili ifikapo 1980; mbinu hiyo ilianza na kazi ya Jenner karne ya 18 kuhusu kinga kwa cowpox.

pt.fact: Sabias que a varíola foi a primeira doença erradicada pela vacinação?
pt.detail: Campanhas de vacinação globais lideradas pela OMS eliminaram a varíola natural em 1980; a abordagem começou com o trabalho de Jenner no século XVIII com a protecção dada pela varíola bovina.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la viruela fue la primera enfermedad erradicada mediante vacunación?
es.detail: Global vaccination campaigns led by WHO eliminated naturally occurring smallpox by 1980. The approach began with Jenner's 18th-century work on cowpox protection.

subject: history
picture: A scientific photo of a microscope slide preparation or high-resolution micrograph of rod-shaped bacteria stained against a dark background, no people.

en.fact: Did you know the Black Death was caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis?
en.detail: DNA from medieval victims confirms Yersinia pestis caused many 14th-century plague outbreaks. The disease spread rapidly via fleas on rodents and human movement.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Black Death na bacterium Yersinia pestis cause?
pcm.detail: DNA from medieval victims confirm Yersinia pestis cause many 14th-century plague outbreaks. The disease spread fast through fleas on rodents and human movement.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Ajẹsára Dúdú (Black Death) jẹ́ nítorí kokoro arun Yersinia pestis?
yo.detail: DNA láti ara àwọn tí wọ́n kú nígbà arẹ̀wà arúgbó fihan pé Yersinia pestis fa púpọ̀ àwọn àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn ní ọ̀rúndún 14; arúgbó náà tan kán nípasẹ̀ ọrẹ́-òkìkí (fleas) lórí àkàkọ̀ àti ìrìnàjò ènìyàn.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Black Death kpatara bacterium Yersinia pestis?
ig.detail: DNA sitere n’ahụ ndị nwụrụ n’oge etiti gosiri na Yersinia pestis kpatara ọtụtụ mgbasa ọrịa n’afọ 14th; ọrịa a gbasasịrị ngwa site na tick nke ndị ọrịa na-ebu na ụbọchi na mmegharị mmadụ.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Barkewar Baƙin Mortan (Black Death) ta samo asali ne daga ƙwayar cuta Yersinia pestis?
ha.detail: DNA daga gawawwakin mutane na zamanin tsakiyar zamani ya tabbatar da cewa Yersinia pestis ce ta haddasa yawancin barkewar annoba na ƙarni na 14; cutar ta bazu cikin sauri ta hanyar tsutsotsi a jikin beraye da motsin mutane.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La peste noire était causée par la bactérie Yersinia pestis.
fr.detail: L’ADN extrait de victimes médiévales confirme que Yersinia pestis a provoqué de nombreuses épidémies de peste au XIVe siècle. La maladie se propageait rapidement via les puces sur les rongeurs et par les déplacements humains.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الطاعون الأسود سببه البكتيريا يرسينيا بيستس؟
ar.detail: تؤكد الحمض النووي من ضحايا القرون الوسطى أن يرسينيا بيستس سببت العديد من تفشيات الطاعون في القرن الرابع عشر. انتشر المرض بسرعة عبر البراغيث على القوارض وحركة البشر.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Wafu wa Giza waliosababisha Kifo Kizito (Black Death) walisababishwa na bakteria Yersinia pestis?
sw.detail: DNA kutoka kwa wahanga wa wakati wa kati imethibitisha kuwa Yersinia pestis ilisababisha milipuko mingi ya ugonjwa huo katika karne ya 14; ugonjwa huo ulienea kwa haraka kupitia ndungu za vimelea kwenye panya na harakati za binadamu.

pt.fact: Sabias que a Peste Negra foi causada pela bactéria Yersinia pestis?
pt.detail: O ADN de vítimas medievais confirma que a Yersinia pestis causou muitas epidemias de peste no século XIV; a doença espalhou‑se rapidamente através de pulgas em roedores e do movimento humano.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la Peste Negra fue causada por la bacteria Yersinia pestis?
es.detail: DNA from medieval victims confirms Yersinia pestis caused many 14th-century plague outbreaks. The disease spread rapidly via fleas on rodents and human movement.

subject: history
picture: Aerial photo of small rectangular plots of green crops separated by narrow waterways, resembling a patchwork of floating gardens, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Aztec farmers grew food on floating gardens called chinampas?
en.detail: Chinampas were raised planting beds built in shallow lakes around Mexico City. They produced high yields and supported dense urban populations before Spanish conquest.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Aztec farmers dey grow food for floating gardens wey dem call chinampas?
pcm.detail: Chinampas na raised planting beds wey dem build for shallow lakes around Mexico City. Dem produce high yields and support dense urban populations before the Spanish conquer.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé awọn agbẹ Aztec gbìn oúnjẹ lórí ọgbà tí ń fò (chinampas)?
yo.detail: Chinampas jẹ́ àga ìgbìn tí a gbé sẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ òkun pẹlẹbẹ nígbà ilẹ̀ tó wà lórí omi ní ìgbè Mexico City; wọ́n ń ṣe agbára oúnjẹ gíga tí ó sì ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti gbé àwọn ìlú tí ó kún ṣáájú ìyọkúrò Spain.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ndị ọrụ ugbo Aztec nwere ubi na-etolite n’elu mmiri akpọrọ chinampas?
ig.detail: Chinampas bụ ọdụ ubi wụrụ elu wuru n’ime ọdọ mmiri dị miri gburugburu obodo Mexico; ha na-enye mmepụta buru ibu nke kwadoro nnukwu ndị bi n’obodo tupu mwakpo Spanish.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa manoman Aztecs sun noma abinci a gonaki masu iyo da ake kira chinampas?
ha.detail: Chinampas su ne shimfidar gadon shuka da aka daga a cikin tabkuna masu ƙasa kusa da birnin Mexico; sun samar da yawan amfanin gona mai yawa kuma sun tallafa wa yawan jama’a kafin mamayar Mutanen Spain.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? Les paysans aztèques cultivaient sur des jardins flottants appelés chinampas.
fr.detail: Les chinampas étaient des lits de culture surélevés construits dans des lacs peu profonds autour de Mexico. Ils produisaient des rendements élevés et soutenaient des populations urbaines denses avant la conquête espagnole.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن فلاحي الأزتك زرعوا محاصيل على حدائق عائمة تُسمى تشينامباس؟
ar.detail: كانت التشينامباس أحواضًا مرتفعة للزراعة بُنيت في بحيرات ضحلة حول مدينة مكسيكو. أنتجت محاصيل غزيرة ودعمت كثافة سكانية عالية قبل الغزو الإسباني.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba wakulima wa Aztec walilima chakula kwenye bustani zinazoyeyuka zinazoitwa chinampas?
sw.detail: Chinampas zilikuwa vifuko vya kupanda vilivyoinuliwa vilivyojengwa katika maziwa ya kina kidogo karibu na Mji wa Mexico; zilitoa mazao mengi na kuunga mkono idadi kubwa ya watu wa miji kabla ya ushindi wa Wahispania.

pt.fact: Sabias que os agricultores astecas cultivavam em jardins flutuantes chamados chinampas?
pt.detail: As chinampas eram canteiros levantados em lagos rasos à volta da Cidade do México; produziam altos rendimentos e sustentavam populações urbanas densas antes da conquista espanhola.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los agricultores aztecas cultivaban en jardines flotantes llamados chinampas?
es.detail: Chinampas were raised planting beds built in shallow lakes around Mexico City. They produced high yields and supported dense urban populations before Spanish conquest.

subject: history
picture: A long, empty desert trade route with camel caravans' tracks and distant hills under a wide sky, no people or animals visible in the frame.

en.fact: Did you know the Mongol Empire connected East and West for trade and ideas?
en.detail: By the 13th century Mongol rule linked Asia and Europe, reopening and protecting trade routes like the Silk Road. This increased exchange of goods, technologies and knowledge.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the Mongol Empire connect East and West for trade and ideas?
pcm.detail: By the 13th century Mongol rule link Asia and Europe, reopen and protect trade routes like the Silk Road. This increase exchange of goods, technologies and knowledge.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Ìjọba Mongol so Iwọ̀-Ìlà àti Ọ̀run-Ọ́run jọ fún ìtajà àti ìmọ̀?
yo.detail: Ní ọrundún 13, ìṣàkóso Mongol darapọ̀ Asia àti Europe, òun sì tún tún ṣí àti dáabò bo ọ̀nà ọjà bí Silk Road; èyí mu ìpínkiri ohun èlò, ìmọ̀ ẹrọ àti ìmọ̀ pọ̀ sí i.

ig.fact: Ị ma na Alaeze Mongol jikọtara East na West maka ahia na echiche?
ig.detail: N’afọ 13th Mongol n’ire rule jikọtara Asia na Europe, mepee ma chekwaa ụzọ ahia dị ka Silk Road; nke a nyere ngwa ahịa, teknụzụ na ọmụma ịkekọrịta n’ụzọ sara mbara.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa Daular Mongol ta haɗa Gabas da Yamma don kasuwanci da musayar ra’ayi?
ha.detail: A ƙarni na 13 mulkin Mongol ya haɗa Asiya da Turai, yana sake buɗe da kare hanyoyin kasuwanci kamar Hanyar Silk; hakan ya ƙara musayar kaya, fasahohi da ilimi.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? L’Empire mongol a relié l’Est et l’Ouest pour le commerce et les idées.
fr.detail: Au XIIIe siècle, la domination mongole a relié l’Asie et l’Europe, rouvrant et protégeant des routes commerciales comme la Route de la soie. Cela a accru les échanges de marchandises, de techniques et de savoirs.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الإمبراطورية المغولية ربطت الشرق بالغرب للتجارة وتبادل الأفكار؟
ar.detail: بحلول القرن الثالث عشر ربط الحكم المغولي آسيا بأوروبا، فأعاد فتح وحمى طرق التجارة كالطريق الحريري. زاد هذا من تبادل السلع والتقنيات والمعرفة.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba Empire ya Mongol iliunganisha Mashariki na Magharibi kwa ajili ya biashara na mawazo?
sw.detail: Madiwani ya karne ya 13 ya Mongol yalihusisha Asia na Ulaya, ikirejesha na kulinda njia za biashara kama Njia ya Hariri; hili liliimarisha kubadilishana kwa bidhaa, teknolojia na maarifa.

pt.fact: Sabias que o Império Mongol ligou o Oriente e o Ocidente para comércio e ideias?
pt.detail: No século XIII o domínio mongol ligou a Ásia e a Europa, reabrindo e protegendo rotas comerciais como a Rota da Seda, o que aumentou a troca de bens, tecnologias e conhecimentos.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el Imperio mongol conectó Oriente y Occidente para el comercio y las ideas?
es.detail: By the 13th century Mongol rule linked Asia and Europe, reopening and protecting trade routes like the Silk Road. This increased exchange of goods, technologies and knowledge.

subject: history
picture: A detailed photo of an early-style bronze cannon barrel placed horizontally on wooden supports, shot from the side with no people.

en.fact: Did you know gunpowder was invented in China and changed warfare worldwide?
en.detail: Chinese alchemists developed gunpowder by the 9th century; it later spread to the Middle East and Europe. Its use led to new weapons like cannons and firearms.

pcm.fact: You sabi say gunpowder invent for China and e change war all over the world?
pcm.detail: Chinese alchemists develop gunpowder by the 9th century; later e spread to the Middle East and Europe. The use of gunpowder lead to new weapons like cannons and firearms.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé ìjẹ́pọ̀gun (gunpowder) ni a dá sílẹ̀ ní Ṣáínà àti pé ó yí ìjà padà kọ́ọ̀kan?
yo.detail: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìjẹ́-òmí Ṣáínà ṣe ìdàgbàsókè gunpowder ní ọrundún kẹsán (9th century); ó tan kalẹ̀ sí Ilẹ̀-árà-mẹ́dọ̀lá àti Yúróòpù, ó sì dá àwọn ohun ija tuntun bí cannons àti firearms sílẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị ma na gunpowder chọpụtara na China wee gbanwee agha n'ụwa niile?
ig.detail: Ndị alchemy China mepụtara gunpowder site na narị afọ nke 9; o jisiri banye Middle East na Europe, wee mepụta ngwa agha ọhụrụ dịka cannon na egbe.

ha.fact: Ko ka sani cewa barasa (gunpowder) an ƙirƙire ta ne a China kuma ta sauya yaƙe-yaƙe a duniya?
ha.detail: Alkimiyoyin China sun haɓaka gunpowder tun a ƙarni na 9; daga baya ya bazu zuwa Gabas ta Tsakiya da Turai, kuma amfani da shi ya haifar da makamai kamar bama-bamai da bindigogi.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous ? La poudre à canon a été inventée en Chine et a changé la guerre dans le monde.
fr.detail: Des alchimistes chinois ont mis au point la poudre à canon au IXe siècle ; elle s’est ensuite répandue au Moyen‑Orient et en Europe. Son utilisation a donné naissance à de nouvelles armes comme les canons et les armes à feu.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن البارود اخترع في الصين وغير شكل الحروب في العالم؟
ar.detail: طور الكيميائيون الصينيون البارود بحلول القرن التاسع؛ ثم انتشر إلى الشرق الأوسط وأوروبا. أدى استخدامه إلى ظهور أسلحة جديدة مثل المدافع والأسلحة النارية.

sw.fact: Je, unajua kwamba kiberiti cha bunduki kilizaliwa China na kilibadilisha vita kote duniani?
sw.detail: Waalchemista wa Kichina walitengeneza kiberiti cha bunduki kufikia karne ya 9; baadaye kilienea Mashariki ya Kati na Ulaya na kusababisha matumizi ya silaha mpya kama kanuni na bunduki.

pt.fact: Sabias que a pólvora foi inventada na China e transformou a guerra em todo o mundo?
pt.detail: Alquimistas chineses desenvolveram a pólvora já no século IX; ela espalhou‑se para o Médio Oriente e a Europa e levou ao aparecimento de novas armas como canhões e armas de fogo.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la pólvora se inventó en China y cambió la guerra en todo el mundo?
es.detail: Chinese alchemists developed gunpowder by the 9th century; it later spread to the Middle East and Europe. Its use led to new weapons like cannons and firearms.

subject: technology
picture: A realistic photo of a large insulated fibre-optic cable being coiled on the deck of a specialised cable-laying ship at sea, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know undersea cables carry around 97% of the world’s international internet traffic?
en.detail: Most global data—websites, calls and streaming—travels through long fibre-optic cables laid on the ocean floor. Satellites handle only a small fraction because cables are faster and cheaper per gigabyte.

pcm.fact: You sabi say undersea cables dey carry around 97% of the world’s international internet traffic?
pcm.detail: Most global data—websites, calls and streaming—dey travel through long fibre-optic cables wey dem lay for the ocean floor; satellites dey handle only small fraction because cables faster and cheaper per gigabyte.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn kábùùlù abẹ́ òkun ń gbe nípa 97% ti ìrìnàjò intanẹẹti àgbáyé?
yo.detail: Most global data—websites, calls and streaming—travels through long fibre-optic cables laid on the ocean floor. Satellites handle only a small fraction because cables are faster and cheaper per gigabyte.

ig.fact: Ị ma na eriri n'oké osimiri na-ebufe ihe dị ka 97% nke njem ịntanetị mba ụwa?
ig.detail: Most global data—websites, calls and streaming—travels through long fibre-optic cables laid on the ocean floor. Satellites handle only a small fraction because cables are faster and cheaper per gigabyte.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa kebul ɗin ƙarƙashin teku na ɗauke da kusan 97% na zirga-zirgar intanet ɗin ƙasa da ƙasa?
ha.detail: Yawancin bayanai na duniya—rintsi na yanar gizo, kiran waya da yawo—suna tafiya ta dogayen kebul na fiber-optic da aka shimfiɗa a ƙasan teku; tauraron ɗan adam yana ɗaukar ƙanƙanin kaso ne kawai saboda kebul ya fi sauri kuma ya fi arha a kowane gigabyte.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que des câbles sous-marins transportent environ 97 % du trafic Internet international mondial ?
fr.detail: La plupart des données mondiales — sites web, appels et streaming — circulent via de longues fibres optiques posées au fond des océans ; les satellites ne prennent qu’une faible part parce que les câbles sont plus rapides et moins chers par gigaoctet.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الكابلات البحرية تنقل نحو 97% من حركة الإنترنت الدولية في العالم؟
ar.detail: تسافر معظم البيانات العالمية—المواقع والمكالمات والبث—عبر كابلات ألياف ضوئية طويلة موضوعة على قاع المحيط. تتعامل الأقمار الصناعية مع جزء صغير فقط لأن الكابلات أسرع وأرخص لكل غيغابايت.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba nyaya za chini ya bahari hubeba karibu 97% ya trafiki ya kimataifa ya intaneti?
sw.detail: Most global data—websites, calls and streaming—travels through long fibre-optic cables laid on the ocean floor. Satellites handle only a small fraction because cables are faster and cheaper per gigabyte.

pt.fact: Sabias que cabos submarinos transportam cerca de 97% do tráfego internacional de internet do mundo?
pt.detail: A maior parte dos dados globais — sites, chamadas e streaming — viaja por longos cabos de fibra óptica colocados no fundo do oceano. Os satélites lidam apenas com uma pequena fracção porque os cabos são mais rápidos e mais baratos por gigabyte.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los cables submarinos transportan alrededor del 97% del tráfico internacional de internet del mundo?
es.detail: La mayor parte de los datos globales—sitios web, llamadas y streaming—viajan por cables de fibra óptica largos instalados en el fondo marino. Los satélites sólo manejan una pequeña fracción porque los cables son más rápidos y más baratos por gigabyte.

subject: technology
picture: A close-up, high-resolution photo of an old electromechanical relay panel with a small preserved moth specimen placed beside it on neutral background, no people.

en.fact: Did you know the first computer 'bug' was a real moth trapped in a relay in 1947?
en.detail: Engineers found a moth stuck in an early electromechanical computer’s relay and taped it into the log as the 'bug'. The term 'bug' for faults existed earlier, but this incident is a famous literal example.

pcm.fact: You sabi say the first computer 'bug' na real moth wey get trapped for relay for 1947?
pcm.detail: Engineers find moth stuck for early electromechanical computer relay and dem tape am enter log as the 'bug'; the word 'bug' for faults dey earlier, but this one na famous literal example.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé “bug” kọ̀m̀pútà àkọ́kọ́ jẹ́ moth gidi tí wọ́n rí sínú relè ní 1947?
yo.detail: Engineers found a moth stuck in a relay and taped it into the log as the 'bug'. The term 'bug' for faults existed earlier, but this incident is a famous literal example.

ig.fact: Ị ma na 'bug' kọmputa mbụ bụ ihere n'ezie — moth jidere n'ime relay na 1947?
ig.detail: Engineers found a moth stuck in an early electromechanical computer’s relay and taped it into the log as the 'bug'. The term 'bug' for faults existed earlier, but this incident is a famous literal example.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa ‘kwari’ na farko a kwamfuta gaskiya maciji ne wato ƙwari (moth) da ya makale a cikin relay a 1947?
ha.detail: Injiniyoyi sun sami wata moth da ta makale a cikin relay na farko na kwamfuta wacce ta yi amfani da lantarki da na'urorin inji, suka liƙa ta a cikin rajista a matsayin ‘bug’; kalmar ‘bug’ don kurakurai ta riga ta wanzu amma wannan lamari ya zama misali na harƙalla.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que le premier « bug » informatique était un vrai papillon coincé dans un relais en 1947 ?
fr.detail: Des ingénieurs ont trouvé un papillon bloqué dans le relais d’un ancien ordinateur électromécanique et l’ont collé dans le journal de bord comme le « bug » ; le mot existait déjà, mais cet incident est un exemple littéral célèbre.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن أول 'عطل' في الحواسيب كان حرفياً عثة علقت في مرحل عام 1947؟
ar.detail: عثر المهندسون على عثة عالقة في مرحل في حاسوب كهروميكانيكي مبكر ولصقوها في سجل الأخطاء باسم 'العتبة'. كان مصطلح 'خطأ' مستخدماً سابقاً، لكن هذا الحادث هو مثال حرفي مشهور.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba 'bug' ya kwanza ya kompyuta ilikuwa angae halisi aliyekwama katika relay mnamo 1947?
sw.detail: Engineers found a moth stuck in an early electromechanical computer’s relay and taped it into the log as the 'bug'. The term 'bug' for faults existed earlier, but this incident is a famous literal example.

pt.fact: Sabias que o primeiro 'bug' de computador foi uma mariposa presa num relé em 1947?
pt.detail: Engenheiros encontraram uma mariposa presa no relé de um computador eletromecânico primitivo e colaram-na no diário como o 'bug'. O termo 'bug' para falhas já existia antes, mas este incidente é um famoso exemplo literal.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el primer 'bug' informático fue una polilla real atrapada en un relé en 1947?
es.detail: Los ingenieros encontraron una polilla atascada en el relé de una computadora electromecánica temprana y la pegaron en el registro como el 'bug'. El término 'bug' para fallos existía antes, pero este incidente es un ejemplo literal famoso.

subject: technology
picture: A realistic image of a model GPS satellite against a plain sky background, showing solar panels and antenna, no people or text.

en.fact: Did you know GPS needs Einstein's relativity to give accurate locations?
en.detail: Satellites' clocks tick faster than clocks on Earth because of both special and general relativity. Engineers correct for these tiny time shifts so GPS positions stay accurate to meters.

pcm.fact: You sabi say GPS need Einstein relativity make e give correct locations?
pcm.detail: Satellites’ clocks dey tick faster than clocks for Earth because of both special and general relativity, so engineers dey correct those small time shifts to keep GPS accurate to meters.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé GPS nílò ìmúlò Einstein (relativity) kí ó lè fún ní ipo tó pé?
yo.detail: Satellites' clocks tick faster than clocks on Earth because of both special and general relativity. Engineers correct for these tiny time shifts so GPS positions stay accurate to meters.

ig.fact: Ị ma na GPS chọrọ ntụziaka Einstein nke relativity iji nye ọnọdụ ziri ezi?
ig.detail: Satellites' clocks tick faster than clocks on Earth because of both special and general relativity. Engineers correct for these tiny time shifts so GPS positions stay accurate to meters.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa GPS na buƙatar ilimin Einstein na dangi da na musamman don samar da madaidaiciyar matsayi?
ha.detail: Agogon tauraron ɗan adam na bugun sauri fiye da na ƙasa saboda tasirin dangi da na musamman na relativity; injiniyoyi suna gyara waɗannan ƙananan canje-canje na lokaci don ƙarin daidaito zuwa mita.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que le GPS a besoin de la relativité d’Einstein pour fournir des positions précises ?
fr.detail: Les horloges des satellites avancent plus vite que celles sur Terre à cause de la relativité spéciale et générale ; les ingénieurs corrigent ces très faibles décalages temporels pour que les positions GPS restent précises à la métre près.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن نظام تحديد المواقع GPS يحتاج إلى نسبية أينشتاين ليعطي مواقع دقيقة؟
ar.detail: تدق ساعات الأقمار الصناعية أسرع من الساعات على الأرض بسبب نسبية خاصة وعامة معاً. يصحح المهندسون هذه التحولات الزمنية الصغيرة حتى تبقى مواقع GPS دقيقة لمدى أمتار.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba GPS inahitaji nadharia ya uhusiano wa Einstein ili kutoa maeneo sahihi?
sw.detail: Satellites' clocks tick faster than clocks on Earth because of both special and general relativity. Engineers correct for these tiny time shifts so GPS positions stay accurate to meters.

pt.fact: Sabias que o GPS precisa da relatividade de Einstein para dar localizações precisas?
pt.detail: Os relógios dos satélites andam mais depressa do que os relógios na Terra por causa da relatividade restrita e geral. Os engenheiros corrigem essas pequenas diferenças de tempo para que as posições do GPS se mantenham precisas a metros.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el GPS necesita la relatividad de Einstein para dar ubicaciones precisas?
es.detail: Los relojes de los satélites funcionan más rápido que los de la Tierra por efectos de la relatividad especial y general. Los ingenieros corrigen esos pequeños desfases temporales para que las posiciones del GPS sigan siendo precisas a metros.
