pcm.detail: New satellite constellations fit connect remote areas cheaply, but fibre-optic cables remain primary for bulk, low-latency backbone traffic; both technologies dey complement each other.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé satẹ́lítì lè pèsè intanẹẹti sí àgbègbè jìnnà ṣùgbọ́n kábùùlù abẹ́ òkun ṣi ń gbé púpọ̀ jùlọ ìkópa ìrìnàjò?
yo.detail: New satellite constellations can connect remote areas with lower infrastructure cost, but fibre-optic cables remain primary for bulk, low-latency backbone traffic. Both technologies are complementary.

ig.fact: Ị ma na satịlaịtị na-enye ịntanetị n'ebe ndị dịpụrụ adịpụ ma eriri n'oké osimiri ka na-ebufe ọtụtụ ibu njem?
ig.detail: New satellite constellations can connect remote areas with lower infrastructure cost, but fibre-optic cables remain primary for bulk, low-latency backbone traffic. Both technologies are complementary.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa tauraron‑dan‑adam na samar da intanet zuwa wurare masu nisa amma kebul ɗin ƙarƙashin teku har yanzu suna ɗaukar yawancin manyan zirga‑zirga?
ha.detail: Sabbin gungun tauraron‑dan‑adam na iya haɗa wurare masu nisa da farashi ƙasa wajen gina kayayyaki, amma kebul‑na‑fiber suna nan gabaɗaya don manyan bayanai da ƙarancin jinkiri; duka fasahohi na cike gurbin juna.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que des satellites fournissent Internet aux zones éloignées mais que les câbles sous-marins transportent toujours la majorité du trafic lourd ?
fr.detail: De nouvelles constellations de satellites peuvent connecter des zones isolées à moindre coût d’infrastructure, mais les fibres optiques restent la colonne vertébrale principale pour le trafic en vrac et à faible latence ; les deux technologies se complètent.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن الأقمار الصناعية توفر الإنترنت إلى الأماكن النائية لكن الكابلات البحرية لا تزال تنقل معظم حركة المرور الثقيلة؟
ar.detail: يمكن لمجموعات الأقمار الصناعية الجديدة ربط المناطق النائية بتكلفة بنية تحتية أقل، لكن كابلات الألياف الضوئية تبقى الأساس لحركة المرور الكبيرة والمنخفضة الكمون. التقنيتان تكملان بعضهما البعض.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba satelaiti zinatoa intaneti kwa maeneo ya mbali lakini nyaya za chini ya bahari bado hubeba meeste ya trafiki nzito?
sw.detail: New satellite constellations can connect remote areas with lower infrastructure cost, but fibre-optic cables remain primary for bulk, low-latency backbone traffic. Both technologies are complementary.

pt.fact: Sabias que satélites fornecem internet a locais remotos, mas os cabos submarinos ainda transportam a maior parte do tráfego pesado?
pt.detail: Novas constelações de satélites podem ligar áreas remotas com custos de infra‑estrutura mais baixos, mas os cabos de fibra óptica continuam a ser a espinha dorsal principal para tráfego em grande volume e baixa latência. Ambas as tecnologias são complementares.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los satélites ofrecen internet a lugares remotos pero los cables submarinos aún llevan la mayor parte del tráfico pesado?
es.detail: Nuevas constelaciones de satélites pueden conectar áreas remotas con menor coste de infraestructuras, pero los cables de fibra óptica siguen siendo la columna vertebral principal para tráfico masivo y de baja latencia. Ambas tecnologías se complementan.

subject: economics and money
picture: A close-up photo of different modern banknotes and coins fanned out on a plain surface, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know money today is usually ‘fiat’—worth because people trust the government?
en.detail: Most modern currencies are not backed by gold or silver. Their value comes from laws and public confidence that others will accept them in trade.

pcm.fact: You sabi say money today usually na ‘fiat’—e worth because people trust government?
pcm.detail: Most modern currencies no dey backed by gold or silver; their value come from laws and public confidence say other people go accept am for trade.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé owó lónìí jẹ́ májẹ̀mú 'fiat'—ó wúlò nítorí ìgbẹ́kẹ̀lé àwọn ènìyàn sí ìjọba?
yo.detail: Most modern currencies are not backed by gold or silver. Their value comes from laws and public confidence that others will accept them in trade.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ego taa bụ 'fiat' — bara uru n’ihi na ndị mmadụ nwere ntụkwasị obi n’na gọọmenti?
ig.detail: Most modern currencies are not backed by gold or silver. Their value comes from laws and public confidence that others will accept them in trade.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa kuɗi a yau yawanci ‘fiat’ ne—yana da daraja ne saboda mutane suna amincewa da gwamnatin?
ha.detail: Yawancin kuɗaɗen zamani ba sa da goyon bayan zinariya ko azurfa; ƙimarsu ta samo asali ne daga dokoki da amincewar jama’a cewa wasu za su karɓe su a kasuwanci.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que l’argent d’aujourd’hui est généralement de la monnaie fiduciaire — il vaut parce que les gens font confiance au gouvernement ?
fr.detail: La plupart des devises modernes ne sont pas adossées à l’or ou à l’argent ; leur valeur provient des lois et de la confiance publique que d’autres les accepteront dans les échanges.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن المال اليوم عادةً 'ورقي القيمة'—ذو قيمة لأن الناس تثق بالحكومة؟
ar.detail: معظم العملات الحديثة ليست مدعومة بالذهب أو الفضة. قيمتها تأتي من القوانين وثقة الجمهور بأن الآخرين سيقبلونها في التداول.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba pesa leo kwa kawaida ni 'fiat'—ina thamani kwa sababu watu wanaimaini serikali?
sw.detail: Most modern currencies are not backed by gold or silver. Their value comes from laws and public confidence that others will accept them in trade.

pt.fact: Sabias que o dinheiro hoje em dia é geralmente 'fiat' — vale porque as pessoas confiam no Governo?
pt.detail: A maioria das moedas modernas não é coberta por ouro ou prata. O seu valor vem das leis e da confiança pública de que outros as aceitarão nas trocas.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que hoy el dinero suele ser 'fiduciario'—vale porque la gente confía en el gobierno?
es.detail: La mayoría de las monedas modernas no están respaldadas por oro o plata. Su valor proviene de las leyes y de la confianza pública de que otros las aceptarán en el intercambio.

subject: economics and money
picture: Interior of a bank with an empty teller counter and rows of desks and computer screens, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know banks create most of the money supply when they make loans?
en.detail: When banks lend, they credit customers' accounts, which increases deposit balances. This process multiplies money beyond the physical cash in circulation.

pcm.fact: You sabi say banks dey create most of the money supply when dem give loans?
pcm.detail: When banks lend, dem credit customers’ accounts and that one increase deposit balances, so money multiply beyond the physical cash wey dey circulate.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn ilé-ifowópamọ́ ń dá púpọ̀ owó sílẹ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá nṣe awin?
yo.detail: When banks lend, they credit customers' accounts, which increases deposit balances. This process multiplies money beyond the physical cash in circulation.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ụlọ akụ na-emepụta ọtụtụ n'ime ego mkpụrụ ego mgbe ha na-enye ụgwọ?
ig.detail: When banks lend, they credit customers' accounts, which increases deposit balances. This process multiplies money beyond the physical cash in circulation.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa bankuna suna ƙirƙirar mafi yawan adadin kuɗi lokacin da suka ba da rance?
ha.detail: Lokacin da bankuna suka bayar da rance, suna ƙara kuɗi a asusun abokan ciniki, wanda ke haɓaka adadin ajiyar; wannan tsarin yana ninka kuɗi fiye da kuɗin hannu da ke yawo.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que les banques créent la majeure partie de la masse monétaire quand elles accordent des prêts ?
fr.detail: Quand les banques prêtent, elles créditent les comptes des clients, ce qui augmente les dépôts ; ce processus multiplie la quantité de monnaie au-delà des billets physiques en circulation.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن البنوك تخلق معظم المعروض النقدي عندما تمنح قروضاً؟
ar.detail: عندما تمنح البنوك قروضاً، فإنها تقيد حسابات العملاء بديون تُزيد أرصدة الودائع. تضاعف هذه العملية النقدية تتجاوز النقد المادي المتداول.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba benki zinatengeneza sehemu kubwa ya wingi wa pesa wanapotoa mikopo?
sw.detail: When banks lend, they credit customers' accounts, which increases deposit balances. This process multiplies money beyond the physical cash in circulation.

pt.fact: Sabias que os bancos criam a maior parte da massa monetária quando concedem empréstimos?
pt.detail: Quando os bancos emprestam, creditam as contas dos clientes, o que aumenta os saldos de depósitos. Este processo multiplica o dinheiro para além do numerário físico em circulação.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los bancos crean la mayor parte de la oferta monetaria cuando conceden préstamos?
es.detail: Cuando los bancos prestan, abonan en las cuentas de los clientes, lo que aumenta los saldos de los depósitos. Este proceso multiplica el dinero más allá del efectivo físico en circulación.

subject: economics and money
picture: A close-up of a small pile of coins beside a growing stack of coins on a wooden table, gradual height increase visible.

en.fact: Did you know tiny interest rates can grow money a lot over many years due to compound interest?
en.detail: Interest earned becomes part of the new principal, so growth accelerates over time. This is why starting to save early is powerful for long-term goals.

pcm.fact: You sabi say small interest rates fit grow money well big over many years because of compound interest?
pcm.detail: Interest wey you earn become part of new principal so growth dey accelerate over time, and na why to start save early strong for long-term goals.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìfẹ́-èrè kékeré ṣókùnfà ìdàgbàsókè púpọ̀ lórí ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún nípasẹ̀ ìlúkọ̀pọ̀ (compound interest)?
yo.detail: Interest earned becomes part of the new principal, so growth accelerates over time. This is why starting to save early is powerful for long-term goals.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọnụego ntanetị pere mpe nwere ike ime ka ego too nke ukwuu n’ime ọtụtụ afọ n’ihi mbughari mmasị (compound interest)?
ig.detail: Interest earned becomes part of the new principal, so growth accelerates over time. This is why starting to save early is powerful for long-term goals.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa ƙaramin riba na iya haɓaka kuɗi sosai a cikin shekaru da yawa saboda ribar haɗin gwiwa (compound interest)?
ha.detail: Riba da aka samu tana zama sabon babban kuɗi, don haka haɓaka yana ƙarawa da lokaci; shi ya sa fara ajiya tun da wuri ke da ƙarfi don manufofin dogon lokaci.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que de faibles taux d’intérêt peuvent faire beaucoup croître l’argent sur de longues années grâce aux intérêts composés ?
fr.detail: Les intérêts gagnés deviennent partie du nouveau capital, donc la croissance s’accélère avec le temps ; c’est pourquoi commencer à épargner tôt est puissant pour des objectifs à long terme.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن معدلات الفائدة الصغيرة يمكن أن تكبر المال كثيراً عبر سنوات عديدة بفضل الفائدة المركبة؟
ar.detail: تُصبح الفائدة المكتسبة جزءاً من رأس المال الجديد، فتتسارع الزيادة مع مرور الوقت. لهذا السبب البدء المبكر في الادخار قوي لتحقيق أهداف طويلة الأمد.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba viwango vidogo vya riba vinaweza kukuza pesa kiasi kikubwa kwa miaka mingi kutokana na riba ya mchakato?
sw.detail: Interest earned becomes part of the new principal, so growth accelerates over time. This is why starting to save early is powerful for long-term goals.

pt.fact: Sabias que taxas de juro pequenas podem fazer o dinheiro crescer muito ao longo de muitos anos devido aos juros compostos?
pt.detail: Os juros ganhos passam a fazer parte do novo capital, por isso o crescimento acelera com o tempo. Por isso, começar a poupar cedo é poderoso para objetivos a longo prazo.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que tasas de interés pequeñas pueden hacer crecer mucho el dinero a lo largo de muchos años debido al interés compuesto?
es.detail: Los intereses ganados se incorporan al nuevo principal, así que el crecimiento se acelera con el tiempo. Por eso empezar a ahorrar pronto es poderoso para metas a largo plazo.

subject: economics and money
picture: A supermarket shelf filled with everyday goods and price tags blurred, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know inflation means prices rise so your money buys less over time?
en.detail: When the general price level increases, a fixed amount of money buys fewer goods and services. Central banks monitor inflation to keep it stable and predictable.

pcm.fact: You sabi say inflation mean prices dey rise so your money go buy less over time?
pcm.detail: When general price level increase, fixed amount of money go buy fewer goods and services, and central banks dey monitor inflation to keep am stable and predictable.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé ìfojúpò (inflation) túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn owó ń dín níye—ìyẹn ni pé owó rẹ kì í ra bí ó ti máa rá tẹ́lẹ̀?
yo.detail: When the general price level increases, a fixed amount of money buys fewer goods and services. Central banks monitor inflation to keep it stable and predictable.

ig.fact: Ị ma na inflation pụtara na ọnụahịa na-arị elu ya mere ego gị na-azụ obere ihe n’oge?
ig.detail: When the general price level increases, a fixed amount of money buys fewer goods and services. Central banks monitor inflation to keep it stable and predictable.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa hauhawar farashi (inflation) na nufin farashi suna tashi don haka kuɗinka yana siyan ƙasa da lokaci?
ha.detail: Idan matakin farashi gaba ɗaya ya ƙaru, adadi ɗaya na kuɗi zai siya kayan aiki da ayyuka kaɗan; bankunan tsakiya suna sa ido kan inflation don kiyaye ta cikin kima da annabta.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que l’inflation signifie que les prix augmentent et que ton argent achète moins avec le temps ?
fr.detail: Quand le niveau général des prix augmente, une somme d’argent fixe achète moins de biens et services ; les banques centrales surveillent l’inflation pour la maintenir stable et prévisible.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن التضخّم يعني أن الأسعار ترتفع فتشتري أموالك أقل مع مرور الوقت؟
ar.detail: عندما يرتفع المستوى العام للأسعار، فإن مبلغاً ثابتاً من المال يشتري سلعاً وخدمات أقل. تراقب البنوك المركزية التضخّم للحفاظ عليه مستقراً ومتوقعاً.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba mfumuko wa bei unamaanisha bei zinaongezeka hivyo pesa yako inanunua kidogo zaidi kwa muda?
sw.detail: When the general price level increases, a fixed amount of money buys fewer goods and services. Central banks monitor inflation to keep it stable and predictable.

pt.fact: Sabias que inflação significa que os preços sobem, por isso o teu dinheiro compra menos ao longo do tempo?
pt.detail: Quando o nível geral de preços aumenta, uma quantia fixa de dinheiro compra menos bens e serviços. Os bancos centrais monitorizam a inflação para a manter estável e previsível.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la inflación significa que los precios suben y tu dinero compra menos con el tiempo?
es.detail: Cuando el nivel general de precios aumenta, una cantidad fija de dinero compra menos bienes y servicios. Los bancos centrales controlan la inflación para mantenerla estable y predecible.

subject: economics and money
picture: Close-up of a hand holding a basic mobile phone showing a simple mobile-money menu, no people identifiable.

en.fact: Did you know mobile money services dramatically increased financial access in parts of Africa?
en.detail: Systems like mobile wallets let people send, receive, and save without a bank branch. This lowered costs and brought many previously unbanked people into the financial system.

pcm.fact: You sabi say mobile money services sharply increase financial access for parts of Africa?
pcm.detail: Systems like mobile wallets let people send, receive and save without bank branch, lower costs and bring many previously unbanked people into the financial system.

yo.fact: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé iṣẹ́ owó alágbèéká ti mu ìbámu ìṣúná pọ̀ gan-an ní apá kan ti Afíríkà?
yo.detail: Systems like mobile wallets let people send, receive, and save without a bank branch. This lowered costs and brought many previously unbanked people into the financial system.

ig.fact: Ị ma na ọrụ mobile money gbanwere ohere akụ na ụba n'ọtụtụ akụkụ Africa?
ig.detail: Systems like mobile wallets let people send, receive, and save without a bank branch. This lowered costs and brought many previously unbanked people into the financial system.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa ayyukan kuɗin wayar hannu sun ƙara samun damar kuɗi sosai a wasu sassan Afirka?
ha.detail: Tsarin walat na wayar hannu yana ba mutane damar aiko, karɓa, da ajiye kuɗi ba tare da rassa banki ba; hakan ya rage kuɗaɗe kuma ya kawo mutane da yawa da ba su da asusun banki cikin tsarin kuɗi.

fr.fact: Savais-tu que les services d’argent mobile ont fortement augmenté l’accès financier dans certaines régions d’Afrique ?
fr.detail: Des systèmes comme les portefeuilles mobiles permettent d’envoyer, recevoir et épargner sans agence bancaire ; cela a réduit les coûts et intégré beaucoup de personnes non bancarisées au système financier.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أن خدمات المال عبر الهاتف زادت بشكل كبير من الوصول المالي في أجزاء من أفريقيا؟
ar.detail: تمكّن الأنظمة مثل المحافظ الهاتفية الناس من الإرسال والاستلام والادخار دون فرع مصرفي. خفضت التكاليف وجلبت العديد من الأشخاص غير المرتبطين بالبنوك إلى النظام المالي.

sw.fact: Je, wajua kwamba huduma za pesa za simu ziliongeza kwa kiasi kikubwa upatikanaji wa kifedha katika sehemu za Afrika?
sw.detail: Systems like mobile wallets let people send, receive, and save without a bank branch. This lowered costs and brought many previously unbanked people into the financial system.

pt.fact: Sabias que serviços de dinheiro móvel aumentaram dramaticamente o acesso financeiro em partes de África?
pt.detail: Sistemas como carteiras móveis permitem às pessoas enviar, receber e poupar sem uma agência bancária. Isto reduziu custos e trouxe muitas pessoas anteriormente sem acesso ao sistema financeiro.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los servicios de dinero móvil incrementaron drásticamente el acceso financiero en partes de África?
es.detail: Sistemas como las billeteras móviles permiten enviar, recibir y ahorrar sin una sucursal bancaria. Esto redujo costes y permitió que muchas personas sin acceso bancario tradicional entraran al sistema financiero.

subject: economics and money
picture: A busy port with cargo containers and cranes seen from a distance, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know countries trade because they benefit from specializing in goods they produce relatively cheaply?
en.detail: Comparative advantage means even if one country is better at everything, both can gain by specializing and trading. Trade raises total production and choices available.

pcm.fact: You sabi say countries dey trade because dem benefit if dem specialise for goods wey dem fit produce cheap?
pcm.detail: Comparative advantage means even if one country is better at everything, both can gain by specializing and trading. Trade raises total production and choices available.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè máa ń paṣípààrọ̀ nítorí wọ́n ń rí èrè nípa mímọ̀ amọ̀jà nínú ohun tí wọ́n lè ṣe ní owó díẹ̀?
yo.detail: Ẹ̀kọ́ ìyàtọ̀ ìfẹ́yàtọ̀ (comparative advantage) túmọ̀ sí pé bí orílẹ̀-èdè kan bá dára jù ní gbogbo ohun, ìwọ̀n méjì lè jèrè nípa pípa amọ̀ja sílẹ̀ àti paṣípààrọ̀; ìṣòwò ń pọ̀sí ìgbẹ̀kẹ́lé àti àṣàyàn ohun tí a lè ra.

ig.fact: Ị maara na mba na-azụ ahịa n’ihi na ha bara uru site n’ichepụta ihe ha na-emefu obere ego imepụta?
ig.detail: Uche comparative advantage pụtara na ọbụlagodi ma otu mba nwee ike ime ihe niile n’aka nke ọma, mba abụọ ahụ ka nwere uru ma ha kee ọrụ ha ma zụta na ire. Ahịa na-eme ka mmepụta buru ibu ma na-enye ọtụtụ nhọrọ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa ƙasashe suna yin ciniki domin suna amfana idan suka ƙware a kaya da suke samarwa cikin arha?
ha.detail: Comparative advantage means even if one country is better at everything, both can gain by specializing and trading. Trade raises total production and choices available.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les pays commercent parce qu’ils tirent avantage de se spécialiser dans les biens qu’ils produisent relativement à moindre coût ?
fr.detail: Comparative advantage means even if one country is better at everything, both can gain by specializing and trading. Trade raises total production and choices available.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ الدول تتاجر لأنّها تستفيد من التخصص في السلع التي تنتجها بتكلفة نسبية أقل؟
ar.detail: ميزة المقارنة تعني أنّ حتى إن كانت دولة أفضل في كل شيء، فإن التخصص والتبادل يفيدان الطرفين ويزيدان الإنتاج والخيارات المتاحة.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba nchi zinafanya biashara kwa sababu zinafaidika kwa kuzingatia bidhaa wanazoweza kuzalisha kwa gharama nafuu kwa ulinganisho?
sw.detail: Faida ya kulinganisha ina maana hata kama nchi moja ni bora katika kila kitu, zote zinaweza kunufaika kwa kuzingatia uzalishaji maalum na kufanya biashara; biashara inaongeza uzalishaji wa jumla na chaguo zinazopatikana.

pt.fact: Sabias que os países comerciam porque lucram ao se especializarem em bens que produzem relativamente mais barato?
pt.detail: Comparative advantage means even if one country is better at everything, both can gain by specializing and trading. Trade raises total production and choices available.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los países comercian porque les conviene especializarse en bienes que producen relativamente barato?
es.detail: La ventaja comparativa significa que, aunque un país sea mejor en todo, ambos pueden ganar especializándose y comerciando. El comercio aumenta la producción total y las opciones disponibles.

subject: economics and money
picture: A skyline showing factories, office buildings, and a highway, viewed from a distance at sunset.

en.fact: Did you know GDP measures a country’s total production but not everyone’s well‑being?
en.detail: Gross Domestic Product sums the value of goods and services produced in a year. It doesn't capture income distribution, unpaid work, or environmental damage.

pcm.fact: You sabi say GDP dey measure a country’s total production but e no show everybody well‑being?
pcm.detail: Gross Domestic Product sums the value of goods and services produced in a year. It doesn't capture income distribution, unpaid work, or environmental damage.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé GDP ń ṣe ìṣírò gbogbo ìṣèjọba ọjà orílẹ̀-èdè ṣùgbọ́n kì í ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìrètí ìdàgbàsókè gbogbo ènìyàn?
yo.detail: Ìjọpọ̀ Agbègbè Ọjà (Gross Domestic Product) kó iye gbogbo ọjà àti iṣẹ́ tí a ṣe ní ọdún kan jọ; kì í ṣe ìfihàn bí owó ṣe pin, iṣẹ́ aítẹ́lẹ̀ tàbí ìbaje ayé.

ig.fact: Ị maara na GDP na-atụpụta ọnụahịa mmepụta mba niile mana ọ naghị atụpụta ịdị mma ndụ onye ọ bụla?
ig.detail: Gross Domestic Product na-akpọkọta uru nke ngwongwo na ọrụ e mepụtara n’afọ. Ọ naghị ewere nkesa ego, ọrụ a na-enweghị akwụ ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ mmebi gburugburu ebe obibi n’ụzọ zuru ezu.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa GDP yana auna jimillar abin da ƙasa ta samar amma ba ya nuna jin daɗin kowa?
ha.detail: Gross Domestic Product sums the value of goods and services produced in a year. It doesn't capture income distribution, unpaid work, or environmental damage.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le PIB mesure la production totale d’un pays mais pas le bien‑être de tout le monde ?
fr.detail: Gross Domestic Product sums the value of goods and services produced in a year. It doesn't capture income distribution, unpaid work, or environmental damage.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ الناتج المحلي الإجمالي يقيس إجمالي إنتاج البلد لكنه لا يقيس رفاهية الجميع؟
ar.detail: الناتج المحلي الإجمالي يجمع قيمة السلع والخدمات المنتجة خلال سنة، لكنه لا يلتقط توزيع الدخل أو العمل غير المدفوع أو الأضرار البيئية.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba Pato la Taifa (GDP) linapima uzalishaji wa nchi lakini halihesabi ustawi wa kila mtu?
sw.detail: Pato la Taifa Jumla linakusanya thamani ya bidhaa na huduma zinazozalishwa katika mwaka; haliwezi kuonyesha mgawanyo wa mapato, kazi isiyolipwa, au uharibifu wa mazingira.

pt.fact: Sabias que o PIB mede a produção total de um país, mas não o bem‑estar de todas as pessoas?
pt.detail: Gross Domestic Product sums the value of goods and services produced in a year. It doesn't capture income distribution, unpaid work, or environmental damage.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el PIB mide la producción total de un país pero no el bienestar de todas las personas?
es.detail: El Producto Interno Bruto suma el valor de bienes y servicios producidos en un año. No captura la distribución del ingreso, el trabajo no remunerado ni el daño ambiental.

subject: economics and money
picture: An empty storefront with a 'for lease' sign in the window, photographed from the street with no people.

en.fact: Did you know recessions are often declared after several months of falling economic activity?
en.detail: Economists look at indicators like output, employment and sales to identify contractions. Governments use policy tools to try to shorten downturns.

pcm.fact: You sabi say dem dey declare recession after several months wey economic activity don dey fall?
pcm.detail: Economists look at indicators like output, employment and sales to identify contractions. Governments use policy tools to try to shorten downturns.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé a sábà máa kéde ìṣubú-ọrọ̀ lẹ́yìn oṣù mélòó kan tí ìṣẹ́-ọrọ̀ bá ń dínkù?
yo.detail: Àwọn oníṣègùn-ọrọ̀ ń wo àmì bí iṣelọpọ, iṣẹ́ àti tita láti mọ ìdínkù; ìjọba sì máa lo ọ̀nà ìlànà ìṣètò ìṣúná tàbí owó láti gbìyànjú láti kuru ìrú ìṣubú bẹ́ẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị maara na a na-asịkarị na e nwere recession mgbe ọnwa ole na ole gasịrị nke ike akụ na ụba na-ada?
ig.detail: Ụmụ ọkachamara akụ na ụba na-ele ihe ngosi dị ka mmepụta, ọrụ na ire ere iji mata mkpụsịrị akụrụngwa. Ndị ọchịchị na-eji ngwaọrụ iwu akụ na ụba iji gbalịa mee ka downturn dị mkpụmkpụ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa ana yawan ayyana koma bayan tattalin arziki bayan watanni kaɗan na raguwar ayyukan tattalin arziki?
ha.detail: Economists look at indicators like output, employment and sales to identify contractions. Governments use policy tools to try to shorten downturns.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les récessions sont souvent déclarées après plusieurs mois de baisse de l’activité économique ?
fr.detail: Economists look at indicators like output, employment and sales to identify contractions. Governments use policy tools to try to shorten downturns.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ الركود يُعلن غالبًا بعد عدة أشهر من تراجع النشاط الاقتصادي؟
ar.detail: يقيس الاقتصاديون مؤشرات مثل الإنتاج والتوظيف والمبيعات لتحديد الانكماش، وتستخدم الحكومات أدوات سياسة لمحاولة تقصير فترات الركود.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba mdororo wa uchumi mara nyingi hutangazwa baada ya miezi kadhaa ya kuporomoka kwa shughuli za kiuchumi?
sw.detail: Wataalamu wa uchumi hutatiza dalili kama uzalishaji, ajira na mauzo kutambua mivurugo; serikali hutumia sera ili kujaribu kufupisha kipindi cha mdororo.

pt.fact: Sabias que uma recessão costuma ser declarada depois de vários meses de atividade económica em queda?
pt.detail: Economists look at indicators like output, employment and sales to identify contractions. Governments use policy tools to try to shorten downturns.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las recesiones suelen declararse después de varios meses de caída de la actividad económica?
es.detail: Los economistas observan indicadores como producción, empleo y ventas para identificar contracciones. Los gobiernos usan herramientas de política para intentar acortar las crisis.

subject: economics and money
picture: A split-image style photo of a student studying at a desk on one side and friends playing soccer on the other, no recognizable faces.

en.fact: Did you know opportunity cost is the real cost of choosing one option over another?
en.detail: When you pick one use of time or money, you give up the benefit from the next best alternative. Thinking in opportunity costs helps people and governments make better decisions.

pcm.fact: You sabi say opportunity cost na the real cost of choosing one option over another?
pcm.detail: When you pick one use of time or money, you give up the benefit from the next best alternative. Thinking in opportunity costs helps people and governments make better decisions.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé owó ànfàní tí o padà sílẹ̀ (opportunity cost) ni gidi iye tí ìyanjẹ kan máa jẹ nígbà tí o bá yan aṣayan kan ju omiiran lọ?
yo.detail: Nígbà tí o bá yan bí o ṣe máa lo ìgbà tàbí owó rẹ, o padà foju kọ ànfàní tí aṣayan kejì yóò fún ọ; rò nípa owó ànfàní máa ràn àwọn ènìyàn àti ìjọba lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe ìpinnu tó dára.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ohere ụgwọ (opportunity cost) bụ ezigbo ụgwọ ịkwụ mgbe ị họrọ otu nhọrọ kama nke ọzọ?
ig.detail: Mgbe ị họrọ otu ojiji oge ma ọ bụ ego, i na-enye uru si na nhọrọ kacha nso ị chefuru. Ị na-eche banyere opportunity cost na-enyere mmadụ na ọchịchị ime mkpebi ka mma.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa farashin damar (opportunity cost) shine ainihin farashin zaɓi ɗaya a kan wani?
ha.detail: When you pick one use of time or money, you give up the benefit from the next best alternative. Thinking in opportunity costs helps people and governments make better decisions.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le coût d’opportunité est le vrai prix d’un choix par rapport à une autre option ?
fr.detail: When you pick one use of time or money, you give up the benefit from the next best alternative. Thinking in opportunity costs helps people and governments make better decisions.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ تكلفة الفرصة البديلة هي التكلفة الحقيقية لاختيار خيار على آخر؟
ar.detail: عند اختيار استخدام وقتك أو مالك في خيار واحد، تتخلى عن فوائد أفضل بديل، والتفكير بتكلفة الفرصة البديلة يساعد على اتخاذ قرارات أفضل.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba gharama ya fursa ni gharama halisi ya kuchagua chaguo moja badala ya kingine?
sw.detail: Unapochagua matumizi ya muda au pesa, unapoteza faida ya mbadala bora inayofuata; kufikiria kwa gharama za fursa husaidia watu na serikali kufanya maamuzi bora.

pt.fact: Sabias que o custo de oportunidade é o custo real de escolher uma opção em vez de outra?
pt.detail: When you pick one use of time or money, you give up the benefit from the next best alternative. Thinking in opportunity costs helps people and governments make better decisions.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el costo de oportunidad es el verdadero costo de elegir una opción sobre otra?
es.detail: Cuando eliges un uso del tiempo o del dinero, renuncias al beneficio de la siguiente mejor alternativa. Pensar en costos de oportunidad ayuda a personas y gobiernos a tomar mejores decisiones.

subject: economics and money
picture: Close-up photo of a payment terminal and a smartphone beside some coins on a table, no people visible.

en.fact: Did you know cash and digital money can both be legal tender, but digital records are increasingly common?
en.detail: Legal tender laws require acceptance of certain forms of money for debts, but most transactions today are digital transfers. Banks and payment networks keep electronic records of balances.

pcm.fact: You sabi say cash and digital money fit both be legal tender, but digital records don dey more common?
pcm.detail: Legal tender laws require acceptance of certain forms of money for debts, but most transactions today are digital transfers. Banks and payment networks keep electronic records of balances.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé owó owúrọ̀ (cash) àti owó díjítàlì lè jẹ́ owó ìtọ́ka ofin, ṣùgbọ́n ìkọ̀kọ̀rọ̀ díjítàlì ti di wọ́pọ̀?
yo.detail: Ofin owó ìtọ́ka lè fi pàṣẹ pé kí a gba irú owó kan fún gbèsè, ṣùgbọ́n lónìí púpọ̀ ìràpadà ni a ṣe nípasẹ̀ ìbáṣepọ̀ díjítàlì; àwọn banki àti nẹ́tìwọ́ọ̀kì ìsanwó ń tọ́jú ìgbòsílẹ̀ oníkọ̀ọ̀kan ní ìkọ̀lẹ̀ ẹlẹ́rọ̀.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ego aka na ego dijitalụ abụọ nwere ike ịbụ legal tender, ma ndekọ dijitalụ na-abawanye mgbe niile?
ig.detail: Iwu legal tender na-eme ka e nwee ihe a ga-anabata maka ụgwọ, ma ọtụtụ azụmahịa taa bụ mbufe dijitalụ. Ụlọ akụ na netwọk ịkwụ ụgwọ na-edebe ndekọ eletrọnịkị nke akụnụba.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa kuɗi na hannu da na dijital duka na iya zama kuɗin doka, amma rikodin dijital suna yawaita?
ha.detail: Legal tender laws require acceptance of certain forms of money for debts, but most transactions today are digital transfers. Banks and payment networks keep electronic records of balances.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que l’argent liquide et l’argent numérique peuvent être tous deux monnaie légale, mais que les enregistrements numériques sont de plus en plus courants ?
fr.detail: Legal tender laws require acceptance of certain forms of money for debts, but most transactions today are digital transfers. Banks and payment networks keep electronic records of balances.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ النقود النقدية والرقمية يمكن أن تكونا وسيلة دفع قانونية، لكن السجلات الرقمية أصبحت شائعة؟
ar.detail: قوانين وسيلة الدفع تجبر قبول أشكال معينة من المال لتسوية الديون، لكن معظم المعاملات اليوم تحويلات رقمية، والبنوك وشبكات الدفع تحتفظ بسجلات إلكترونية للأرصدة.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba pesa taslimu na pesa za kidigitali zote zinaweza kuwa sarafu halali, lakini rekodi za kidigitali zinaenea zaidi?
sw.detail: Sheria za sarafu halali zinawataka watu kukubali aina fulani za pesa kwa madeni, lakini miamala mingi ya sasa hufanywa kwa uhamisho wa kidigitali; benki na mitandao ya malipo zina rekodi za kielektroniki za salio.

pt.fact: Sabias que dinheiro físico e dinheiro digital podem ser ambos meios legais de pagamento, mas os registos digitais são cada vez mais comuns?
pt.detail: Legal tender laws require acceptance of certain forms of money for debts, but most transactions today are digital transfers. Banks and payment networks keep electronic records of balances.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el dinero en efectivo y el digital pueden ser ambos moneda de curso legal, pero los registros digitales son cada vez más comunes?
es.detail: Las leyes de curso legal exigen la aceptación de ciertas formas de dinero para deudas, pero hoy la mayoría de las transacciones son transferencias digitales. Los bancos y redes de pago mantienen registros electrónicos de saldos.

subject: languages and words
picture: A colorful map-style collage of many small flags and speech-bubble icons over a globe, no people, showing language diversity.

en.fact: Did you know there are about 7,000 languages spoken in the world today?
en.detail: Linguists estimate roughly 7,000 living languages by surveying communities and documented languages. Numbers change as some languages gain speakers and others become extinct.

pcm.fact: You sabi say about 7,000 languages dey spoken for the world today?
pcm.detail: Linguists estimate roughly 7,000 living languages by surveying communities and documented languages. Numbers change as some languages gain speakers and others become extinct.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé a ní nípa 7,000 èdè tí a ń sọ lónìí?
yo.detail: Àwọn onímọ̀ ẹ̀dá èdè (linguists) ṣàṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn àgbègbè àti ìwé-ẹ̀kọ́ láti ṣe ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ pé oko 7,000 ni àwọn èdè alààyè wa; ìyẹn lè yí padà bí diẹ̀ ninu wọn bá ń parí tàbí míì sì ń gbòòrò.

ig.fact: Ị maara na e nwere ihe dị ka 7,000 asụsụ a na-asụ n’ụwa taa?
ig.detail: Ndị ọkà asụsụ na-atụ aro ihe dị ka 7,000 asụsụ dị ndụ site n’inyocha obodo na akwụkwọ edepụtara asụsụ. Ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-agbanwe ka ụfọdụ asụsụ na-abawanye ndị na-asụ ha ebe ndị ọzọ na-apụ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa akwai kimanin 7,000 harsuna da ake magana da su a duniya a yau?
ha.detail: Linguists estimate roughly 7,000 living languages by surveying communities and documented languages. Numbers change as some languages gain speakers and others become extinct.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous qu’il existe environ 7,000 langues parlées dans le monde aujourd’hui ?
fr.detail: Linguists estimate roughly 7,000 living languages by surveying communities and documented languages. Numbers change as some languages gain speakers and others become extinct.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ هنالك حوالي 7,000 لغة تُتَحدَّث في العالم اليوم؟
ar.detail: يقدّر اللغويون نحو 7,000 لغة حية عن طريق مسح المجتمعات واللغات الموثقة، وتتغير الأرقام مع ازدياد بعض اللغات واندثار أخرى.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba kuna takriban lugha 7,000 zinazozungumzwa duniani leo?
sw.detail: Wataalamu wa lugha wanakadiria lugha hai takriban 7,000 kwa kuchunguza jamii na lugha zilizodokumentishwa; idadi hubadilika wakati baadhi zinapata wazungumzaji wapya na nyingine zinapotea.

pt.fact: Sabias que existem cerca de 7,000 línguas faladas no mundo hoje?
pt.detail: Linguists estimate roughly 7,000 living languages by surveying communities and documented languages. Numbers change as some languages gain speakers and others become extinct.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que existen alrededor de 7,000 idiomas hablados en el mundo hoy?
es.detail: Los lingüistas estiman aproximadamente 7,000 idiomas vivos al encuestar comunidades y lenguas documentadas. Las cifras cambian cuando algunas lenguas ganan hablantes y otras se extinguen.

subject: languages and words
picture: A row of worn, old books with torn spines and fading labels on a wooden table, implying loss, no people.

en.fact: Did you know nearly 40% of the world's languages are considered endangered?
en.detail: UNESCO and linguists estimate a large share of languages are at risk because few children learn them. When young people stop learning a community language, the language can disappear within a generation.

pcm.fact: You sabi say nearly 40% of the world's languages dey considered endangered?
pcm.detail: UNESCO and linguists estimate a large share of languages are at risk because few children learn them. When young people stop learning a community language, the language can disappear within a generation.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé fẹrẹ̀ 40% ti gbogbo èdè ayé ni wọ́n kà sí ní ewu ìparí (endangered)?
yo.detail: UNESCO àti àwọn linguists sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀ èdè wà ní ewu nítorí pé díẹ̀ ṣoṣo lara awọn ọmọ kékeré ni ń kọ́ wọn; nígbà tí ọdọ̀kùnrin kó kọ́ èdè kan mọ́, èdè náà lè parí ní ìran kan.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ihe fọdụrụ ihe dị ka 40% nke asụsụ ụwa ka a kọwara dị ka ndị nọ n’ihe ize ndụ?
ig.detail: UNESCO na ndị ọkà asụsụ na-atụ aro na nnukwu akụkụ asụsụ nọ n’ihe ize ndụ n’ihi na ntakịrị ụmụaka na-amụta ha. Mgbe ndị ntorobịa kwụsịrị ịmụ asụsụ obodo ha, asụsụ ahụ nwere ike ịla n’iyi n’ime ọgbọ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa kusan 40% na harsunan duniya ana laƙabi da ‘na cikin haɗari’?
ha.detail: UNESCO and linguists estimate a large share of languages are at risk because few children learn them. When young people stop learning a community language, the language can disappear within a generation.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que près de 40% des langues du monde sont considérées en danger ?
fr.detail: UNESCO and linguists estimate a large share of languages are at risk because few children learn them. When young people stop learning a community language, the language can disappear within a generation.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ ما يقرب من 40% من لغات العالم تعتبر مهددة بالانقراض؟
ar.detail: تقدّر اليونسكو واللغويون أنّ حصة كبيرة من اللغات معرضة للخطر لأنّ عدد الأطفال الذين يتعلمونها قليل، وعندما يتوقف الشباب عن تعلم اللغة المجتمعية يمكن أن تختفي خلال جيل.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba karibu 40% ya lugha za dunia zinachukuliwa kuwa hatarini?
sw.detail: UNESCO na wataalamu wa lugha wanakadiria sehemu kubwa ya lugha ziko hatarini kwa sababu watoto wachache wanazijifunza; lugha inaweza kutoweka ndani ya kizazi ikiwa vijana wanaacha kuizoea.

pt.fact: Sabias que quase 40% das línguas do mundo são consideradas em perigo?
pt.detail: UNESCO and linguists estimate a large share of languages are at risk because few children learn them. When young people stop learning a community language, the language can disappear within a generation.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que casi 40% de las lenguas del mundo se consideran en peligro?
es.detail: La UNESCO y los lingüistas estiman que una gran proporción de lenguas corre riesgo porque pocos niños las aprenden. Cuando los jóvenes dejan de aprender la lengua comunitaria, ésta puede desaparecer en una generación.

subject: languages and words
picture: Close-up of hands passing a carved wooden storytelling stick in front of a dim, empty clay-floor hut, no faces visible.

en.fact: Did you know many languages have never been written down?
en.detail: Thousands of languages exist only in speech and oral tradition. Without a writing system, knowledge is passed by storytelling, song, and memory across generations.

pcm.fact: You sabi say many languages never bin write down and dem dey exist only as speech?
pcm.detail: Thousands of languages exist only in speech and oral tradition. Without a writing system, knowledge is passed by storytelling, song, and memory across generations.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èdè kò tí ì ní ìkọ̀wé, wọ́n sì wà nínú ìtàn ẹnu péré?
yo.detail: Ẹ̀dá ẹgbẹ̀ẹgbẹ̀rún èdè wà ní ọ̀nà ẹnu—àmọ̀ràn, ìtàn àti orin—kìí ṣe nípa kikọ; láìsí ètò kikọ, ìmọ̀ kì í ṣe ìtàn náà ráyè wọ́n sí ìran tuntun bí ó ṣe yẹ.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ọtụtụ asụsụ e dereghị ha mgbe ọ bụla?
ig.detail: Puku asụsụ dị ndụ nwere naanị okwu a na-asụ, na omenala ọnụ ọnụ. N’enweghị usoro ide, ọmụma na-aga site n’ịgwa akụkọ, abụ na ncheta site n’otu ọgbọ ruo n’ọzọ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa da yawa daga cikin harsuna ba a taba rubuta su ba?
ha.detail: Thousands of languages exist only in speech and oral tradition. Without a writing system, knowledge is passed by storytelling, song, and memory across generations.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que de nombreuses langues n’ont jamais été mises par écrit ?
fr.detail: Thousands of languages exist only in speech and oral tradition. Without a writing system, knowledge is passed by storytelling, song, and memory across generations.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ العديد من اللغات لم تُدون كتابيًا أبدًا؟
ar.detail: هناك آلاف اللغات موجودة في صورة كلام وتقاليد شفهية فقط، وبدون نظام كتابة تنتقل المعرفة من خلال السرد والغناء والذاكرة عبر الأجيال.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba lugha nyingi hazijawahi kuandikwa?
sw.detail: Maelfu ya lugha zinapatikana kwa matamshi tu na mila za mdomo; bila mfumo wa uandishi, maarifa hupitishwa kwa hadithi, nyimbo na kumbukumbu vizazi kwa vizazi.

pt.fact: Sabias que muitas línguas nunca foram colocadas por escrito?
pt.detail: Thousands of languages exist only in speech and oral tradition. Without a writing system, knowledge is passed by storytelling, song, and memory across generations.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que muchas lenguas nunca se han escrito?
es.detail: Miles de lenguas existen solo en la palabra hablada y la tradición oral. Sin un sistema de escritura, el conocimiento se transmite mediante relatos, canciones y memoria entre generaciones.

subject: languages and words
picture: A high-contrast photo of two silhouetted hands forming a clear sign against a plain bright background, no faces.

en.fact: Did you know sign languages are full natural languages, not just gestures of spoken ones?
en.detail: Sign languages have their own grammar, vocabulary and regional varieties separate from local spoken languages. For example, American Sign Language is distinct from British Sign Language.

pcm.fact: You sabi say sign languages na full natural languages, no be just gestures of the spoken ones?
pcm.detail: Sign languages have their own grammar, vocabulary and regional varieties separate from local spoken languages. For example, American Sign Language is distinct from British Sign Language.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé àwọn èdè àmì ọwọ́ jẹ́ èdè aládàáṣe gẹ́gẹ́ bíi èdè míì, kìí ṣe ìfihàn ìṣeré tí a ṣe lórí èdè tí a ń sọ?
yo.detail: Èdè àmì ọwọ́ ní girama, ìkòwé àti onírúurú agbègbè tirẹ̀; fún àpẹẹrẹ, American Sign Language kò jọ British Sign Language nípa èdá àti ìlànà rẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị maara na asụsụ nsọtụ aka (sign languages) bụ asụsụ zuru oke, ọ bụghị naanị mgbaàmà nke asụsụ e kwuru?
ig.detail: Asụsụ nsọtụ aka nwere iwu okwu ha, okwu e ji asụ na ụdị mpaghara dị iche na asụsụ okwu obodo. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, American Sign Language adịghị ka British Sign Language.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa harsunan hannu cikakkun harsuna ne na halitta, ba kawai alamomin harsunan magana ba?
ha.detail: Sign languages have their own grammar, vocabulary and regional varieties separate from local spoken languages. For example, American Sign Language is distinct from British Sign Language.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les langues des signes sont de véritables langues naturelles, pas seulement des gestes des langues parlées ?
fr.detail: Sign languages have their own grammar, vocabulary and regional varieties separate from local spoken languages. For example, American Sign Language is distinct from British Sign Language.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ لغات الإشارة لغات طبيعية كاملة وليست مجرد إيماءات للغات المنطوقة؟
ar.detail: لغات الإشارة لها قواعد نحوية ومفردات واللهجات الإقليمية الخاصة بها، فعلى سبيل المثال لغة الإشارة الأمريكية تختلف عن لغة الإشارة البريطانية.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba lugha za alama ni lugha kamili za asili, si tu ishara za lugha za maneno?
sw.detail: Lugha za alama zina sarufi zao, msamiati na tofauti za kikanda tofauti na lugha za mdomo za eneo; kwa mfano, American Sign Language ni tofauti na British Sign Language.

pt.fact: Sabias que as línguas gestuais são línguas naturais completas, não apenas gestos das línguas orais?
pt.detail: Sign languages have their own grammar, vocabulary and regional varieties separate from local spoken languages. For example, American Sign Language is distinct from British Sign Language.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que las lenguas de signos son lenguas naturales completas, no solo gestos de las habladas?
es.detail: Las lenguas de signos tienen su propia gramática, vocabulario y variedades regionales separadas de las lenguas habladas locales. Por ejemplo, la American Sign Language es distinta de la British Sign Language.

subject: languages and words
picture: A simple classroom blackboard with three example sentence fragments arranged in different orders, no people or labels.

en.fact: Did you know most languages put the verb either in the middle or at the end of a sentence?
en.detail: Linguistic surveys show the majority of languages use SVO (I eat rice) or SOV (I rice eat) word orders. These patterns shape how sentences and grammar evolve in a language.

pcm.fact: You sabi say most languages put the verb either for the middle or at the end of the sentence?
pcm.detail: Linguistic surveys show the majority of languages use SVO (I eat rice) or SOV (I rice eat) word orders. These patterns shape how sentences and grammar evolve in a language.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé púpọ̀ àwọn èdè maa ń fi ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe sí àárín (SVO) tàbí sí ìkẹ́yìn (SOV) gbolohun?
yo.detail: Ìwádìí lórí èdè fi hàn pé ọ̀pọ̀ jùlọ lo ìlànà SVO (Mo ńjẹ iresi) tàbí SOV (Mo iresi jẹ́); ìlànà wọ̀nyí nípa ọrọ̀-ìṣe máa ń dá bí gbolohun àti girama ṣe ń yí padà.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ọtụtụ asụsụ na-etinye verb ma ọ bụ etiti ma ọ bụ n’ókè ikpeazụ nke ahịrịokwu?
ig.detail: Nnyocha asụsụ na-egosi na ọtụtụ asụsụ na-eji usoro okwu SVO (I eat rice) ma ọ bụ SOV (I rice eat). Ụdị ndị a na-emetụta otu ahịrịokwu na grammar si etolite n’asụsụ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa mafi yawan harsuna suna saka aikin (verb) ko a tsakiyar jimla ko a ƙarshen ta?
ha.detail: Linguistic surveys show the majority of languages use SVO (I eat rice) or SOV (I rice eat) word orders. These patterns shape how sentences and grammar evolve in a language.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que la plupart des langues placent le verbe soit au milieu, soit à la fin de la phrase ?
fr.detail: Linguistic surveys show the majority of languages use SVO (I eat rice) or SOV (I rice eat) word orders. These patterns shape how sentences and grammar evolve in a language.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ معظم اللغات تضع الفعل إما في الوسط أو في نهاية الجملة؟
ar.detail: تُظهر الدراسات اللغوية أنّ أغلب اللغات تستخدم ترتيب فاعل-فعل-مفعول (SVO) أو فاعل-مفعول-فعل (SOV)، وهذه الأنماط تؤثر في تطوّر الجمل والنحو.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba lugha nyingi huweka kitenzi katikati au mwishoni mwa sentensi?
sw.detail: Utafiti wa lugha unaonyesha wengi hutumia muundo wa maneno SVO (mimi ninala wali) au SOV (mimi wali nala); mifumo hii huathiri jinsi sentensi na sarufi zinavyoendelea katika lugha.

pt.fact: Sabias que a maioria das línguas coloca o verbo no meio ou no fim da frase?
pt.detail: Linguistic surveys show the majority of languages use SVO (I eat rice) or SOV (I rice eat) word orders. These patterns shape how sentences and grammar evolve in a language.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que la mayoría de las lenguas colocan el verbo en el medio o al final de la oración?
es.detail: Los estudios lingüísticos muestran que la mayoría usan el orden SVO (Yo como arroz) o SOV (Yo arroz como). Estos patrones influyen en cómo evolucionan las oraciones y la gramática de una lengua.

subject: languages and words
picture: A close-up photo of old carved stone tablets filled with Chinese characters, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Chinese characters represent meaning units, not just sounds?
en.detail: Each Chinese character usually represents a morpheme — a piece of meaning — which can match different pronunciations in dialects. That’s why speakers of different Chinese dialects can read the same text aloud differently.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Chinese characters represent meaning units, not just sounds?
pcm.detail: Each Chinese character usually represents a morpheme — a piece of meaning — which can match different pronunciations in dialects. That’s why speakers of different Chinese dialects can read the same text aloud differently.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé àwọn àmì Ṣáínì ń ṣe aṣojú ẹ̀ka ìtumọ̀ (morpheme), kì í ṣe kíkọ́ ẹ̀dá ohun-nìkan?
yo.detail: Ìwọ̀n àmì Ṣáínì kọọkan sábà máa duro fún ìyọ̀rí-ọrọ̀—ẹ̀ka ìtumọ̀ kan—tí ó lè ní ìtúmọ̀ àti àwọn ìforúkọsílẹ̀ onírúurú ní àwọn èdè-ìbáṣepọ̀, èyí tí ó mú kí àwọn agbègbè orílẹ̀-èdè Ṣáínì lè ka ìwé kan pọ̀ ṣùgbọ́n máa sọ ọ́ ní ìróhùn tó yàtọ̀.

ig.fact: Ị maara na mkpụrụedemede Chinese na-anọchi ihe pụtara, ọ bụghị naanị ụda?
ig.detail: A na-ejikarị mkpụrụedemede Chinese ọ bụla na-anọchi morpheme — akụkụ nke pụtara — nke nwere ike inwe ụda dị iche n’ụdị okwu dị iche. Nke a bụ ihe kpatara na ndị kwuru dialekdị ndị dị iche nwere ike gụọ otu ederede ma kwuo ya n’ụzọ dị iche.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa haruffan Sinanci suna wakiltar rakaƙƙen ma’ana, ba kawai sauti ba?
ha.detail: Each Chinese character usually represents a morpheme — a piece of meaning — which can match different pronunciations in dialects. That’s why speakers of different Chinese dialects can read the same text aloud differently.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que les caractères chinois représentent des unités de sens, pas seulement des sons ?
fr.detail: Each Chinese character usually represents a morpheme — a piece of meaning — which can match different pronunciations in dialects. That’s why speakers of different Chinese dialects can read the same text aloud differently.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ الأحرف الصينية تمثل وحدات معنى لا أصواتًا فقط؟
ar.detail: كل حرف صيني عادةً يمثل مورفيمًا — قطعة معنى — وقد تُنطق بطرق مختلفة في اللهجات، ولهذا يمكن لمتكلمي لهجات مختلفة قراءة نفس النص بصيغ نطق مختلفة.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba herufi za Kichina zinawakilisha vitengo vya maana, sio sauti tu?
sw.detail: Kila kimoja cha herufi za Kichina kawaida kinawakilisha morfemu — kipande cha maana — ambacho kinaweza kuwa na matamshi tofauti katika lahaja; ndiyo sababu wazungumzaji wa lahaja tofauti wanaweza kusoma maandishi yale yale kwa sauti tofauti.

pt.fact: Sabias que os caracteres chineses representam unidades de significado, não apenas sons?
pt.detail: Each Chinese character usually represents a morpheme — a piece of meaning — which can match different pronunciations in dialects. That’s why speakers of different Chinese dialects can read the same text aloud differently.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que los caracteres chinos representan unidades de significado, no solo sonidos?
es.detail: Cada carácter chino suele representar un morfema —una pieza de significado— que puede corresponder a diferentes pronunciaciones en distintos dialectos. Por eso hablantes de distintos dialectos chinos pueden leer el mismo texto y pronunciarlo de forma distinta.

subject: languages and words
picture: A neat stack of flashcards showing different Japanese characters (kanji, hiragana, katakana) on a wooden desk, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Japanese uses three writing systems at once: kanji, hiragana and katakana?
en.detail: Modern Japanese mixes Chinese characters (kanji) with two phonetic alphabets for native words and borrowed words. This trio lets writers show meaning, grammar and foreign terms clearly.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Japanese dey use three writing systems at once: kanji, hiragana and katakana?
pcm.detail: Modern Japanese mixes Chinese characters (kanji) with two phonetic alphabets for native words and borrowed words. This trio lets writers show meaning, grammar and foreign terms clearly.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé èdè Jàpánì ń lo eto kikọ mẹ́ta ní àkókò kan: kanji, hiragana àti katakana?
yo.detail: Ìjùmọ̀ Jàpánì dárapọ̀ àwọn àmì Ṣáínì (kanji) pẹ̀lú àwọn àlùfáà ohun (hiragana àti katakana) fún ọ̀rọ̀ abinibi àti tí a gbà láti òkè òkun, èyí ń jẹ́ kí a fi ìtumọ̀, girama àti ọ̀rọ̀ ajẹsara hàn kedere.

ig.fact: Ị maara na Japanese na-eji usoro ede atọ n’otu: kanji, hiragana na katakana?
ig.detail: Japanese nke oge a na-ejikọta mkpụrụedemede Chinese (kanji) na alphabets phonetic abụọ maka okwu ọdịnala na okwu êwere site n’ụwa ọzọ. Njikọta a na-enyere edemede igosipụta pụtara, grammar na okwu si mba ọzọ nke ọma.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa Jafananci yana amfani da tsarin rubutu guda uku a lokaci guda: kanji, hiragana da katakana?
ha.detail: Modern Japanese mixes Chinese characters (kanji) with two phonetic alphabets for native words and borrowed words. This trio lets writers show meaning, grammar and foreign terms clearly.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le japonais utilise trois systèmes d’écriture à la fois : kanji, hiragana et katakana ?
fr.detail: Modern Japanese mixes Chinese characters (kanji) with two phonetic alphabets for native words and borrowed words. This trio lets writers show meaning, grammar and foreign terms clearly.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ اليابانية تستخدم ثلاثة أنظمة كتابة معًا: كانجي وهيراغانا وكاتاكانا؟
ar.detail: اليابانية الحديثة تدمج الحروف الصينية (كانجي) مع ألفبائيْن صوتيّيْن للكلمات الأصلية والمستعارة، مما يسمح بتمييز المعنى والنحو والمصطلحات الأجنبية بوضوح.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba Kijapani kinatumia mifumo mitatu ya uandishi sekal: kanji, hiragana na katakana?
sw.detail: Kijapani cha kisasa kinakamua herufi za Kichina (kanji) pamoja na alfabeti mbili za fonetiki kwa maneno ya asili na maneno yaliyokopwa; mchanganyiko huu unawawezesha waandishi kuonyesha maana, sarufi na maneno ya kigeni kwa uwazi.

pt.fact: Sabias que o japonês usa três sistemas de escrita ao mesmo tempo: kanji, hiragana e katakana?
pt.detail: Modern Japanese mixes Chinese characters (kanji) with two phonetic alphabets for native words and borrowed words. This trio lets writers show meaning, grammar and foreign terms clearly.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el japonés usa tres sistemas de escritura a la vez: kanji, hiragana y katakana?
es.detail: El japonés moderno mezcla caracteres chinos (kanji) con dos alfabetos fonéticos para palabras nativas y palabras prestadas. Esta combinación permite mostrar claramente significado, gramática y términos extranjeros.

subject: languages and words
picture: A macro photo of an open mouth and tongue position demonstrating a click mechanism on a neutral background, no faces or people.

en.fact: Did you know some African languages use click sounds as regular consonants?
en.detail: Languages like Xhosa and several Khoisan languages include click consonants that function like 'k' or 't' in other languages. Clicks are produced by creating suction in the mouth, then releasing it.

pcm.fact: You sabi say some African languages get click sounds wey act like normal consonants?
pcm.detail: Languages like Xhosa and several Khoisan languages include click consonants that function like 'k' or 't' in other languages. Clicks are produced by creating suction in the mouth, then releasing it.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé díẹ̀ ninu àwọn èdè Áfíríkà bíi Xhosa àti àwọn èdè Khoisan ní ohun 'click' gẹ́gẹ́ bí konsonanti deede?
yo.detail: Àwọn ohun click wọ̀nyí ṣiṣẹ́ bíi konsonanti míì, a sì ń ṣe wọn nípa ṣe ìdákẹ́jẹẹ́kù nínú ẹnu láti ṣẹ̀dá ìmú-sùbù, kí a sì tú u sílẹ̀.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ụfọdụ asụsụ Afrịka na-eji ụda click dị ka consonant mgbe nile?
ig.detail: Asụsụ dị ka Xhosa na ụfọdụ asụsụ Khoisan gụnyere click consonants nke na-arụ ọrụ dịka 'k' ma ọ bụ 't' n’asụsụ ndị ọzọ. A na-emepụta clicks site n’ime suction n’ọnụ, wee hapụ ya.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa wasu harsunan Afirka suna amfani da sautin danna (click) a matsayin ƙwayar sautuka na yau da kullum?
ha.detail: Languages like Xhosa and several Khoisan languages include click consonants that function like 'k' or 't' in other languages. Clicks are produced by creating suction in the mouth, then releasing it.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que certaines langues africaines utilisent des clics comme consonnes régulières ?
fr.detail: Languages like Xhosa and several Khoisan languages include click consonants that function like 'k' or 't' in other languages. Clicks are produced by creating suction in the mouth, then releasing it.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ بعض لغات أفريقيا تستخدم أصوات نقر كحروف صوتية اعتيادية؟
ar.detail: لغات مثل الخوسا وبعض لغات الخويسان تضم حروف نقر تعمل مثل 'ك' أو 'ت' في لغات أخرى، وتُنتَج بإحداث شفط داخل الفم ثم إطلاقه.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba baadhi ya lugha za Afrika zinatumia sauti za 'click' kama konsonanti za kawaida?
sw.detail: Lugha kama Xhosa na baadhi ya lugha za Khoisan zina konsonanti za click zinazofanya kazi kama 'k' au 't' katika lugha nyingine; clicks hutengenezwa kwa kuunda msongamano mdomoni kisha kuutoa.

pt.fact: Sabias que algumas línguas africanas usam cliques como consoantes regulares?
pt.detail: Languages like Xhosa and several Khoisan languages include click consonants that function like 'k' or 't' in other languages. Clicks are produced by creating suction in the mouth, then releasing it.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que algunas lenguas africanas usan sonidos de clic como consonantes regulares?
es.detail: Lenguas como el xhosa y varias khoisan incluyen consonantes con clic que funcionan como la 'k' o la 't' en otras lenguas. Los clics se producen creando succión en la boca y luego liberándola.

subject: languages and words
picture: An abstract photo of sound waves overlaid on an African savanna silhouette at sunrise, no people.

en.fact: Did you know many African languages are tonal, using pitch to change word meaning?
en.detail: Languages such as Yoruba and Igbo use tone so the same syllable can mean different things with different pitches. Tone is a core part of vocabulary, not just emotion or stress.

pcm.fact: You sabi say many African languages dey tonal, dem use pitch to change the meaning of words?
pcm.detail: Languages such as Yoruba and Igbo use tone so the same syllable can mean different things with different pitches. Tone is a core part of vocabulary, not just emotion or stress.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé ọ̀pọ̀ èdè Áfíríkà jẹ́ tonal, wọn ń lò ìgíga-orin (pitch) láti yí ìtumọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ padà?
yo.detail: Èdè bíi Yorùbá àti Igbo máa ń lo tone kíkan fún ìyípadà ìtumọ̀; tone jẹ́ apá pàtàkì ti ọ̀rọ̀, kì í ṣe àfihàn ìmọ̀tara-ẹni tàbí ìtẹ́biì.

ig.fact: Ị maara na ọtụtụ asụsụ Afrịka bụ tonal, na-eji pitch gbanwee pụtara okwu?
ig.detail: Asụsụ dịka Yoruba na Igbo na-eji tone ka otu syllable pụta ihe dị iche iche site n’iji pitch dị iche. Tone bụ akụkụ isi nke okwu, ọ bụghị naanị mmetụta obi ma ọ bụ mgbali olu.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa da yawa daga cikin harsunan Afirka suna da murya (tonal), suna amfani da ɗagawa ko sauke murya don canza ma’anar kalma?
ha.detail: Languages such as Yoruba and Igbo use tone so the same syllable can mean different things with different pitches. Tone is a core part of vocabulary, not just emotion or stress.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que de nombreuses langues africaines sont tonales, utilisant la hauteur pour changer le sens des mots ?
fr.detail: Languages such as Yoruba and Igbo use tone so the same syllable can mean different things with different pitches. Tone is a core part of vocabulary, not just emotion or stress.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ العديد من لغات أفريقيا نغمية وتستخدم النبرة لتغيير معنى الكلمة؟
ar.detail: لغات مثل اليوروبا والإيغبو تستخدم النبرة بحيث يمكن أن تحمل نفس المقطع معانٍ مختلفة حسب تغيّر الحدة الصوتية، فالنبرة جزء أساسي من المفردات لا مجرد تعبير عن المشاعر.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba lugha nyingi za Afrika ni za tonal, zikitumia sauti kuleta tofauti ya maana ya neno?
sw.detail: Lugha kama Yoruba na Igbo zinatumia tonal hivyo silabi ile ile inaweza kumaanisha vitu tofauti kwa sauti tofauti; toni ni sehemu ya msingi ya msamiati, sio hisia au msisitizo tu.

pt.fact: Sabias que muitas línguas africanas são tonais, usando a entoação para mudar o significado das palavras?
pt.detail: Languages such as Yoruba and Igbo use tone so the same syllable can mean different things with different pitches. Tone is a core part of vocabulary, not just emotion or stress.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que muchas lenguas africanas son tonales y usan el tono para cambiar el significado de las palabras?
es.detail: Lenguas como el yoruba y el igbo usan el tono para que la misma sílaba signifique cosas diferentes según la altura de la voz. El tono es parte esencial del vocabulario, no solo de la emoción o el énfasis.

subject: languages and words
picture: A photograph of a wooden dhow boat on calm coastal water with a market shoreline in the distance, no people.

en.fact: Did you know Swahili grew as a trade language by borrowing from Arabic, Persian and Bantu roots?
en.detail: Swahili developed on East African coasts through centuries of trade, picking up vocabulary from Arab and Persian traders while keeping Bantu grammar. That made it a practical lingua franca across the region.

pcm.fact: You sabi say Swahili grow as trade language after borrowing from Arabic, Persian and Bantu roots?
pcm.detail: Swahili developed on East African coasts through centuries of trade, picking up vocabulary from Arab and Persian traders while keeping Bantu grammar. That made it a practical lingua franca across the region.

yo.fact: Ṣe o mọ̀ pé Swahili dàgbà gẹ́gẹ́ bí èdè ìṣòwò nípa gbígba ọ̀rọ̀ láti Arabic, Persian àti orísun Bantu?
yo.detail: Swahili ṣe ìtọ́sọ́nà lórílẹ̀-èdè ìlà-õrùn Afirika nípasẹ̀ ìṣòwò láàárín ọ̀gá àwọn aṣòwò, nítorí náà ó gba ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ láti Arabìkì àti Persian ṣùgbọ́n pa ìmúlò girama Bantu mọ́.

ig.fact: Ị maara na Swahili toro dịka asụsụ azụmahịa site n’ịnata okwu site n’Arabic, Persian na mgbọrọgwụ Bantu?
ig.detail: Swahili mepụtara n’akụkụ ọnụ mmiri East Africa site n’afọ ndị gara aga nke azụmahịa, were ahịrịokwu site n'aka ndị Arab na Persian ebe o chekwara grammar Bantu. Nke a mere ka ọ bụrụ lingua franca bara uru n’ụzọ sara mbara n’ógbè ahụ.

ha.fact: Shin ka san cewa Kiswahili ya bunƙasa a matsayin harshe na kasuwanci ta hanyar aro kalmomi daga larabci, Farsi da tushen Bantu?
ha.detail: Swahili developed on East African coasts through centuries of trade, picking up vocabulary from Arab and Persian traders while keeping Bantu grammar. That made it a practical lingua franca across the region.

fr.fact: Le saviez‑vous que le swahili s’est développé comme langue commerciale en empruntant à l’arabe, au persan et aux racines bantoues ?
fr.detail: Swahili developed on East African coasts through centuries of trade, picking up vocabulary from Arab and Persian traders while keeping Bantu grammar. That made it a practical lingua franca across the region.

ar.fact: هل تعلم أنّ السواحيلية نشأت كلغة تجارة باقتباس كلمات من العربية والفارسية وجذور بانتو؟
ar.detail: تطوّرت السواحيلية على سواحل شرق أفريقيا عبر قرون من التجارة، فاستعارت مفردات من التجّار العرب والفُرس مع الحفاظ على القواعد البانتوية، مما جعلها لغة تواصل عملية في المنطقة.

sw.fact: Je, ulijua kwamba Kiswahili kilikuwepo kama lugha ya biashara kwa kukopa kutoka Kiarabu, Kupersia na mizizi ya Kibantu?
sw.detail: Kiswahili kilikuza pwani za Afrika Mashariki kupitia karne za biashara, kikichukua msamiati kutoka kwa wafanyabiashara wa Kiarabu na Kupersia huku kikihifadhi sarufi ya Kibantu; hilo lilifanya kuwa lingua franca ya vitendo katika ukanda.

pt.fact: Sabias que o suaíli cresceu como língua de comércio ao incorporar palavras do árabe, persa e raízes bantas?
pt.detail: Swahili developed on East African coasts through centuries of trade, picking up vocabulary from Arab and Persian traders while keeping Bantu grammar. That made it a practical lingua franca across the region.

es.fact: ¿Sabías que el swahili creció como lengua de comercio al tomar prestado del árabe, persa y raíces bantúes?
es.detail: El swahili se desarrolló en las costas del África Oriental por siglos de comercio, incorporando vocabulario de comerciantes árabes y persas mientras mantenía la gramática bantú. Eso lo hizo un idioma práctico como lengua franca en la región.
